items.title: Minnesota: Hooyo Soomaali ah oo loo xiray dilka labadeeda carruur ah oo 3 iyo 5 jir ah
items.summary: Booliska magaalada Savage ee gobolka Minnesota, Mareykanka, ayaa xiray hooyo Soomaali ah oo 33 jir ah, kaddib markii labadeeda carruur ah oo 3 iyo 5 jir ah ay ku dhinteen toogasho Arbacadii ka dhacday guri ku yaalla magaalada.
items.imageAlt: Waddo ku taalla magaalada Savage ee Minnesota, sawir hore

items.title: Flamengo oo 2-1 ka soo noqotay Athletico Paranaense, hoggaanka Brasileirão-na 6 dhibcood ku kordhisay
items.summary: Flamengo ayaa garoonka Maracanã ugu soo noqotay guul 2-1 ah oo ay ka gaartay Athletico Paranaense, iyadoo Palmeiras oo labaad ah ay 2-1 guriga Cruzeiro looga adkaaday, sidaasna Flamengo ay hoggaanka horyaalka Brazil ugu kordhisay lix dhibcood.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Maracanã ee Rio de Janeiro, sawir hore

items.title: Trump oo Shenzhen kula kulmay Putin kadibna Xi Jinping, kuna adkaystay in Iran aan caawimaad looga baahnayn
items.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Khamiistii magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha wadahadal kula yeeshay Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin, kadibna la kulmay Madaxweyne Xi Jinping, iyadoo uu sheegay in Mareykanku uusan u baahnayn caawimaad Ruushka iyo Shiinaha si uu u soo afjaro dagaalka Iran.
items.imageAlt: Dhismayaasha dhaadheer ee magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha, sawir hore

items.title: NBA: Utah Jazz oo 109-97 ku garaacday Lakers, sagaal guul oo isku xigta oo Lakers lahayd-na joojisay
items.summary: Utah Jazz ayaa Arbacadii Los Angeles 109-97 kaga adkaatay Lakers, kooxda ugu fiican NBA, iyadoo Keyonte George uu dhaliyay 30 dhibcood, sidaasna ay joojisay sagaal guul oo isku xigta oo Lakers ay gaartay.
items.imageAlt: Keyonte George oo u ciyaaraya Utah Jazz, sawir hore oo January 2026 laga qaaday

items.title: NBA: Cooper Flagg oo 33 dhibcood dhaliyay, Mavericks-na 116-94 ku garaacday Warriors
items.summary: Cooper Flagg ayaa dhaliyay 33 dhibcood iyo 9 caawin, Dallas Mavericks-na Arbacadii 116-94 kaga adkaatay Golden State Warriors oo aan haysan Stephen Curry, sidaasna ay ku joojisay saddex guul-darro oo isku xigta.
items.imageAlt: Cooper Flagg oo u ciyaaraya jaamacadda Duke, sawir hore oo 2025 laga qaaday

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo maalgashadayaasha caalamka u bandhigtay 14 qaybood oo sahan saliid ah
items.summary: Koonfur Suudaan ayaa maalgashadayaasha caalamiga ah u bandhigaysa 14 qaybood oo loogu talagalay sahanka saliidda, iyadoo diyaar u ah inay 24 iyo 25 November Juba ku martigeliso shirka toddobaad ee South Sudan Oil and Power.
items.imageAlt: Xarun lagu farsameeyo saliidda oo ku taalla Koonfur Suudaan, sawir hore oo 2012 laga qaaday

items.title: F1: Ollie Bearman oo ka xun in Haas aysan weli xaqiijin heshiiskiisa 2027
items.summary: Darawalka Haas Ollie Bearman ayaa sheegay inay niyad-jab ku tahay in kooxdu aysan weli ku dhawaaqin inuu sii joogi doono 2027, isagoo ah darawalka keliya ee aan weli loo magacaabin xilli ciyaareedka soo socda, iyadoo xilli ciyaareedku dhammaad ku dhow yahay.
items.imageAlt: Ollie Bearman oo wadaya baabuurka Haas, sawir hore oo 2025 laga qaaday

items.title: Valérien Ismaël oo loo soo bandhigay tababaraha cusub ee Le Havre, kooxda ugu dambeysa Ligue 1
items.summary: Le Havre oo ku jirta kaalinta ugu dambeysa Ligue 1 ayaa Arbacadii warbaahinta u soo bandhigtay tababaraheeda cusub Valérien Ismaël, oo 51 jir ah, kaasoo ballan qaaday inuu kooxda ka badbaadin doono hoos u dhaca.
items.imageAlt: Valérien Ismaël, sawir hore oo 2014 laga qaaday

items.title: Diego Pavia oo noqday ciyaaryahanka ugu horreeya ee laga doorto UFL, Columbus Aviators ayaa qaatay
items.summary: Diego Pavia, oo hore ugu ciyaari jiray Vanderbilt kana mid ahaa musharrixiinta kama dambaysta ah ee abaalmarinta Heisman Trophy, ayaa Arbacadii noqday doorashada koowaad ee xulashada ciyaartoyda horyaalka United Football League (UFL), waxaana qaatay Columbus Aviators.
items.imageAlt: Diego Pavia, sawir hore oo 2022 laga qaaday

items.title: Uganda oo booliska ku amartay inay joojiyaan bandhigyada iyo isu-imaatinka degmooyinka xuduudda, Ebola dartiis
items.summary: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Uganda ayaa booliska ku amartay inay joojiyaan riwaayadaha, xafladaha, shirarka siyaasadeed iyo isu-imaatinka kale ee degmooyinka xuduudda ee khatarta sare ku jira, iyadoo Ebola ay sii faafayso Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo.
items.imageAlt: Buuraha degmada Bundibugyo ee galbeedka Uganda, oo xuduud la leh Congo, sawir hore

items.title: Elon Musk oo sheegay in lacagtii uu ku bixiyay doorashooyinka Mareykanka ay ahayd 'nacasnimo'
items.summary: Elon Musk ayaa Arbacadii sheegay inuu dareemayo 'nacasnimo' lacagta rikoorka ah ee uu ku bixiyay doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka, kadib guuldarrooyin ballaaran oo soo gaaray xisbiga Jamhuuriga.
items.imageAlt: Elon Musk, sawir hore oo la qaaday March 2025

items.title: Ashley Sanchez oo ku guuleysatay abaalmarinta MVP ee NWSL kadib xilli 20 gool ah
items.summary: Weeraryahanka North Carolina Courage, Ashley Sanchez, ayaa loo doortay ciyaartoyga ugu qiimaha badan (MVP) xilli ciyaareedka horyaalka haweenka Mareykanka ee NWSL, kadib markii ay dhalisay 20 gool.
items.imageAlt: Ashley Sanchez oo garoonka ku jirta, sawir hore

items.title: IAEA: Kuuriyada Waqooyi oo dhamaystirtay ballaarin cusub oo lagu sameeyay xarunta uranium-ka ee Yongbyon
items.summary: Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga Caalamka (IAEA), Rafael Grossi, ayaa sheegay in Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay dhammaadkii October dhamaystirtay dhismaha dibadda ee ballaarin cusub oo lagu sameeyay xarunta sifeynta uranium-ka ee Yongbyon.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta cilmi-baarista nukliyeerka ee Yongbyon, Kuuriyada Waqooyi (sawir hore)

items.title: Sawir uu sameeyay Van Gogh oo rikoor ah 190.4 milyan oo doollar lagu iibiyay
items.summary: Shirkadda xaraashka ee Sotheby's ayaa New York ku iibisay sawirka 'Châtaigniers en fleurs' ee Vincent van Gogh 190.4 milyan oo doollar, taasoo ah qiimaha ugu sarreeya ee abid xaraash lagu iibiyo shaqo uu sameeyay.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka 'Châtaigniers en fleurs' ee Vincent van Gogh (1890)

items.title: Kenya: Yaraanta caanaha oo sii xumaatay iyadoo abaartu saameysay beeralayda xoolaha
items.summary: Caanaha ayaa ku yaraaday qaybo ka mid ah Kenya, gaar ahaan dukaamada Nairobi, kadib markii xilli qalalan oo dheer uu hoos u dhigay wax-soosaarka beeralayda xoolaha caanaha, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Nin ku lisaya sac gobolka Murang'a ee Kenya (sawir hore)

items.title: Cam Skattebo oo joojiyay dabaaldegga 'backflip' kadib dhaawacii Aidan Hutchinson
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka New York Giants, Cam Skattebo, ayaa sheegay inuu muddo joojinayo dabaaldegga uu dhabarka isaga rogo, kadib markii xiddigga Detroit Lions Aidan Hutchinson uu dhaawac jilibka ah ku soo gaaray isagoo dabaaldegaya.
items.imageAlt: Aidan Hutchinson, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2021

items.title: Ciyaaryahanka Ravens Marlon Humphrey oo raali-gelin ka bixiyay hadal uu ka sheegay magaalada Baltimore
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka khadka daafaca ee Baltimore Ravens Marlon Humphrey ayaa Arbacadii raali-gelin bixiyay, kaddib markii uu barnaamijkiisa podcast-ka ku sheegay in Baltimore ay ugu fiican tahay soo saarista dambiilayaal, sida ay wariyeen CBS Sports iyo The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: Marlon Humphrey, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2021

items.title: Mareykanka oo cunaqabateyn cusub saaray urur uu ku tilmaamay waji u ah Xisbullah
items.summary: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii cunaqabateyn saartay ururka Wa Ta'awanu Association ee Lubnaan, oo ay ku tilmaantay waji ay Xisbullah u adeegsato ururinta lacagaha, iyo saddex qof oo Lubnaan ku nool, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ee Washington, sawir hore

items.title: Muddadii is-diiwaangelinta doorashada madaxtooyada FIFA oo xirantay, Infantino oo ah musharaxa ugu horreeya
items.summary: Muddadii musharaxiinta doorashada guddoomiyaha FIFA ayaa xirantay, iyadoo Gianni Infantino uu yahay musharaxa loo badinayo inuu ku guuleysto shirweynaha 18 March ee Rabat, halka Philippe Diallo iyo Kozo Tashima ay iyana tartamayaan, sida ay wariyeen AS iyo RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Gianni Infantino, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2020

items.title: Luke Littler oo laga reebay Grand Slam of Darts kaddib guuldaro 10-8 ah oo uu ka soo gaaray Jermaine Wattimena
items.summary: Horyaalkii difaacanayay Luke Littler ayaa si lama filaan ah looga saaray Grand Slam of Darts ee Wolverhampton, kaddib markii ciyaaryahanka reer Holland Jermaine Wattimena uu 10-8 kaga adkaaday wareegga labaad, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Jermaine Wattimena iyo Stefan Bellmont, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2024

items.title: Manchester United oo tixgelinaysa tallaabo sharci ah kaddib bixitaanka JJ Gabriel ee Real Madrid
items.summary: Manchester United ayaa la sheegay inay diyaar u tahay inay tallaabo sharci ah qaaddo haddii ay hesho caddeyn muujinaysa in kooxo kale ay la xiriireen ciyaaryahanka 16 jirka ah ee JJ Gabriel intii uu heshiiska kula jiray, sida ay wariyeen warbaahinta Ingiriiska iyo Spain.
items.imageAlt: Sawir hore oo laga qaaday garoonka Old Trafford ee Manchester United

items.title: Juventus Haweenka oo 2-0 ku garaacday OH Leuven, una gudubtay wareegga ka-saarista Champions League
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Juventus ayaa Arbacadii magaalada Biella 2-0 kaga adkaatay OH Leuven ee Belgium ciyaartii 5aad ee wareegga horyaalka UEFA Women's Champions League, waxayna xaqiijisay inay u gudubto wareegga ka-saarista iyadoo ay ka harsan tahay hal ciyaar.
items.imageAlt: Annamaria Serturini, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2018

items.title: Mamadou Coulibaly oo hal kulan laga mamnuucay kaddib dabaaldeggiisii muranka dhaliyay
items.summary: Guddiga anshaxa ee Ligue de Football Professionnel (LFP) ayaa Arbacadii hal kulan oo toos ah iyo laba kulan oo shuruud ah ku ganaaxay ciyaaryahanka Monaco Mamadou Coulibaly, kaddib dabaaldeg uu sameeyay markii uu gool ka dhaliyay Le Mans.
items.imageAlt: Sawir hore oo laga qaaday garoonka Stade Louis II ee Monaco

items.title: Rob Manfred: milkiilayaasha MLB ma aqbali doonaan heshiis aan lahayn xad mushahar
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha horyaalka baseball-ka Mareykanka (MLB) Rob Manfred ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in milkiilayaasha kooxaha aysan ka tanaasuli doonin dalabkooda ah in heshiiska shaqada ee cusub uu yeesho xad sare iyo xad hoose oo mushaharka ah, taas oo horyaalka u dhaweynaysa xannibaad shaqo.
items.imageAlt: Rob Manfred, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2019

items.title: Wadaad ku nool Florida oo lagu helay dembiyo la xiriira dilkii Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse
items.summary: Xeerbeegti federaal ah oo ku sugan Miami ayaa Arbacadii dembi ku heshay wadaadka Christian Emmanuel Sanon, oo haysta dhalashada Haiti iyo Mareykanka, dhammaan sideed eedeyn oo ay ka mid tahay shirqool lagu dilayay Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse, sida ay wariyeen CBS News iyo CNN.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2019

items.title: Chelsea oo gool dambe 1-0 kaga adkaatay PSG, kuna gashay hoggaanka Champions League-ka Haweenka
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Chelsea ayaa Arbacadii 1-0 kaga adkaatay Paris Saint-Germain wareegga horyaalka ee UEFA Women's Champions League, kaddib gool ay daqiiqadii 88 dhalisay daafaca Veerle Buurman.
items.imageAlt: Veerle Buurman, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2025

items.title: Copa del Rey: Mallorca oo waqti dheeraad ah ku dhaaftay Alcoyano, Tenerife-na 5-2 ku garaacday Badajoz
items.summary: Mallorca ayaa Arbacadii 3-1 kaga adkaatay Alcoyano kaddib waqti dheeraad ah, halka Tenerife ay 5-2 kaga badisay Badajoz, iyagoo labaduba u gudbay wareegga xiga ee Copa del Rey.
items.imageAlt: Sawir hore oo laga qaaday garoonka Estadi Mallorca Son Moix

items.title: Mykhailo Mudryk oo sheegay in maamulka xulka Ukraine uu mas'uul ka yahay baaritaankii doping-ka ee uu ku dhacay
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Tottenham ee amaahda kaga jira Chelsea, Mykhailo Mudryk, ayaa markii ugu horreysay si furan uga hadlay ganaaxiisii doping-ka, isagoo eedda saaray maamulka xulka qaranka Ukraine, sida ay wariyeen BBC Sport iyo AS.
items.imageAlt: Mykhailo Mudryk, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2023

items.title: Daafaca England Jess Carter oo ku biirtay Bay FC kaddib markii ay ka tagtay Gotham FC
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanadda khadka daafaca ee xulka England Jess Carter ayaa u wareegtay kooxda Bay FC ee horyaalka NWSL, iyadoo heshiis la saxiixatay ilaa 2028 kaddib markii ay si xor ah uga tagtay Gotham FC, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Jess Carter, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2022

items.title: Strasbourg oo si rasmi ah u magacaabtay Vítor Matos, Hugo Oliveira-na wuu tagay
items.summary: Kooxda Strasbourg ee Ligue 1 ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday in Vítor Matos oo 38 jir ah, kana yimid Swansea City, uu noqday tababarahooda cusub, kaddib markii ay kala tageen Hugo Oliveira.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Stade de la Meinau ee Strasbourg, sawir hore

items.title: Sonny Gray oo ku laabtay Minnesota Twins, heshiis laba sano ah oo lagu sheegay 55 milyan oo dollar
items.summary: Kooxda baseball-ka Minnesota Twins ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay dib u qaadatay tuuraha waayo-aragga ah Sonny Gray, iyadoo heshiiska lagu sheegay laba sano iyo 55 milyan oo dollar, sida ay werisay CBS Sports.
items.imageAlt: Sonny Gray, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2015

items.title: Pew: Islaamku wuxuu 2035 ka gudbi doonaa Masiixiyadda, noqonna doonaa diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka
items.summary: Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay xarunta cilmi-baarista Pew Research Center ayaa saadaalisay in Islaamku uu sannadka 2035 ka gudbi doono Masiixiyadda, uuna noqon doono diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka.
items.imageAlt: Dad ka soo baxaya masjid kaddib salaadda Jimcaha, Kano, Nigeria, sawir hore

items.title: Valtteri Bottas oo kursigiisa Cadillac ku sii haynaya xilli ciyaareedka 2027
items.summary: Darawalka Finland u dhashay Valtteri Bottas ayaa sii wadi doona inuu u wado kooxda Mareykanka ee Cadillac xilli ciyaareedka 2027 ee Formula 1, kaddib muddo mustaqbalkiisa uu ahaa mid aan la hubin.
items.imageAlt: Valtteri Bottas, sawir hore oo 2024 la qaaday

items.title: McKennie oo sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay Juventus, hadalkiisa Man Utd-na si khaldan loo fahmay
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Juventus iyo xulka Mareykanka, Weston McKennie, ayaa sheegay in hadalladii uu dhowaan ka sheegay Manchester United si khaldan loo fahmay, isla markaana uu ku faraxsan yahay inuu sii joogo Juventus.
items.imageAlt: Weston McKennie, sawir hore oo 2019 la qaaday

items.title: Real Madrid oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter, Signe Bruun oo laba gool dhalisay
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Real Madrid ayaa Arbacadii garoonka Alfredo Di Stéfano 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter Milan, kulan ka tirsan Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Signe Bruun ay daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay dhalisay laba gool.
items.imageAlt: Signe Bruun, sawir hore oo 2018 la qaaday

items.title: Manchester City oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Häcken, Hemp iyo Shaw oo dhaliyay
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Manchester City ayaa Arbacadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay BK Häcken oo dalka Sweden ah, kulan ka tirsan wareegga horyaalka Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Lauren Hemp iyo Khadija Shaw ay dhaliyeen goolasha.
items.imageAlt: Lauren Hemp, sawir hore

items.title: Leicester City oo joojisay heshiiska maalgeliyaha funaanadda BC Game
items.summary: Kooxda Leicester City ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay heshiis ku kala tageen shirkadda sharadka internetka ee BC Game, oo funaanaddooda ku qornayd tan iyo 2024, kaddib cabashooyin ka yimid taageerayaasha.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka King Power ee kooxda Leicester City, sawir hore

items.title: Rassie Erasmus oo la ganaaxay 6 kulan, kulanka Ireland-na toos ula daawan doona taageerayaasha
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka rugby-ga Koonfur Afrika, Rassie Erasmus, oo World Rugby ay 6 kulan ka mamnuucday hoggaaminta Springboks, ayaa qorsheynaya inuu kulanka Ireland ee Sabtida si toos ah internetka ugula daawado taageerayaasha.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kooxda Springboks oo yaal matxafka Springbok Experience Rugby, sawir hore

items.title: Darajada FIFA: Spain oo hoggaanka haysa, Morocco-na markii ugu horreysay 5-ta sare gashay
items.summary: Darajada cusub ee FIFA oo Arbacadii la shaaciyay ayaa Spain ku sii haysa kaalinta 1-aad, Argentina 2-aad iyo Faransiiska 3-aad, halka Morocco ay gashay 5-ta xul ee ugu sarreysa, kana sarreysay Brazil.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta FIFA ee Zurich, sawir hore

items.title: Emma Hayes oo ka mid ah kooxda raadinaysa tababaraha cusub ee xulka ragga Mareykanka
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka haweenka Mareykanka, Emma Hayes, ayaa sheegtay inay ku kalsoon tahay kooxda loo xilsaaray raadinta beddelka Mauricio Pochettino, kaas oo u ambabaxay Manchester United, iyadoo ay iyadu ka mid tahay kooxdaas.
items.imageAlt: Emma Hayes, sawir hore

items.title: Primož Roglič oo ku biiray kooxda baaskiilka NSN ee Andrés Iniesta
items.summary: Baaskiil-wadaha Slovenia u dhashay Primož Roglič oo 37 jir ah ayaa ka tagay Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, wuxuuna heshiis hal sano ah la saxiixday kooxda NSN Cycling, oo uu milkiilayaasheeda ka mid yahay ciyaaryahankii hore ee Spain Andrés Iniesta.
items.imageAlt: Primož Roglič, sawir hore oo 2024 la qaaday

items.title: Sharciga offside-ka ee Wenger oo la filayo in la tuuro kaddib tijaabo Canada
items.summary: Sharciga cusub ee offside-ka oo uu soo jeediyay Arsène Wenger, laguna tijaabiyay horyaalka Canada tan iyo bishii April, ayaa la filayaa in aan la dhaqan gelin, sida ay werisay L'Équipe iyadoo soo xiganaysa The New York Times.
items.imageAlt: Arsène Wenger, sawir hore oo 2019 la qaaday

items.title: SU’AALO CULUS OO KA DHASHAY KULANKA MUUNGAAB IYO DIBLOMAASIYIINTA IMAARAADKA EE NAIROBI!
items.summary: Maxaa ka dambeeyay kulanka qarsoodiga ah ee Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab, uu la yeeshay saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta?
items.imageAlt: Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab, calammada Imaaraadka iyo Soomaaliya, iyo albaabka Hotel Movenpick ee Nairobi

items.title: Kadaga: Uganda kaligeed ma qaadi karto culayska qaxootiga taageero caalami ah la'aanteed
items.summary: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka koowaad ee Uganda, Rebecca Alitwala Kadaga, ayaa Arbacadii ka digtay in siyaasadda albaabka furan ee dalkeeda aan loo fahmin awood aan xad lahayn, waxayna ku baaqday taageero caalami ah oo badan.
items.imageAlt: Rebecca Kadaga, sawir hore oo 2017

items.title: Walter Samuel oo sagootiyay xulka Argentina kaddib siddeed sano oo uu ka mid ahaa shaqaalaha Scaloni
items.summary: Difaacii hore ee Roma iyo Inter Walter Samuel ayaa si rasmi ah uga tagay shaqaalaha tababarka xulka Argentina kaddib siddeed sano oo uu ku garab shaqaynayay Lionel Scaloni, sida uu xulku ku shaaciyay baraha bulshada, una werisay Sky Sport Italia.
items.imageAlt: Walter Samuel, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2022

items.title: Michael Emenalo, agaasimihii hore ee Chelsea, oo la-talin u qabanaya Leicester City
items.summary: Leicester City oo hadda ku jirta League One ayaa u yeeratay Michael Emenalo, agaasimihii farsamada ee hore ee Chelsea, iyo koox la-taliyayaal ah oo ka socda Deloitte, si ay uga caawiyaan qorshaynta bilaha soo socda.
items.imageAlt: Michael Emenalo, sawir hore oo 2017 laga qaaday

items.title: Maamulaha Juventus Carnevali: Khaladaad ayaa dhacay, dib-u-dhiska waqti ayuu u baahan yahay
items.summary: Agaasimaha guud ee Juventus, Giovanni Carnevali, ayaa qirtay in kooxda ay sannadihii la soo dhaafay gashay khaladaad, isla markaana sheegay in heshiiska maaliyadeed ee ay UEFA la leedahay uu xaddidayo awoodda ay ku iibsan karto ciyaartoy.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Allianz Stadium ee Juventus ee Turin, sawir hore

items.title: Doorashada FIFA: Tashima oo doonaya wadahadal la yeesho Diallo, DFB-na si rasmi ah u taageertay Diallo
items.summary: Kozo Tashima oo u tartamaya madaxweynaha FIFA ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo inuu wadahadal la yeesho Philippe Diallo, oo isna u tartamaya xilka, halka Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Jarmalka uu si rasmi ah u taageeray Diallo.
items.imageAlt: Philippe Diallo, sawir hore oo 2020 la qaaday

items.title: Saddex xildhibaan oo Mareykan ah oo Trump ka codsaday inuu dib u eego cunaqabateynta Rwanda
items.summary: Saddex sharci-dejiye oo ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee Mareykanka ayaa warqad ay qoreen 16-ka November ku codsaday in dib loo eego cunaqabateynta Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ay saartay ciidamada iyo Wasaaradda Difaaca ee Rwanda.
items.imageAlt: Xildhibaan Joe Wilson, sawirkiisa rasmiga ah ee Congress-ka

items.title: Prem Rugby oo furtay diiwaangelinta kooxaha doonaya inay horyaalka ku biiraan, 12 kooxood 2029-30

items.summary: Juan Mata, oo la guuleystay Spain Koobka Adduunka 2010 iyo Euro 2012, ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubbadda cagta isagoo 38 jir ah, kaddib 20 xilli ciyaareed, sida ay werisay AS.
items.imageAlt: Juan Mata, sawir hore (2024)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo keligeed ka hor timid qaraar Qaramada Midoobay ka ansixisay difaaca haweenka iyo gabdhaha – Codka haweenka oo mar kale dunida xusuusiyay muhiimaddooda!
items.summary: Guddiga saddexaad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa 175 cod ku ansixiyey qaraar lagu xoojinayo dagaalka ka dhanka ah tacaddiyada haweenka iyo gabdhaha, halka Soomaaliya ay noqotay dalka keliya ee diiday.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee New York oo kulan ka socdo

items.title: Pochettino oo Arbacada bilaabaya shaqada Man Utd: "Manchester had iyo jeer buluug ma ahaan doonto"
items.summary: Mauricio Pochettino ayaa ballanqaaday inuu Manchester United dib ugu celin doono inay noqoto kooxda ugu guulaha badan magaalada, isagoo Arbacadan si rasmi ah u bilaabaya shaqadiisa cusub, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Mauricio Pochettino, sawir hore (2012)

items.title: Voyager 1 oo gaartay masaafo hal maalin iftiin ah oo u jirta Dhulka
items.summary: Dayax-gacmeedka sahanka ee Voyager 1 ayaa Arbacadii gaaray masaafo hal maalin iftiin ah oo u jirta Dhulka, taasoo ah qiyaastii 25.9 bilyan oo kiilomitir, kaddib ku dhawaad 50 sano oo uu hawada sare ku jiray, sida ay werisay Sweden Herald iyadoo soo xiganaysa NASA.
items.imageAlt: Sawir sharraxaad ah oo NASA ay samaysay ee dayax-gacmeedka Voyager

items.title: Talyaaniga oo ansixiyay sharci ka dhan ah naceybka Yuhuudda, iyadoo walaac laga muujiyay xorriyadda hadalka
items.summary: Xildhibaannada Talyaaniga ayaa Talaadadii ansixiyay sharci lagula dagaallamayo naceybka Yuhuudda, kaasoo sharciga dalka ku daraya qeexidda ururka IHRA ee 2016, inkastoo mucaaradku ay ka cabsi qabaan inuu xaddido xorriyadda hadalka, sida ay werisay The Local iyo France 24.
items.imageAlt: Palazzo Montecitorio, xarunta Golaha Wakiilada Talyaaniga ee Rome, sawir hore

items.title: Qarax xooggan oo laga maqlay waqooyiga magaalada Riyadh
items.summary: Qarax xooggan ayaa Arbacadii laga maqlay qeybta waqooyi ee Riyadh, caasimadda Sacuudi Carabiya, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AFP. Sababta qaraxa iyo haddii uu khasaare dhaliyay lama oga weli.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaalka dhismayaasha dhaadheer ee magaalada Riyadh, sawir hore

items.title: Real Madrid oo loo soo jeediyay ganaax 3,001 euro ah boodh ka dhan ah Javier Tebas dartiis
items.summary: Guddiga Spain ee la dagaalanka rabshadaha isboortiga ayaa soo jeediyay in Real Madrid la ganaaxo 3,001 euro, kaddib markii taageerayaasheedu garoonka Bernabéu ku muujiyeen boodh ka dhan ah madaxweynaha LaLiga, Javier Tebas, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Santiago Bernabéu ee Madrid, sawir hore

items.title: Chile iyo Colombia oo 0-0 ku kala tagay, Vigouroux oo badbaadiyay rigoore
items.summary: Xulalka Chile iyo Colombia ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Monumental ee Santiago ku kala tagay barbarro 0-0 ah, kulankoodii saaxiibtinimo ee ugu dambeeyay sannadkan, iyadoo goolhayaha Chile, Lawrence Vigouroux, uu badbaadiyay rigoore, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Monumental ee Santiago, sawir hore

items.title: Antonio Rüdiger: "Laba sano oo Real Madrid aysan waxba ku guuleysan waa wax aad u xun"
items.summary: Daafaca Real Madrid Antonio Rüdiger ayaa wareysi uu siiyay The Athletic ku sheegay in laba sano oo kooxdu aysan koob ku guuleysan ay tahay xaalad aad u xun, isagoo ka hadlay tababarayaashii kala duwanaa ee kooxda.
items.imageAlt: Sawir hore: Antonio Rüdiger oo u ciyaaraya xulka Jarmalka

items.title: AFL oo 3 kulan ka joojisay Tom Papley kaddib baaritaan muujiyay kookayn iyo MDMA
items.summary: Ururka kubbadda cagta Australia (AFL) ayaa 3 kulan ka joojiyay xiddigga Sydney Swans, Tom Papley, kaddib markii muunad labaad oo baaritaan daroogo ah ay xaqiijisay kookayn iyo MDMA, sida ay werisay The Guardian.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Sydney Cricket Ground, halkaas oo Sydney Swans ay ku ciyaaraan, sawir hore

items.title: Turkiga: diyaaradaha F-16 ee Soomaaliya oo 55 saacadood ku kala duulay Muqdisho iyo Bandırma
items.summary: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in duuliyeyaasheeda ay diyaaradaha dagaalka F-16 ee ka howlgala Soomaaliya ku kala beddeleen Muqdisho iyo magaalada Bandırma, iyagoo maray in ka badan 11,000 oo kiiloomitir muddo 55 saacadood ah.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad dagaal oo nooca F-16 ah, sawir hore

items.title: Quentin Grimes oo 47 dhibcood dhaliyay, Lakers oo 118-114 ku garaacday Hornets waqti dheeraad ah
items.summary: Quentin Grimes ayaa dhaliyay 47 dhibcood, oo ah kuwii ugu badnaa xirfaddiisa, isagoo Los Angeles Lakers ka caawiyay inay waqti dheeraad ah 118-114 kaga adkaadaan Charlotte Hornets, sida ay werisay The Athletic iyo AP.
items.imageAlt: Quentin Grimes, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: Aadan Faarax oo loo magacaabay guddoomiyaha guddiga maamulka Ethiopian Airlines
items.summary: Aadan Faarax, oo ah siyaasi Soomaali ah oo haya darajada Ra’iisul Wasaare-ku-xigeenka Itoobiya, ayaa loo magacaabay guddoomiyaha cusub ee guddiga maamulka shirkadda diyaaradaha Ethiopian Airlines, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad Boeing 787 ah oo ay leedahay Ethiopian Airlines, sawir hore

items.title: Kozo Tashima oo si rasmi ah u gudbiyay codsigiisa doorashada madaxweynaha FIFA
items.summary: Kozo Tashima, madaxweynaha sharafta ee Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Japan, ayaa gudbiyay codsigiisa uu ugu tartamayo madaxweynaha FIFA, kaddib markii ay taageereen 5 xiriir oo qaran, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Rabat, halkaas oo shirka FIFA lagu qabanayo, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo xarigga ka jaray waddada Jamhuuriya ee degmada Kaaraan
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Arbacadii xarigga ka jaray waddada Jamhuuriya ee degmada Kaaraan ee Muqdisho, kaddib dib-u-dhis iyo dayactir ballaaran oo lagu sameeyay, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sawir hore

items.title: Ecuador oo 2-0 ku garaacday Bolivia, Gallardo oo gaaray guushiisii labaad
items.summary: Xulka Ecuador ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Monumental ee Guayaquil 2-0 kaga adkaaday Bolivia kulan saaxiibtinimo ah, taas oo ahayd guushii labaad ee isku xigta ee tababaraha cusub Marcelo Gallardo, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Monumental ee Guayaquil, sawir hore

items.title: Euro 2028: dheriyada isreebreebka oo la ogaaday, France iyo England oo ku jira dheriga 1
items.summary: Kaddib dhammaadka wareegga koowaad ee UEFA Nations League, waxaa la ogaaday dheriyada isreebreebka Euro 2028, iyadoo France, England, Spain iyo Germany ay ku jiraan dheriga 1, sida ay werisay RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka Magaalada Belfast, sawir hore

items.title: Endrick: "Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan noloshayda oo dhan ku qaato Real Madrid"
items.summary: Weeraryahanka reer Brazil ee Real Madrid, Endrick, ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo inuu noloshiisa oo dhan ku qaato kooxda, xilli warbaahinta Spain ay sheegayso inuu ka fikirayo inuu ka tago bisha January.
items.imageAlt: Endrick xilligii uu u ciyaarayay Palmeiras, sawir hore (2024)

items.title: Mexico oo 1-0 ku garaacday Jamaica, semi-finalka Nations League-na kula kulmi doonta Mareykanka
items.summary: Xulka Mexico ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Monterrey 1-0 kaga adkaaday Jamaica, isagoo isugeyn ahaan 3-3 ku gaaray kuna gudbay semi-finalka CONCACAF Nations League, halkaas oo uu kula kulmi doono Mareykanka.
items.imageAlt: Rafael Márquez, oo hadda tababare u ah xulka Mexico, sawir hore (2014)

items.title: Detroit Pistons oo 105-93 ku jebiyay 12-kii guulood ee isku xigay ee San Antonio Spurs
items.summary: Detroit Pistons ayaa garoonka San Antonio 105-93 kaga adkaaday Spurs, taasoo soo afjartay 12 guulood oo isku xigay oo kooxda Victor Wembanyama ay ka gaartay horyaalka NBA.
items.imageAlt: Cade Cunningham oo u ciyaaraya Detroit Pistons, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga oo ka wada hadlay mataanaynta caasimadaha Muqdisho iyo Riyaad
items.summary: Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Sacuudi Carabiya, Maxamed Amiin Sheekh Cusmaan, ayaa kulan la qaatay Duqa Magaalada Riyaad, Amiir Dr. Faysal Bin Cabdulcasiis Bin Cayaaf, iyagoo ka wada hadlay qorshe lagu mataaneynayo labada caasimadood.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta maaliyadda King Abdullah ee magaalada Riyaad, Sacuudi Carabiya

items.title: Xi Jinping iyo Putin oo Shenzhen ku kulmay maalin ka hor shir saddex geesood ah oo Trump ka qayb galayo
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping iyo madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin ayaa Arbacada wada hadal ku yeeshay magaalada Shenzhen, maalin ka hor shir aan horay u dhicin oo saddex geesood ah oo ay la yeelanayaan madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump.
items.imageAlt: Xi Jinping iyo Vladimir Putin, sawir hore (Beijing, May 2024)

items.title: Waymo oo hakisay safarrada gawaarida aan darawalka lahayn ee waddooyinka waaweyn ee Mareykanka
items.summary: Shirkadda Waymo ayaa hakisay adeegga tagsiyada aan darawalka lahayn ee waddooyinka xawaaraha sare ee dhammaan suuqyada Mareykanka, kaddib markii California ay si ku meel gaar ah uga mamnuucday waddooyinkeeda waaweyn.
items.imageAlt: Gaari Waymo ah oo aan darawal lahayn, sawir hore (San Francisco, 2025)

items.title: Cutter Gauthier oo noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horreeyay ee NHL ee hal bil gudaheed sameeya 4 hat-trick
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Anaheim Ducks, Cutter Gauthier, ayaa noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horreeyay taariikhda NHL ee sameeya 4 hat-trick hal bil oo kalandar ah, sida ay werisay The Athletic, inkastoo Ducks ay 8-6 ku lumiyeen kulankii St. Louis Blues.
items.imageAlt: Cutter Gauthier oo ku jira tababar ay Anaheim Ducks sameeyeen 2024

items.title: Cricket Australia oo madal madaxbannaan u furtay ciyaartoyda fadeexadda sandpapergate
items.summary: Cricket Australia ayaa furtay madal madaxbannaan oo ciyaartoyda iyo shaqaalihii ku lug lahaa fadeexaddii xumeynta kubbadda ee 2018, ee loo yaqaan sandpapergate, ay ku sheegi karaan sida ay wax u dhaceen.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka cricket-ka ee Newlands ee magaalada Cape Town, sawir hore

items.title: Mary Peltola oo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee Alaska, Dan Sullivan oo laga adkaaday
items.summary: Musharaxa Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Mary Peltola ayaa ka adkaatay Senator Dan Sullivan oo ka tirsan Xisbiga Jamhuuriga, iyadoo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee gobolka Alaska, kaas oo ahaa doorashadii ugu dambeysay ee Golaha Guurtida ee la go'aamiyo, sida ay saadaaliyeen warbaahinta Mareykanka.
items.imageAlt: Mary Peltola, sawir rasmi ah oo hore (2022)

items.title: Connor Bedard oo dhaawac la baxay, Blackhawks oo 6-3 ku garaacay Maple Leafs
items.summary: Xiddigga kooxda Chicago Blackhawks Connor Bedard ayaa Talaadadii dhaawac ku ah garoonka ka baxay xilli uu socday kulan ay kooxdiisu 6-3 kaga adkaatay Toronto Maple Leafs horyaalka NHL.
items.imageAlt: Connor Bedard, sawir hore (2023)

items.title: Nin Pakistani ah oo 27 sano iyo badh lagu xukumay qorshe lagu doonayay in lagu dilo siyaasiyiin Mareykan ah
items.summary: Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taal Brooklyn ayaa Talaadadii 330 bilood oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Asif Merchant, oo u dhashay Pakistan, kaddib markii lagu helay qorshe dil oo uu sheegay inuu ka dambeeyay Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran, Donald Trump-na uu ka mid ahaa bartilmaameedyada.
items.imageAlt: Maxkamadda federaalka ee Brooklyn, New York, sawir hore

items.title: Stojakovic oo 46 dhibcood dhaliyay, Illinois oo 99-78 ku garaacday Duke
items.summary: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee Illinois, oo kaalinta 10-aad ah, ayaa Talaadadii 99-78 kaga adkaatay Duke oo kaalinta 5-aad ah garoonkeeda Cameron Indoor Stadium, iyadoo Andrej Stojakovic uu dhaliyay 46 dhibcood.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Cameron Indoor Stadium ee Duke, sawir hore

items.title: Mareykanka oo 2-0 ku garaacay Haiti kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee Pochettino
items.summary: Xulka Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Cincinnati 2-0 kaga adkaaday Haiti, isagoo isugeyn ahaan 8-0 ugu gudbay semi-finalka CONCACAF Nations League, kulankaas oo ahaa kii ugu dambeeyay ee tababare Mauricio Pochettino.
items.imageAlt: Christian Pulisic oo u ciyaaraya xulka Mareykanka, sawir hore (March 2026)

items.title: Nin Irish ah oo New York lagu soo oogay burburinta diyaarad milatari oo Mareykan ah garoonka Shannon
items.summary: Golaha garsoorka ee magaalada New York ayaa dacwad ku soo oogay Daithi O'Corrain, oo 48 jir ah kana soo jeeda Ireland, kaddib markii xeer-ilaalinta Mareykanku ay ku eedeysay inuu faas ku burburiyay diyaarad milatari oo C-130 ah oo la dhigay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Shannon.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka diyaaradaha ee Shannon, Ireland, sawir hore

items.title: Nin 25 jir ah oo lagu soo oogay isku day dil kadib weerarkii darawalka Soomaaliga ah ee Minnesota
items.summary: Xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta degmada Hennepin ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa Talaadadii eedeymo isku day dil iyo afduub gaari ku soo oogay Samit Apurva Patel, oo 25 jir ah, kaddib weerar loo geystay Maxamed Yuusuf, darawal Uber oo Soomaali-Maraykan ah.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta dowladda degmada Hennepin ee Minneapolis, sawir hore

items.title: Uruguay oo 5-0 ku garaacday Jamhuuriyadda Dominican, Valverde oo gool qurux badan dhaliyay
items.summary: Xulka Uruguay ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Maldonado 5-0 kaga adkaaday Jamhuuriyadda Dominican ciyaar saaxiibtinimo ah, taasoo ahayd guushii labaad ee tababare Diego Forlán laba kulan gudahood.
items.imageAlt: Federico Valverde oo u ciyaaraya Uruguay, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Golaha Nabadda oo uga digay Golaha Ammaanka in xabbad-joojinta Gaza ay khatar ugu jirto burbur
items.summary: Golaha Nabadda (Board of Peace) oo Mareykanku taageero ayaa Talaadadii warbixintiisii sannadeed ee ugu horreysay u gudbiyay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo uga digay in heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta Gaza ee 2025 uu burburi karo haddii aan tallaabooyin degdeg ah la qaadin.
items.imageAlt: Burburka magaalada Rafah ee Gaza markii xabbad-joojintii hore ay dhaqan gashay, sawir hore (January 2025)

items.title: Argentina oo 7-0 ku burburisay Costa Rica, guushii ugu horreysay kaddib fariisashada Messi
items.summary: Xulka Argentina ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Mario Alberto Kempes ee magaalada Córdoba 7-0 kaga adkaaday Costa Rica ciyaar saaxiibtinimo ah, iyadoo Nico Paz, Julián Álvarez iyo Franco Mastantuono ay mid kasta laba gool dhaliyeen.
items.imageAlt: Nico Paz oo u ciyaaraya Argentina, sawir hore (July 2026)

items.title: Houston Dash oo Seb Hines u magacaawday tababaraha cusub
items.summary: Kooxda kubadda cagta haweenka ee Houston Dash, oo ka ciyaarta horyaalka NWSL ee Mareykanka, ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday inay tababare cusub u magacawday Seb Hines, oo hore Orlando Pride ugu hoggaamiyay laba koob sannadkii 2024.
items.imageAlt: Seb Hines xilligii uu ciyaaryahan ahaa, sawir hore (2017)

items.title: Kuwait oo sheegtay weerarro drone ah, xiisadda Iran iyo Mareykanka oo sii kordhaysa
items.summary: Ciidamada Kuwait ayaa Talaadadii habeennimo sheegay in difaaca hawadu uu ka jawaabayo weerarro drone ah, saacado kaddib markii Mareykanku uu weeraray goob gantaallo oo ku taalla jasiiradda Qeshm ee Iran, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Jasiiradda Qeshm oo laga sawiray hawada sare, sawir hore NASA

items.title: Humphries iyo Van Gerwen oo u gudbay wareegga 16-ka ee Grand Slam of Darts
items.summary: Luke Humphries iyo Michael van Gerwen ayaa Talaadadii u gudbay wareegga 16-ka ciyaaryahan ee tartanka Grand Slam of Darts, kaddib guulo ay ka gaareen kulamadoodii ugu dambeeyay ee wareegga kooxaha.
items.imageAlt: Luke Humphries, sawir hore (2024)

items.title: Northern Ireland oo markii ugu horreysay u dallacday League A ee Nations League
items.summary: Northern Ireland ayaa Talaadadii Budapest 1-1 la gashay Hungary, iyadoo Justin Devenny uu dhaliyay gool qurux badan oo ka dhigay kooxda koowaad ee kooxda B2, kuna dallaciyay heerka ugu sarreeya ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Justin Devenny, sawir hore

items.title: Websaydhka Xiriirka Caalamiga ah ee Xeegada Barafka oo la jabsaday kaddib mamnuucidda Ruushka
items.summary: Xiriirka Caalamiga ah ee Xeegada Barafka (IIHF) ayaa sheegay in websaydhkiisa Talaadadii lagu qaaday weerar internet, kaas oo u muuqday mid looga jawaabayo go'aankii Ruushka looga reebay Horyaalka Adduunka ee Dhallinyarada 2026-27.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta IIHF ee magaalada Zurich, Switzerland, sawir hore

items.title: Olimpia Milano oo 91-77 ku garaacday Crvena Zvezda, soo afjartay sagaal guuldarro oo isku xiga
items.summary: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee Olimpia Milano ayaa Talaadadii wareegga 12-aad ee EuroLeague 91-77 kaga adkaatay Crvena Zvezda ee Serbia, taasoo soo afjartay sagaal guuldarro oo ay Yurub isku xigxiga kala kulantay.
items.imageAlt: Leandro Bolmaro oo u ciyaaraya Olimpia Milano, sawir hore (March 2026)

items.title: Josh Hokit oo dalbaday ciyaar celis ah, Gane oo kor ugu kacay liisaska pound-for-pound
items.summary: Feeryahanka Mareykanka Josh Hokit ayaa Talaadadii dalbaday in mar kale lala ciyaarsiiyo Ciryl Gane, isagoo sheegay in farta Gane ay ishiisa gashay bilowgii dagaalkii UFC 334, halka Gane uu kor ugu kacay liisaska pound-for-pound, sida ay werisay CBS Sports iyo RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Ciryl Gane, sawir hore

items.title: Norway oo 3-2 kaga soo laabatay Denmark, Haaland oo u gudbiyay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka
items.summary: Norway ayaa Talaadadii Copenhagen 3-2 kaga adkaatay Denmark kaddib markii ay 2-0 ka dambeysay, iyadoo Erling Haaland uu rigoore waqtiga dheeraadka ah ku dhaliyay goolka u gudbiyay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Erling Haaland oo xiran funaanadda Norway, sawir hore

items.title: Bosnia oo 2-1 kaga soo laabatay Romania, Sweden oo 1-1 la gashay Poland
items.summary: Bosnia iyo Herzegovina ayaa Talaadadii 2-1 kaga adkaatay Romania, halka Sweden ay 1-1 la gashay Poland, labadaas kulan oo ahaa kuwii ugu dambeeyay ee kooxda B4 ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Benjamin Tahirović, sawir hore

items.title: Nations League: 8-da xul ee u gudbay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka oo la ogaaday
items.summary: Wareegga siddeed dhammaadka ee UEFA Nations League 2026/27 ayaa dhammaystirmay Talaadadii, kaddib markii Norway ay noqotay xulkii ugu dambeeyay ee u gudba, iyadoo ku biirtay Belgium, England, France, Germany, Netherlands, Portugal iyo Spain.
items.imageAlt: Koobka UEFA Nations League oo lagu soo bandhigay matxaf, sawir hore

items.title: Nvidia oo soo bandhigtay natiijooyin xooggan, guddiguna ma soo celinayo Jensen Huang
items.summary: Shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Talaadadii soo bandhigtay natiijooyin maaliyadeed oo ka sarreeya filashada suuqa, iyadoo sheegtay inaysan dib u magacaabayn maamulihii hore Jensen Huang, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Endeavor ee Nvidia ee Santa Clara, sawir hore

items.title: Parrott oo laba rigoore dhaliyay, Ireland oo 3-0 ku garaacday Kosovo
items.summary: Jamhuuriyadda Ireland ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Aviva ee Dublin 3-0 kaga adkaatay Kosovo oo 10 ciyaaryahan ku dhammaysatay kulanka, iyadoo Troy Parrott uu dhaliyay laba rigoore, taasoo u gudbisay ciyaaraha play-off-ka ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Aviva ee Dublin, sawir hore

items.title: Portugal oo 3-2 kaga adkaatay Wales, Carlos Forbs oo dhaliyay goolka guusha
items.summary: Xulka Portugal ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Cardiff 3-2 kaga adkaaday Wales kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee wareegga kooxaha ee UEFA Nations League, iyadoo Carlos Forbs, oo ciyaarta ku soo galay beddel, uu dhaliyay goolka guusha.
items.imageAlt: Carlos Forbs, sawir hore

items.title: Mali oo 2-0 ku garaacday Rwanda, 6 xul oo u gudbay AFCON 2027
items.summary: Mali ayaa Talaadadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay Rwanda, halka Burkina Faso ay 3-1 ku garaacday Mauritania, labaduba waxay xaqiijiyeen kaalintooda Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027, sida ay werisay L'Équipe.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka 26 Mars ee Bamako, sawir hore

items.title: Matan Kahana oo loo doortay guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Israa'iil
items.summary: Baarlamaanka Israa'iil ee Knesset-ka ayaa Talaadadii guddoomiye u doortay Matan Kahana, oo xulafo la ah Gadi Eisenkot, isagoo helay 66 cod oo ka mid ah 120-ka xubnood, taasoo wiiqaysa awoodda Ra'iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera iyo CNN.
items.imageAlt: Matan Kahana, sawir hore

items.title: Xulka Kenya ee U-23 oo laga reebay isreebreebka AFCON kaddib 2-0 ay Abidjan kaga badisay Ivory Coast
items.summary: Xulka Kenya ee ka yar 23 sano ayaa Talaadadii laga reebay isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika ee U-23, kaddib markii Ivory Coast ay magaalada Abidjan kaga badisay 2-0, wadartana ku guuleysatay 3-2.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Félix Houphouët-Boigny ee Abidjan, sawir hore

items.title: David Bednar iyo Ryan Jeffers oo aqbalay dalabka $23.15 milyan, lix ciyaaryahan oo kale diideen
items.summary: Laba ciyaaryahan oo baseball-ka MLB ah, David Bednar (New York Yankees) iyo Ryan Jeffers (Minnesota Twins), ayaa aqbalay dalabka hal sano ah ee loo yaqaan qualifying offer, oo dhan $23.15 milyan.
items.imageAlt: Ryan Jeffers, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: Ralph Brand, mid ka mid ah goolhayeyaasha ugu waaweyn taariikhda Rangers, oo ku geeriyooday 89 jir
items.summary: Kooxda Rangers ee Scotland ayaa tacsi u dirtay Ralph Brand, weeraryahankii hore ee kooxda iyo xulka Scotland, oo ku geeriyooday da’da 89 sano, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Ibrox ee Rangers, sawir hore

items.title: Mareykanka oo duqeeyay jasiiradda Qeshm ee Iran kadib markii miinooyin ay ku dhaceen shan markab oo Hormuz mara
items.summary: Diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii fiidkii duqeeyay goobaha gantaallada laga rido ee jasiiradda Qeshm ee koonfurta Iran, kadib markii ugu yaraan shan markab ay ku dhaceen miinooyin badeed oo ku yaal Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo Iran ay isla maalintaas weerar ku qaadday xarun Mareykan oo ku taal Bahrain.
items.imageAlt: Jasiiradda Qeshm ee Khaliijka Faaris, sawir hore

items.title: Žalgiris oo waqti dheeraad ah 117-114 kaga adkaatay Bayern Munich, Carsen Edwards oo 32 dhibcood dhaliyay
items.summary: Kooxda kubbadda koleyga ee Žalgiris Kaunas ayaa Talaadadii kulan EuroLeague ah oo gaaray waqti dheeraad ah 117-114 kaga adkaatay FC Bayern Munich, iyadoo ciyaaryahankii hore ee Bayern, Carsen Edwards, uu go'aamiyay kulanka.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Žalgirio Arena ee Kaunas, sawir hore

items.title: Libya iyo Tunisia oo 1-1 ku kala baxay, ciyaartoyda Tunisia oo garoonka uga baxay mudaharaad rigoore
items.summary: Kulanka isreebreebka AFCON 2027 ee Libya iyo Tunisia oo Talaadadii lagu ciyaaray Tripoli ayaa ku dhammaaday 1-1, kadib markii ciyaartoyda Tunisia ay dhowr daqiiqo garoonka uga baxeen iyagoo ka cabanaya rigoore muran dhaliyay oo la siiyay Libya.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaartoyda xulka Tunisia oo diyaargarow sameynaya, sawir hore

items.title: Nasser Al-Khelaïfi oo garsoorayaasha u sheegay inuusan waxba ka ogeyn "ciidanka dijitaalka" ee PSG
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Paris Saint-Germain, Nasser Al-Khelaïfi, ayaa bishii September laba garsoore oo baaritaan ay dhegeysteen isagoo ah markhaati la caawiyo, wuxuuna sheegay inuusan waxba ka ogeyn akoonnada baraha bulshada ee loo yaqaan "ciidanka dijitaalka" ee naadiga, sida ay wariyeen AFP iyo L'Équipe.
items.imageAlt: Nasser Al-Khelaïfi, sawir hore

items.title: Ukraine oo sheegtay inay burburisay qeyb ka mid ah buundada Kerch ee Ruushka ku xirta Crimea
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in diyaarado drone ah iyo gantaallo Ukraine ah ay garaaceen buundada Kerch ee isku xirta Ruushka iyo jasiiradda Crimea ee la haysto, isagoo howlgalka ku tilmaamay mid aan horay loo arag.
items.imageAlt: Buundada Kerch ee isku xirta Ruushka iyo Crimea, sawir hore (2021)

items.title: JJ Gabriel oo xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagay Manchester United, Real Madrid oo u dhow saxiixiisa
items.summary: Weeraryahanka 16 jirka ah ee JJ Gabriel ayaa Talaadadii muuqaal sagootin ah ku xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagay Manchester United, iyadoo la sheegayo inuu heshiis afka ah la gaaray Real Madrid.
items.imageAlt: JJ Gabriel oo kursiga Manchester United ku jira kulan diyaargarow ah, sawir hore (2026)

items.title: NFL oo kulanka Raiders iyo Browns u wareejisay Sunday Night Football
items.summary: Horyaalka NFL ayaa go'aansaday in kulanka Las Vegas Raiders iyo Cleveland Browns ee toddobaadka 12 loo wareejiyo barnaamijka habeenkii Axadda ee Sunday Night Football, halka kulanka New England Patriots iyo Los Angeles Chargers laga saaray waqtigaas, sida ay werisay CBS Sports iyo The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Cleveland Browns, sawir hore

items.title: Ivory Coast oo gool daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay ah ku heshay barbardhac 2-2 ah oo ay la gashay Gambia
items.summary: Xulka Ivory Coast ayaa Talaadadii waqtigii lagu daray gool ku helay, wuxuuna barbardhac 2-2 ah la galay Gambia kulan isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027 ah, natiijadaas oo ku dhowaad u xaqiijisay kaalintiisa tartanka.
items.imageAlt: Yankuba Minteh, sawir hore

items.title: Xulka U21 ee Jarmalka oo 3-2 looga adkaaday Croatia, roob iyo ceeryaamo culus dhexdooda
items.summary: Xulka da'da ka yar 21 sano ee Jarmalka ayaa Talaadadii 3-2 looga adkaaday Croatia kulan saaxiibtinimo oo lagu ciyaaray roob culus iyo ceeryaamo cufan, taas oo ah guuldarradiisii labaad oo isku xigta.
items.imageAlt: Tababare Antonio Di Salvo, sawir hore (2021)

items.title: Ademola Lookman oo jilibka ka dhaawacmay, Atlético Madrid oo laga yaabo inay waayaan ilaa dhammaadka 2026
items.summary: Baaritaanno caafimaad oo Atlético Madrid ku sameysay magaalada Madrid ayaa muujiyay in weeraryahanka Nigeria Ademola Lookman uu jilibka ka qabo dhaawac xiriiq oo heer sare ah, taas oo laga yaabo inay ka saarto kulamada inta ka harsan 2026.
items.imageAlt: Ademola Lookman, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: Zverev oo 6-2, 7-6 ku garaacay Shelton, kuna gudbay semi-finalka ATP Finals
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka ee Jarmalka Alexander Zverev ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Turin 6-2, 7-6 kaga adkaaday Ben Shelton oo u dhashay Mareykanka, wuxuuna xaqiijiyay inuu u gudbo semi-finalka tartanka ATP Finals.
items.imageAlt: Alexander Zverev oo ku sugan tartanka Miami Open 2026

items.title: Moise Kean oo dhaawac cusub ku qabsaday tababarka, Como oo sheegtay inuu baaritaanno dheeraad ah marayo
items.summary: Naadiga Como ayaa Talaadadii war rasmi ah ku sheegay in weeraryahanka Talyaaniga Moise Kean uu dhibaato ku qabsaday tababarka, isla markaana uu marayo baaritaanno caafimaad oo dheeraad ah, taas oo dib u dhigaysa soo laabashadiisa.
items.imageAlt: Moise Kean, sawir hore (2015)

items.title: Harambee Stars oo garoonka Nyayo 2-1 looga adkaaday, Mofokeng oo Bafana Bafana u dhaliyay labada gool
items.summary: Xulka Koonfur Afrika, Bafana Bafana, ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Nyayo ee Nairobi 2-1 kaga adkaaday xulka Kenya, Harambee Stars, kulan ka tirsan isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027, wuxuuna hoggaanka u qabsaday Kooxda D.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Nyayo ee Nairobi, sawir hore

items.title: Piero Hincapie oo Arsenal la saxiixday heshiis cusub oo socda ilaa 2032
items.summary: Daafaca reer Ecuador, Piero Hincapie, ayaa Arsenal la saxiixday heshiis cusub oo shuruudo ka wanaagsan leh, kaas oo muddadiisa sii dheereynaya 12 bilood ilaa 2032, sida ay werisay The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: Piero Hincapie xilligii uu joogay Bayer Leverkusen, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Togo oo 3-0 ku jebisay Aljeeriya, Thibault Klidje oo laba gool dhaliyay
items.summary: Xulka Togo ayaa Talaadadii 3-0 kaga adkaaday Aljeeriya kulan ka tirsan isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027 ee Kooxda I, iyadoo dhammaan saddexda gool la dhaliyay qeybtii hore.
items.imageAlt: Xulka qaranka Togo, sawir hore (2015)

items.title: Kabtanka Houston Texans Azeez Al-Shaair oo la geliyay liiska dhaawacyada, qalliin ayaa sugaya
items.summary: Kooxda Houston Texans ee horyaalka NFL ayaa kabtankeeda iyo ciyaaryahankeeda difaaca Azeez Al-Shaair gelisay liiska dhaawacyada (injured reserve), kaddib dhaawac uu ka soo gaaray gumaarka oo u baahan qalliin.
items.imageAlt: Azeez Al-Shaair iyo tababaraha Bill Davis xerada tababarka Texans, sawir hore (2026)

items.title: Peter Storey, xiddigii Arsenal ee koobabka labada ah ku guuleystay 1971, oo ku geeriyooday 81 jir
items.summary: Kubbad-yaqaankii hore ee Arsenal iyo xulka England, Peter Storey, ayaa ku geeriyooday da'da 81 jir, sida uu Talaadadii shaaciyay naadiga Arsenal.
items.imageAlt: Peter Storey (Arsenal) iyo Johan Cruyff, sawir hore oo 1970 laga qaaday Amsterdam

items.title: War culus: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo si aan horay loo arag u weeraray Imaaraadka Carabta – “Faragelintiisa waa khatar ku soo wajahan qarannimada Soomaaliya”
items.summary: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad uu caawa u jeediyay shacabka ku eedeeyay Imaaraadka Carabta inuu faragelin toos ah ku hayo arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu wiiqayo midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad ka jeedinaya madal

items.title: Tababarihii hore ee Betis Pepe Mel oo ka soo baxay qaybta daryeelka degdegga ah ee isbitaalka
items.summary: Tababarihii hore ee Real Betis, Pepe Mel, ayaa ka soo baxay qaybta daryeelka degdegga ah ee Isbitaalka Virgen del Rocío ee Sevilla, kaddib istaroog uu ku dhacay 1 November, sida ay wariyeen Cadena SER iyo Mundo Deportivo.
items.imageAlt: Pepe Mel, sawir hore oo 2011 ah

items.title: Philippe Diallo oo Paris ka furay ololihiisa doorashada madaxtinimada FIFA ee ka dhanka ah Infantino
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, ayaa Talaadadii Paris ka furay ololihiisa madaxtinimada FIFA, kaddib markii guddiga fulinta ee FFF uu ansixiyay musharaxnimadiisa.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Faransiiska (FFF) ee Paris, sawir hore

items.title: Jerry Jones: Cowboys waxay ka wada hadlayaan beddelka isku-duwaha difaaca
items.summary: Milkiilaha Dallas Cowboys Jerry Jones ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in kooxdu ay ka wada hadlayso isbeddel ku saabsan isku-duwaha difaaca Christian Parker, kaddib markii difaaca Cowboys uu u oggolaaday 584 yaard kulankii ay 46-40 ugu guuldarreysteen San Francisco 49ers, sida ay werisay CBS Sports.
items.imageAlt: Jerry Jones, milkiilaha Dallas Cowboys, sawir hore

items.title: Ciidanka Uganda oo baarlamaanka ka codsaday 1.9 trillion oo shilin si mushaarka askarta loo labalaabo
items.summary: Wasaaradda Difaaca Uganda ayaa baarlamaanka u sheegtay in ciidanka UPDF ay u baahan yihiin 1.9 trillion oo shilin Uganda ah si mushaarka dhammaan askarta loogu kordhiyo 100 boqolkiiba.
items.imageAlt: Askar Uganda ah oo ku sugan bandhig milatari, sawir hore oo 2009 ah

items.title: LeBron James oo beeniyay warbixin ESPN oo sheegtay inuu 76ers ka codsaday dulqaad
items.summary: LeBron James ayaa beeniyay warbixin uu daabacay wariyaha ESPN Dave McMenamin oo sheegtay inuu Philadelphia 76ers ka codsaday dulqaad, xilli dhibcihiisu ay yihiin kuwii ugu hooseeyay noloshiisa ciyaareed.
items.imageAlt: LeBron James, sawir hore oo 2016 laga qaaday Philadelphia

items.title: Madaxweyne Deni oo xarunta taliska 54-aad kula kulmay saraakiisha ciidanka Daraawiishta
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa booqday xarunta taliska 54-aad, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay taliyaha ciidanka Daraawiishta iyo saraakiil kale, si looga wada hadlo amniga iyo la dagaalanka argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo Garoowe jooga, sawir hore oo 2021 ah

items.title: Arthur Fils oo Rafael Jodar ku garaacay, helayna guushiisii ugu horreysay ee ATP Finals
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka reer Faransiis, Arthur Fils, ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Turin 4-6, 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaaday Rafael Jodar, isagoo noqday reer Faransiiskii ugu horreeyay ee ATP Finals guul ka gaara tan iyo 2011.
items.imageAlt: Arthur Fils, sawir hore oo 2024 laga qaaday Cincinnati

items.title: De Bruyne oo Allegri siiyay laba maalmood oo nasasho ah, Arbacada ayuu ku soo laabanayaa Napoli
items.summary: Kevin De Bruyne ayaa Arbacada, 18 November, ku soo laabanaya xarunta tababarka Napoli ee Castel Volturno, kaddib laba maalmood oo nasasho ah oo uu la ogolaaday tababare Massimiliano Allegri.
items.imageAlt: Kevin De Bruyne oo u ciyaaraya Manchester City, sawir hore oo 2021 ah

items.title: Dustin May oo la sheegay inuu White Sox la galay heshiis saddex sano ah oo $52.5 milyan ah
items.summary: Tuuraha baseball-ka Dustin May ayaa la sheegay inuu Chicago White Sox la gaaray heshiis saddex sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay $52.5 milyan, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo CBS Sports; naadigu weli si rasmi ah uma uusan shaacin.
items.imageAlt: Dustin May oo u ciyaaraya St. Louis Cardinals, 2026

items.title: Senegal oo noqotay xulkii ugu horreeyay ee u gudba Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027
items.summary: Senegal ayaa noqotay xulkii ugu horreeyay ee kaalin ka hela Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027, kaddib markii Mozambique ay 1-0 kaga adkaatay Itoobiya.
items.imageAlt: Patrick Vieira, tababaraha Senegal, sawir hore oo 2016 ah

items.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Spain oo diiday racfaankii LaLiga, Real Madrid oo ku guuleystay kiiska CVC
items.summary: Maxkamadda Sare ee Spain ayaa diiday racfaan ay LaLiga ka qaadatay xukun buriyay go'aankii 2021 ee lagu ansixiyay heshiiska maalgashiga CVC, sida uu Real Madrid ku sheegay war rasmi ah.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Spain, Madrid

items.title: Diyaarad milatari oo Ruush ah oo nooca An-12 ah oo ku burburtay gobolka Kemerovo ee Siberia
items.summary: Diyaarad xamuul oo milatari oo Ruush ah, oo nooca Antonov An-12 ah, ayaa Talaadadii ku burburtay meel u dhow tuulada Yagunovo ee gobolka Kemerovo ee Siberia, iyadoo warbaahinta Ruushku ay sheegayso in dhammaan dadkii saarnaa, ilaa 17 qof, ay dhinteen.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad nooca Antonov An-12 ah, sawir hore oo aan ahayn diyaaradda shilka

items.title: Antoine Griezmann oo loo doortay ciyaaryahanka cusub ee ugu fiican MLS 2026
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Orlando City, Antoine Griezmann, ayaa Talaadadii si rasmi ah loogu dhawaaqay ciyaaryahanka cusub ee sannadka 2026 ee horyaalka MLS, isagoo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee reer Faransiis ah ee abaalmarintan hela.
items.imageAlt: Antoine Griezmann oo u ciyaaraya Orlando City, 2026

items.title: Japan oo 1-2 ku lumisay Paraguay kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee tababare Hajime Moriyasu
items.summary: Xulka Japan ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Singapore 1-2 uga dhashay Paraguay kulan saaxiibtinimo ah, kaas oo ahaa kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee tababaraha muddada dheer xulka hayay, Hajime Moriyasu.
items.imageAlt: Hajime Moriyasu oo garoonka dhinaciisa taagan, sawir hore (Columbus, September 2025)

items.title: Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta England oo codsaday inuu martigeliyo finalka Nations League ee June
items.summary: Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta England (FA) ayaa UEFA u gudbiyay danaynta uu u qabo martigelinta finalka afarta kooxood ee Nations League, kaas oo dhici doona 9 ilaa 13 June 2027, iyadoo Spain iyo Faransiiska ay sidoo kale codsaday.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Wembley ee London, sawir hore

items.title: Lautaro Martínez oo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo dhaawiciisa la tababartay kooxda Inter
items.summary: Kabtanka Inter, Lautaro Martínez, ayaa Talaadadii Appiano Gentile ku soo laabtay tababarka kooxda, kaddib dhaawac muruqa bowdada ah oo ka hor istaagay toddoba kulan.
items.imageAlt: Lautaro Martínez, sawir hore oo 2017 ah

items.title: NISA oo sheegtay inay Moqokori ku dishay horjooge ka tirsan qaybta maaliyadda Al-Shabaab
items.summary: Hay'adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in laba howlgal oo ay ka fulisay degmada Moqokori ee gobolka Hiiraan lagu dilay horjooge u qaabilsanaa maaliyadda Al-Shabaab, laguna dhaawacay 3 kale.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Beledweyne, caasimadda gobolka Hiiraan, sawir hore oo 2013 ah

items.title: Taifa Stars oo Zanzibar 0-0 kula siman Nigeria isreebreebka AFCON 2027
items.summary: Xulka Tanzania, Taifa Stars, ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Amaan ee Zanzibar barbardhac 0-0 ah kula galay xulka Nigeria, kulan ka tirsan Kooxda L ee isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Amaan ee Zanzibar oo sare laga arkayo, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo Philip Mpango u magacaabay guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Beeraha ee Sokoine
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa Madaxweyne ku-xigeenkii hore Dr Philip Mpango u magacaabay Chancellor-ka (guddoomiyaha sare) ee Jaamacadda Beeraha ee Sokoine (SUA), taasoo qayb ka ah magacaabisyo dhowr ah oo maanta lagu dhawaaqay.
items.imageAlt: Dr Philip Mpango, Madaxweyne ku-xigeenkii hore ee Tanzania, sawir hore (2023)

items.title: Robinho Junior oo laba gool u dhaliyay Brazil U20 oo Peru ku garaacday 9-0
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka Genoa Robinho Junior, oo ah wiilka weeraryahankii hore ee Brazil Robinho, ayaa laba gool dhaliyay kulan saaxiibtinimo oo xulka Brazil ee da'da ka yar 20 jirka uu Peru kaga adkaaday 9-0.
items.imageAlt: Robinho Junior oo waraysi siinaya kadib kulan uu u ciyaaray Santos, sawir hore (2025)

items.title: Tiger Woods oo bisha soo socota dib ugu soo laabanaya tartamada golf-ka
items.summary: Tiger Woods ayaa ka qayb geli doona tartanka Hero World Challenge ee ka dhacaya Bahamas 3 ilaa 6 December, isagoo markii ugu horreysay ciyaari doona tan iyo xarigiisii bishii March.
items.imageAlt: Tiger Woods oo ciyaaraya PNC Championship 2020, sawir hore

items.title: Alexander Zverev oo wajahaya dacwad madani ah oo cusub oo ay ka gudbisay xaaskiisii hore
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Jarmalka Alexander Zverev ayaa wajahaya dacwad madani ah oo ay ka gudbisay Brenda Patea, oo ah hooyada gabadhiisa, kadib hadal uu ka sheegay kiiskii hore ee lagu eedeeyay rabshad qoys.
items.imageAlt: Alexander Zverev oo ka ciyaaraya Monte-Carlo Masters 2023, sawir hore

items.title: Daafaca Girona Mauro Furtado oo dhaawac jilibka ah awgiis xilli ciyaareedka oo dhan seegaya
items.summary: Girona ayaa xaqiijisay in daafaceeda reer Portugal, Mauro Furtado, uu jilibka bidix ka qabo dhaawac culus oo xiriqyada ah, kaas oo ka saaraya inta ka dhiman xilli ciyaareedka.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Montilivi ee Girona, sawir hore

items.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Uganda oo amartay doorasho cusub oo Ururka Qareennada ah 14 maalmood gudahood
items.summary: Maxkamadda Sare ee Uganda ayaa go'aamisay in muddada xilka ee golaha hoggaanka Ururka Qareennada Uganda (ULS), oo uu hoggaamiyo Isaac Ssemakadde, ay dhammaatay, waxayna amartay in shir guud iyo doorasho cusub la qabto 14 maalmood gudahood.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Kampala, caasimadda Uganda, sawir hore

items.title: Mike Maignan oo baaritaan kadib laga waayay dhaawac culus, Milan oo neefsatay
items.summary: Kooxda AC Milan ayaa shaacisay in baaritaanno caafimaad oo maanta lagu sameeyay goolhayaha Mike Maignan aysan muujin wax dhaawac ah oo ku yaal muruqyada gumaarka iyo bowdada gudaha.
items.imageAlt: Mike Maignan oo u ciyaaraya AC Milan, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Wayne Rooney oo sheegay inuu xilligii uu Manchester United joogay la halgamayay caafimaadka maskaxda
items.summary: Kabtankii hore ee xulka England Wayne Rooney ayaa barnaamij podcast ah ku sheegay in xilli uu ciyaaryahan ka ahaa Manchester United uu la kulmay dhibaatooyin culus oo xagga caafimaadka maskaxda ah, khamri cabbid iyo go'doomin.
items.imageAlt: Wayne Rooney oo u ciyaaraya Manchester United, sawir hore (2008)

items.title: Ingiriiska oo cunaqabateyn saaray 8 shirkadood oo Israa'iili ah oo dhisa degsiimooyinka Daanta Galbeed
items.summary: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa Talaadadan xayiraad hanti saartay sideed shirkadood oo dhismeed oo Israa'iili ah oo ku lug leh dhismaha degsiimooyinka Daanta Galbeed ee la haysto, iyo koox degeyaal ah oo hor istaagta gargaarka loo diro Gaza.
items.imageAlt: Ed Miliband, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Ingiriiska, sawir rasmi ah oo hore

items.title: Sevilla oo dharbaaxo cusub la kulantay: José Ángel Carmona oo lugta ka jabay
items.summary: Kooxda Sevilla ayaa Talaadadan xaqiijisay in daafaceeda José Ángel Carmona uu ka jabay lafaha tibia iyo perone ee lugta midig, kadib shil uu ku dhaawacmay tababarka.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán ee kooxda Sevilla, sawir hore

items.title: Bryson DeChambeau oo ku biiray DP World Tour kadib burburka LIV Golf
items.summary: Xiddigga golf-ka ee Mareykanka Bryson DeChambeau ayaa sannadka soo socda ku ciyaari doona DP World Tour, kadib markii LIV Golf ay ku dhawaaqday inay joojinayso hawlaheeda.
items.imageAlt: Bryson DeChambeau oo ka qayb galaya Ryder Cup 2025, sawir hore

items.title: Hashim Thaçi oo lagu xukumay 17 bilood oo dheeraad ah kadib markii lagu helay faragelin markhaatiyaal
items.summary: Maxkamad gaar ah oo ku taal The Hague ayaa madaxweynihii hore ee Kosovo Hashim Thaçi ku xukuntay 17 bilood oo xarig dheeraad ah, kadib markii lagu helay inuu isku dayay inuu saameeyo markhaatiyaasha xeer-ilaalinta iyo inuu faafiyay xog qarsoodi ah.
items.imageAlt: Hashim Thaçi oo ka qayb galay Shirka Amniga ee Munich 2019, sawir hore

items.title: Endrick iyo xaaskiisa Gabriely oo helay ilmahoodii ugu horreeyay
items.summary: Weeraryahanka reer Brazil Endrick ayaa ku dhawaaqay in xaaskiisa Gabriely ay dhashay ilmahoodii ugu horreeyay, isagoo warkan ku sheegay warbaahinta kadib kulankii Brazil iyo Singapore.
items.imageAlt: Endrick oo xiran funaanadda xulka Brazil, ka dib kulankii England, sawir hore (2024)

items.title: Kiiska Denis Bergamini: maxkamadda racfaanka oo xaqiijisay xukunka 16 sano ee gabadhii uu saaxiibka la ahaa
items.summary: Maxkamadda Racfaanka ee Catanzaro ee dalka Talyaaniga ayaa xaqiijisay xukun 16 sano oo xarig ah oo lagu riday Isabella Internò, oo ahayd saaxiibaddii hore ee ciyaaryahankii Cosenza Denis Bergamini, kaas oo dhintay 18 November 1989.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka San Vito-Marulla ee kooxda Cosenza, sawir hore

items.title: Apple oo maxkamad Faransiiska ah la horkeeni doonaa 2027 eedeymo la xiriira iPhone
items.summary: Shirkadda tignoolajiyada Mareykanka ee Apple ayaa bisha June 2027 maxkamad la horkeeni doonaa dalka Faransiiska, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay hab loo yaqaan duugoobid qorsheysan (planned obsolescence) oo saameeya dhowr nooc oo iPhone ah.
items.imageAlt: Dukaanka Apple Store Opéra ee magaalada Paris, sawir hore (2013)

items.title: Riccardo Calafiori oo magaalada Roma sharfay, kuna sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu ku laabto Roma
items.summary: Duqa magaalada Roma Roberto Gualtieri ayaa daafaca Arsenal iyo xulka Talyaaniga Riccardo Calafiori ku soo dhaweeyay xarunta Campidoglio, wuxuuna u gudoonsiiyay abaalmarin gaar ah oo loogu talagalay guulihiisa.
items.imageAlt: Riccardo Calafiori oo la jira Arsenal, Emirates Cup 2024, sawir hore

items.title: Arsenal oo wada-hadal horumarsan kula jirta Piero Hincapié oo ku saabsan heshiis cusub
items.summary: Arsenal ayaa wada-hadal horumarsan kula jirta daafaca reer Ecuador, Piero Hincapié, si loogu kordhiyo heshiiskiisa, sida ay wariyeen BBC Sport iyo Sky Sports; naadigu weli si rasmi ah uma uusan xaqiijin.
items.imageAlt: Piero Hincapié, sawir 2026 ah

items.title: Kenan Yildiz oo kubbad la tababaray markii ugu horreysay tan iyo dhaawiciisii
items.summary: Xiddigga Juventus Kenan Yildiz ayaa dib ugu soo laabtay garoonka tababarka ee Continassa isagoo kubbad la shaqeynaya, kadib ku dhowaad saddex bilood oo uu dhaawac cagta ah ku maqnaa.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta tababarka Juventus ee Continassa, magaalada Turin, sawir hore

items.title: Wissam Ben Yedder oo ku biiray Paris 13 Atlético ee Ligue 3
items.summary: Weeraryahankii hore ee AS Monaco iyo xulka Faransiiska, Wissam Ben Yedder oo 36 jir ah, ayaa heshiis la galay kooxda Paris 13 Atlético ee ka ciyaarta Ligue 3, heerka saddexaad ee kubbadda Faransiiska, sida ay werisay L'Équipe.
items.imageAlt: Wissam Ben Yedder oo u ciyaaraya AS Monaco, sawir hore (2023)

items.title: Layvin Kurzawa oo 34 jir ku joojiyay ciyaaraha kubbadda cagta
items.summary: Daafaca bidixda ee hore u ciyaari jiray Paris Saint-Germain iyo xulka Faransiiska, Layvin Kurzawa, ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubbadda cagta xirfadeed isagoo 34 jir ah.
items.imageAlt: Layvin Kurzawa oo u ciyaaraya Paris Saint-Germain, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: Faraska So You Are oo ka qeyb galay Melbourne Cup oo meydkiisa laga helay weel qashin
items.summary: Meydka faraska tartanka ee So You Are, oo dhawaan ka qeyb galay tartanka caanka ah ee Melbourne Cup ee Australia, ayaa laga helay weel qashin oo yaalla goob qashinka lagu shubo, waxaana la bilaabay baaritaan.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka tartanka fardaha ee Flemington ee Melbourne, halka uu ka dhaco Melbourne Cup, sawir hore

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga oo iskaashi ka yeelanaya la-dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa Talaadadii Muqdisho kula kulmay wafdi Sacuudi ah oo uu hoggaaminayo madaxa Xarunta Ilaalinta Fikirka iyo Ka-hortagga Xagjirnimada, Cabdullaahi bin Haadi Al-Haajiri.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre, sawir hore

items.title: Dani Ceballos oo laga shakisan yahay kulanka derby-ga ee Betis iyo Sevilla
items.summary: Khadka dhexe ee Real Betis Dani Ceballos ayaa laga shakisan yahay inuu ka qeyb galo kulanka derby-ga ee Sabtida ay kooxdu la ciyaarayso Sevilla, kadib markii uusan Talaadada la tababaran kooxda, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo iyo AS.
items.imageAlt: Dani Ceballos oo jooga xarunta tababarka Real Betis, sawir hore (2015)

items.title: Costa Rica: Wariye caan ah oo ka warbixin jiray ka ganacsiga daroogada oo la toogtay
items.summary: Wariyaha madaxa-bannaan ee Costa Rica Camilo Rodríguez, oo 50 jir ahaa, ayaa Isniintii lagu toogtay waddo weyn oo ku taalla Santo Domingo de Heredia, meel u dhow caasimadda San José.
items.imageAlt: Kaniisadda Santo Domingo de Guzmán ee magaalada Santo Domingo de Heredia, sawir hore

items.title: Wiegman oo shaacisay liiska England ee ciyaarta go'aanka ah ee Ukraine, Goodwin oo markii ugu horreysay loo yeeray
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka haweenka England, Sarina Wiegman, ayaa magacawday 25 ciyaartoy oo u diyaar ah ciyaarta isreebreebka Koobka Adduunka ee ay la ciyaarayaan Ukraine, iyadoo weeraryahanka London City Lionesses Izzy Goodwin markii ugu horreysay loo yeeray xulka.
items.imageAlt: Sarina Wiegman oo tababar wadda, sawir hore

items.title: Wasiirka Cadaaladda Soomaaliya oo digniin culus u diray mucaaradka: Ma sii adkaanayaan wada-hadalladii siyaasadeed?
items.summary: Wasiirka Cadaaladda Xasan Macallin ayaa ku eedeeyay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka inay qabiil ku gabbanayaan, wuxuuna ka digay in tallaabo laga qaadi doono kuwa siyaasadda ku adeegsanaya magaca beelaha.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Cadaaladda Soomaaliya Xasan Macallin oo ka hadlaya Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka

items.title: Markab gaas qaada oo ka quustay xeebta Bulgaria, maalin kadib markabkii Betul 8

items.imageAlt: Badda Madow iyo xeebta magaalada Byala ee Bulgaria, sawir hore

items.title: Brazil oo 7-0 ku jabisay Singapore, Vinícius oo dhaliyay saddex gool
items.summary: Xulka Brazil ee uu tababaro Carlo Ancelotti ayaa ciyaar saaxiibtinimo oo ka dhacday Singapore 7-0 ugu garaacday xulka dalkaas, iyadoo Vinícius Júnior uu dhaliyay saddex gool 12 daqiiqo gudahood.
items.imageAlt: Vinícius Júnior oo u ciyaaraya Brazil, sawir hore (Koobka Adduunka 2026)

items.title: Tony Mowbray oo xilka tababaraha Blackburn Rovers ka degay arrimo caafimaad awgood
items.summary: Tababaraha kooxda Blackburn Rovers ee horyaalka Championship-ka England, Tony Mowbray, ayaa Talaadadii sheegay inuu xilkiisa ka dhinac maraayo sababo la xiriira caafimaadkiisa.
items.imageAlt: Tony Mowbray xilligii uu tababaraha ahaa Celtic 2009, sawir hore

items.title: Shan urur oo deegaanka difaaca oo FIFA uga cabanaya Qaramada Midoobay arrimaha cimilada
