items.imageAlt: Calaamadda waddada FIFA-Strasse ee u dhow xarunta FIFA ee Zürich, sawir hore

items.title: Taageere Oviedo ah oo 11 bilood oo xabsi ah lagu xukumay cunsuriyad loo geystay Mbappé
items.summary: Maxkamadda gobolka Asturias ee Spain ayaa Talaadadii taageere kooxda Oviedo ah ku xukuntay 11 bilood oo xabsi ah, kadib markii lagu helay inuu Kylian Mbappé u geystay aflagaado cunsuriyad ah ciyaar La Liga ah oo dhacday August 2025.
items.imageAlt: Kylian Mbappé oo u ciyaaraya Real Madrid, sawir hore

items.title: Pochettino oo sheegay inuu Guardiola kula talin lahaa inuu qaato shaqada xulka Mareykanka
items.summary: Mauricio Pochettino, oo ka tagaya xulka Mareykanka si uu u noqdo tababaraha cusub ee Manchester United, ayaa sheegay inuu Pep Guardiola kula talin lahaa inuu aqbalo shaqada haddii loo soo bandhigo.
items.imageAlt: Mauricio Pochettino oo tababare u ah xulka Mareykanka, sawir hore (Maarso 2026)

items.title: Dowladda Federaalka oo joojisay duulimaadyada garoonka Buuhoodle
items.summary: Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliya ayaa ogeysiisay shirkadaha diyaaradaha in la joojiyay dhammaan duulimaadyada ka degaya ama ka ambabaxaya garoonka Buuhoodle, sida ay werisay Puntland Post.
items.imageAlt: Harada Qoob Fardood ee degmada Buuhoodle, sawir hore

items.title: Blas Ziarreta, oo muddo dheer ka shaqeeyay Lezama ee Athletic Club, oo geeriyooday isagoo 79 jir ah
items.summary: Athletic Club ee Bilbao ayaa ku dhawaaqday geerida Blas Ziarreta, oo in ka badan labaatan sano xilal kala duwan ka hayay xarunta ciyaartoyda da'da yar ee kooxda ee Lezama, isagoo 79 jir ah.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta tababarka Athletic Club ee Lezama oo hawada laga sawiray, sawir hore

items.title: Xog-ururin gaar ah: Soomaaliya 16 sano oo aan la helin lacag qaran oo kaash ah, Dollar-ka ayaa noqday lacagta ugu weyn ee lagu kala iibsado
items.summary: Xog-ururin gaar ah oo Wartabiye TV ay ku eegtay xaaladda lacagta qaranka, isticmaalka Dollar-ka iyo caqabadaha nidaamka lacag-bixinta Soomaaliya.
items.imageAlt: Lacag hore oo 1000 Shilin Soomaaliyeed ah oo uu soo saaray Bangiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, labada dhinac

items.title: Romario oo mar kale ku baaqay in Ancelotti iscasilo, kaddib guuldarradii Brazil ee Japan
items.summary: Halyeeyga kubbadda cagta Brazil, Romario, ayaa mar kale ku adkaystay in tababaraha xulka Brazil, Carlo Ancelotti, uu xilka iska casilo, isagoo ka jawaabay hadal uu Ancelotti ku sheegay inuu Romario si badan u hadlo, sida ay werisay Tuttosport.
items.imageAlt: Carlo Ancelotti oo ku sugan ciyaar uu xulka Brazil ku tababarayay Koobka Adduunka, sawir hore

items.title: David Raya iyo Arsenal oo mabda' ahaan isku af gartay heshiis cusub oo muddo dheer ah
items.summary: Goolhayaha Isbaanishka David Raya ayaa mabda' ahaan heshiis la gaaray Arsenal oo ku saabsan qandaraas cusub oo muddo dheer ah, sida ay werisay The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: David Raya oo u ciyaaraya Arsenal kulan ay la ciyaareen RC Lens, sawir hore (2023)

items.title: Fernando Alonso oo hoggaamin doona isku dayga Aston Martin ee tartanka Dakar Rally 2027
items.summary: Laba jeer horyaalka adduunka ee Formula 1, Fernando Alonso, ayaa hoggaamin doona kooxda Aston Martin ee ka qayb galaysa tartanka Dakar Rally bisha January 2027, sida ay werisay BBC Sport iyo wargeyska Isbaanishka ee AS.
items.imageAlt: Fernando Alonso oo wata baabuurka Aston Martin ee Formula 1, sawir hore

items.title: Mareykanka oo xaqiijiyay baaritaan dambiyeed lagu hayo Megaspeed ee Singapore, kiiska chips-ka Nvidia
items.summary: Wasaaradaha Ganacsiga iyo Caddaaladda ee Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii xaqiijiyay inay baaritaan dambiyeed ku wadaan shirkadda adeegyada daruuraha ee Megaspeed, oo fadhigeedu yahay Singapore, kana shakisan yihiin inay jebisay xeerarka xakameynta dhoofinta semiconductor-ka, sida ay werisay wakaaladda Anadolu.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Herbert C. Hoover ee Washington, xarunta Wasaaradda Ganacsiga Mareykanka, sawir hore

items.title: Kenya: Martha Koome oo dhaarisay 18 xubnood oo cusub, kuna baaqday diyaar-garow hore oo doorashada 2027 ah
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya, Martha Koome, ayaa Talaadadii Nairobi ku dhaarisay 18 xubnood oo ku-meel-gaar ah oo ku biiray Maxkamadda Khilaafaadka Xisbiyada Siyaasadda (PPDT), iyadoo ugu baaqday in si hore loogu diyaar garoobo doorashada guud ee 2027.
items.imageAlt: Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya Martha Koome oo khudbad jeedinaysa, sawir hore

items.title: Feeryahanka Ireland ee Lee Reeves oo ku geeriyooday 31 jir, 3 bilood kaddib dhaawac uu ku gaaray ciyaar
items.summary: Feeryahanka Irishka ah ee Lee Reeves ayaa ku geeriyooday da'da 31 sano, 3 bilood kaddib markii uu dhaawac maskaxeed ku gaaray ciyaar uu la galay Gary Cully, sida ay xaqiijisay shirkadda Queensberry ee qabanqaabisa ciyaaraha feerka.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka 3Arena ee Dublin, oo horey loogu yaqaanay The O2, sawir hore

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Laba shirkadood oo diyaaradeed oo Wau dib uga bilaabay howlahooda kaddib khilaafka canshuurta $5
items.summary: Shirkadaha diyaaradaha Kush Airlines iyo Arojet Airlines ayaa dib u bilaabay howlahooda magaalada Wau ee gobolka Western Bahr el Ghazal, kaddib markii la hakiyay amar dowlad-goboleed oo ku khasbayay inay rakaab kasta ka qaadaan canshuur $5 ah, sida uu sheegay ururka howl-wadeennada shirkadaha diyaaradaha Koonfur…
items.imageAlt: Garoonka diyaaradaha ee Wau ee Koonfur Suudaan, sawir hore

items.title: Uganda: Ganacsatada Kampala oo dukaamada xiray iyagoo ka dibadbaxaya canshuuraha iyo habka ururinta ee URA
items.summary: Ganacsiga magaalada Kampala ayaa Talaadadii, 17 November 2026, ku dhawaad istaagay kaddib markii ganacsato badan ay xireen dukaamadooda, iyagoo ka cabanaya canshuuro ay ku tilmaameen kuwo xad-dhaaf ah iyo habka ay Hay'adda Dakhliga Uganda (URA) u fuliso, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
items.imageAlt: Aagga ganacsiga ee Nakivubo ee bartamaha Kampala, sawir hore

items.title: Piqué oo dhaleeceeyay ganaaxa Owono, tababaraha Tenerife oo ka jawaabay
items.summary: Milkiilaha FC Andorra Gerard Piqué ayaa sheegay in goolhayaha Jesús Owono uusan mudnayn ganaaxa 12 kulan ee lagu riday kadib shilkii keenay geerida weeraryahanka Tenerife Jesús de Miguel, halka tababaraha Tenerife Álvaro Cervera uu ka jawaabay.
items.imageAlt: Gerard Piqué, milkiilaha FC Andorra, sawir hore (2015)

items.title: Kuuriyada Koonfureed oo adkeysay ilaalinta imtixaannada kaddib arday qirtay inuu ku khiyaameeyay AI
items.summary: Dowladda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa ku dhawaaqday in la baari doono muraayadaha indhaha ee ardayda gelaysa imtixaanka galitaanka jaamacadaha ee Suneung toddobaadkan, kaddib markii arday helay dhibcaha ugu sarreeya imtixaan qaran uu qirtay inuu ku khiyaameeyay sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI), sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Maalinta imtixaanka galitaanka jaamacadaha ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed, sawir hore

items.title: Somaliland iyo Ingiriiska oo Hargeysa kaga wada hadlay amniga iyo kordhinta taageerada maaliyadeed
items.summary: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Somaliland, Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, oo hadda ah ku-simaha madaxweynaha, ayaa Isniintii Hargeysa kula kulmay masuuliyiin ka socday Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Ingiriiska, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal hawada laga qaaday magaalada Hargeysa, sawir hore

items.title: Ilhan Omar oo gaartay guushii ugu ballaarnayd ee musharrax xisbi weyn ka gaaro Minnesota
items.summary: Xildhibaan Ilhan Omar ayaa doorashadii Aqalka Wakiillada ee bishan ku heshay 76.48 boqolkiiba codadka degmada 5-aad ee Minnesota, taasoo noqotay guushii ugu ballaarnayd ee musharrax Dimuqraadi ama Jamhuuri ah uu ka gaaro tartame xisbi weyn ka socda taariikhda gobolkaas, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Ilhan Omar oo ka hadlaysa shir dadweyne, sawir hore

items.title: Ciidamada Suudaan oo shan cutub oo cusub u diray gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah ee xuduudka la leh Itoobiya
items.summary: Ciidanka milatariga Suudaan ayaa shan cutub oo si buuxda u qalabeysan u diray gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah (Blue Nile), oo ku yaal koonfur-bari dalka xuduudna la leh Itoobiya, xilli ay dagaallo ka socdaan gobolkaas, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Damazin, xarunta gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah ee Suudaan, sawir hore oo 2019

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Saddex shaqaale gargaar oo Yei lagu afduubay oo la sii daayay kaddib $2,500 madax furasho
items.summary: Booliiska degmada Yei ee gobolka Central Equatoria ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xaqiijiyay in saddex shaqaale ah oo ka tirsan hay'ad gargaar caalami ah, oo 9 November qori caaraddiis lagu afduubay, la sii daayay kaddib markii afduubayaashu ay qaateen $2,500, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo deegaanka Yei ee Koonfur Suudaan, sawir hore

items.title: RAYE oo hoggaamisay magacaabista Grammy 2027, Beyoncé oo gaartay 100 magacaabis
items.summary: Fannaanadda reer Ingiriiska RAYE ayaa helay 11 magacaabis oo ah tirada ugu badan ee abaalmarinta Grammy 2027, halka Beyoncé ay noqotay fannaankii ugu horreeyay taariikhda Grammy ee gaara 100 magacaabis.
items.imageAlt: Fannaanadda RAYE oo ku heesaysa Kingston, sawir hore oo 2023

items.title: Madaxweynaha Mongolia Ukhnaa Khurelsukh oo iscasilay kaddib eedeymo musuqmaasuq ah oo uu beeniyay
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Mongolia, Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, ayaa Talaadadii 17 November ku dhawaaqay inuu xilka ka degayo, kaddib markii xisbiga mucaaradka uu ku eedeeyay musuqmaasuq kuna hanjabay inuu baarlamaanka xilka kaga qaadi doono, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AFP.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, sawir hore oo 2024 laga qaaday Ulaanbaatar

items.title: Xavi oo ku tilmaamay shoog guuldarradii 5-0 ee Nederland, warbaahinta Holland oo eedda saartay
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka Nederland, Xavi, ayaa guuldarradii 5-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Jarmalka ku tilmaamay shoog, iyadoo ay tahay guuldarradii ugu culus ee xulka tan iyo 1959, halka wargeysyada Holland ay isaga dusha ka saareen eedda.
items.imageAlt: Xavi Hernández, sawir hore oo 2016 laga qaaday Doha

items.title: Jules Koundé oo la filayo inuu Barcelona ugu soo laabto kulanka Villarreal kaddib dhaawac dheeraaday
items.summary: Daafaca Barcelona Jules Koundé ayaa la filayaa in dhakhaatiirta kooxdu ay u oggolaadaan inuu ciyaaro kulanka Villarreal, kaddib markii soo kabashadiisa ay in ka badan hal bil dib u dhacday, sida ay wariyeen wargeysyada AS iyo Mundo Deportivo.
items.imageAlt: Jules Koundé oo u ciyaaraya Faransiiska, sawir hore oo 2026

items.title: Hakan Fidan: Ruushku ma rabo heshiis ku meel gaar ah oo Badda Madow ah ilaa nabad joogto ah la helo
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga, Hakan Fidan, ayaa sheegay in Ruushku uusan oggolaan doonin heshiis ku meel gaar ah oo la xiriira socdaalka maraakiibta Badda Madow, ilaa laga gaaro heshiis nabadeed oo joogto ah oo lala galo Ukraine.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan, sawir hore oo 2024 laga qaaday Washington

items.title: Japan oo diyaarado dagaal u dirtay kaddib markii laba diyaaradood oo Ruush ah la sheegay inay galeen hawadeeda
items.summary: Dowladda Japan ayaa sheegtay in laba diyaaradood oo la rumeysan yahay inay Ruush yihiin ay Talaadadii subax hore ku xadgudbeen hawada dalka agagaarka jasiiradda Okinoshima, taasoo keentay in Tokyo ay diyaarado dagaal u dirto kana gudbiso Moscow cabasho.
items.imageAlt: Afhayeenka dowladda Japan Minoru Kihara, sawir hore oo 2024

items.title: Ukraine oo mar labaad 24 saacadood gudahood weerartay buundada Crimea, socodka gaadiidka oo la joojiyay
items.summary: Maamulka Ruushku ku magacaabay Crimea ayaa Talaadadii hakiyay socodka gaadiidka ee buundada Kerch, kadib weerar Ukraine habeennimo ku qaaday, iyadoo warar aan weli la xaqiijin ay sheegayaan in qayb ka mid ah waddada buundada ay badda ku dhacday.
items.imageAlt: Buundada Crimea ee Kerch (sawir hore, 2021)

items.title: Ukraine oo Ruushka ku eedeysay inuu beegsaday samatabbixinta Komyshuvakha, halkaas oo 72 qof lagu dilay
items.summary: Saraakiisha Ukraine ayaa Ruushka ku eedeeyay inuu weeraro ku qaaday howlgallada samatabbixinta iyo soo saarista meydadka ee tuulada Komyshuvakha, laba toddobaad kadib weerar laba-jeer ah oo halkaas lagu dilay ugu yaraan 72 qof, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Burbur ka muuqda tuulada Komyshuvakha ee gobolka Zaporizhzhia (sawir hore, 2025)

items.title: Jorge Linares, oo saddex jeer ahaa horyaalka adduunka ee feerka, oo ay hay'adda socdaalka Mareykanka ICE ku xirtay Texas
items.summary: Feeryahankii hore ee reer Venezuela, Jorge Linares, oo saddex jeer ku guuleystay horyaalnimada adduunka, ayaa ay xirtay hay'adda socdaalka iyo kastamka Mareykanka (ICE) gobolka Texas, sida ay xaqiijiyeen qareennadiisa.
items.imageAlt: Jorge Linares oo feer ka ciyaaraya O2 Arena ee London, sawir hore oo 2015

items.title: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika oo Tanzania u ballanqaaday $26 milyan oo loogu talagalay isbeddelka cimilada

items.imageAlt: Xarunta Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika ee Abidjan (sawir hore, 2016)

items.title: Golaha Ammaanka QM oo maanta shir gaar ah ka yeelanaya howlgalka AUSSOM iyo xaaladda Soomaaliya
items.summary: Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa la filayaa inuu maanta, 17 November, shir gaar ah oo albaabadu u xiran yihiin ka yeesho howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), xilli ay soo dhowdahay dib-u-cusboonaysiinta waqtiga howlgalka ee bisha December.
items.imageAlt: Qolka shirarka Golaha Ammaanka ee xarunta QM ee New York (sawir hore)

items.title: NBA: Magic oo Boston ku jebiyay Celtics, Heat oo 128-110 ku garaacay Rockets ka hor kulanka Giannis iyo Bucks
items.summary: Orlando Magic ayaa Boston Celtics u gaarsiisay guuldarradoodii ugu horreysay ee gurigooda xilli ciyaareedkan, halka Miami Heat ay 128-110 kaga adkaatay Houston Rockets, iyadoo Giannis Antetokounmpo uu isu diyaarinayo inuu markii ugu horreysay wajaho kooxdiisii hore ee Milwaukee Bucks.
items.imageAlt: Giannis Antetokounmpo oo xilligii uu Milwaukee Bucks u ciyaarayay, sawir hore oo 2022

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo amar ku siisay hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn inay dib isu diiwaangeliyaan
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Bini'aadannimada iyo Maareynta Masiibooyinka ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa amar ku bixisay in dhammaan hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn ee gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ay maraan hubin, dib-u-eegis shaqadooda iyo dib-u-diiwaangelin, iyadoo codsiyada la furayo 20 November.
items.imageAlt: Buundada webiga Niil ee magaalada Juba, caasimadda Koonfur Suudaan (sawir hore)

items.title: Los Angeles Chargers oo 23-20 kaga adkaaday Baltimore Ravens, guushoodii ugu horreysay xilli ciyaareedkan
items.summary: Kooxda Los Angeles Chargers ayaa Isniintii habeennimo 23-20 kaga adkaatay Baltimore Ravens garoonka M&T Bank Stadium, taasoo ah guushii ugu horreysay ee ay xilli ciyaareedkan ka gaaraan horyaalka NFL.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka M&T Bank Stadium ee Baltimore oo sare laga sawiray (sawir hore, 2022)

items.title: Tababaraha Koonfur Afrika Pitso Mosimane oo qiray in Harambee Stars ay ka yaabiyeen barbardhacii 2-2 ee Soweto
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka Koonfur Afrika, Pitso Mosimane, ayaa qiray in heerka ciyaareed ee xulka Kenya, Harambee Stars, uu la yaabay kulankii isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027 ee Jimcihii ku dhammaaday 2-2 magaalada Soweto.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Orlando ee Soweto, halkaas oo lagu ciyaaray kulanka, sawir hore oo 2024

items.title: Maraakiib shidaal oo lagu weeraray Marinka Hormuz, drone cabsi ka abuuray goob gaas oo Ciraaq ah
items.summary: Maraakiib shidaal qaada ayaa Isniintii lagu weeraray Marinka Hormuz, halka diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn ay dul martay goobta gaaska ee Khor Mor ee waqooyiga Ciraaq, xilli xiisadda u dhaxaysa Mareykanka iyo Iran ay sii socoto.
items.imageAlt: Markab shidaal oo maraya Marinka Hormuz (sawir taariikhi ah)

items.title: Mareykanka oo xeer cusub ku xiraya helitaanka fog ee Shiinaha ee chips-ka AI
items.summary: Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay xeer cusub oo looga hortagayo in horumariyeyaasha AI-da ee Shiinaha ay ka baxsadaan xakamaynta dhoofinta iyagoo si fog u adeegsanaya xarumo xog oo ku yaal dalal saddexaad, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Wasaaradda Ganacsiga Mareykanka ee Washington

items.title: Maxkamad Ireland oo xabsi daa'in ku xukuntay ninkii carruurta mindi ku weeraray Dublin 2023
items.summary: Riad Bouchaker, oo 52 jir ah, ayaa Isniintii xabsi daa'in lagu xukumay isku day dil oo uu u geystay saddex carruur ah, weerar mindi ah oo 23 November 2023 ka dhacay meel u dhow dugsi ku yaal bartamaha Dublin kuna dhaliyay rabshado iyo boob caasimadda Ireland, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Parnell Square East ee bartamaha Dublin (sawir hore)

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Mozambique Venâncio Mondlane oo maanta la horgeynayo Maxkamadda Sare
items.summary: Venâncio Mondlane, hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Mozambique, ayaa maanta oo Talaado ah Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka laga bilaabayaa dacwad lagu soo oogay kicinta argagixiso iyo ku dhiirrigelinta caasinimo madani ah, oo la xiriirta mudaaharaadyadii ka dhashay doorashadii lagu muransanaa ee 2024, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Maputo, caasimadda Mozambique, oo hawada laga sawiray (sawir hore)

items.title: Arkansas State oo shaqada ka eryday tababaraha kubadda cagta Mareykanka Butch Jones
items.summary: Jaamacadda Arkansas State ayaa shaqada ka eryday tababaraha kooxdeeda kubadda cagta Mareykanka, Butch Jones, xilli ay ka harsan yihiin laba ciyaarood oo xilli-ciyaareedka caadiga ah, sida ay werisay The Athletic, waxaana xaqiijisay CBS Sports.
items.imageAlt: Butch Jones oo loogu dhawaaqay tababaraha Arkansas State (sawir hore)

items.title: Weerarro Ruush ah oo ku dhacay laba buundo oo waaweyn oo Kyiv ah, biyaha iyo korontada oo go'ay
items.summary: Ciidamada Ruushka ayaa habeennimadii Isniinta weerarro ku qaaday laba buundo oo waaweyn oo ka gudba webiga Dnipro ee caasimadda Ukraine, Kyiv, taasoo keentay go'itaan biyo, koronto iyo kuleyl qaybo ka mid ah magaalada, sida uu sheegay duqa magaalada Vitali Klitschko.
items.imageAlt: Buundada Paton ee webiga Dnipro ee Kyiv (sawir hore)

items.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Burnham: Brexit wuu fashilmay, Ingiriisku waa inuu u soo dhowaado Midowga Yurub
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Ingiriiska Andy Burnham ayaa sheegay in ballanqaadkii Brexit uusan wax u qaban dalka, isla markaana Ingiriisku uu u baahan yahay inuu dib u habeeyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay Midowga Yurub si uu ula tacaalo go'doominta sii kordheysa ee adduunka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Andy Burnham oo khudbad ka jeedinaya shir xisbiga Labour (sawir hore)

items.title: Strasbourg oo doonaysa tababaraha Swansea Vítor Matos si uu u beddelo Hugo Oliveira

items.imageAlt: Tababaraha Vítor Matos, sawir hore

items.title: Saddex koob oo Melbourne Cup ah oo uu lahaa faraska Makybe Diva oo laga xaday Flemington, nin la xiray
items.summary: Booliiska gobolka Victoria ee Australia ayaa xiray nin 36 jir ah kaddib markii saddex koob oo Melbourne Cup ah, oo uu ku guuleystay faraska caanka ah ee Makybe Diva, laga xaday garoonka tartanka fardaha ee Flemington, balse koobabka weli lama helin.
items.imageAlt: Faraska Makybe Diva oo tababar ku jira, sawir hore oo 2005

items.title: Rassie Erasmus oo su'aal ka keenay garsoorka rugby-ga ka hor kulanka Springboks iyo Ireland
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka rugby-ga Koonfur Afrika, Rassie Erasmus, ayaa dhaleeceeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay laba-wejiilenimo xagga garsoorka iyo anshaxa, isagoo weydiiyay in garsoore arka ciyaar xun balse ka aamusa aysan taasi noqonayn wax lagu beddelo natiijada.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Aviva ee Dublin, halka Springboks iyo Ireland ay Sabtida ku kulmi doonaan

items.title: Paul Seixas: ku guuleysiga Tour de France waa riyadayda muddada dheer
items.summary: Baaskiil-wadaha Faransiiska ee 20 jirka ah Paul Seixas ayaa wargeyska Isbaanishka ee AS u sheegay in ku guuleysiga Tour de France uu yahay riyadiisa muddada dheer, halka horyaalka adduunka uu yahay rabitaankiisa ugu weyn ee sannadka 2027.

items.title: Kooxo Suudaani ah oo ka dibadbaxay in Abyei lagu daro doorashooyinka Koonfur Suudaan
items.summary: Kooxaha bulshada rayidka ah ee Suudaaniyiinta ah ee waqooyiga Abyei ayaa Isniintii dibadbax nabadeed dhigay, waxayna howlgalka nabad-ilaalinta QM ee UNISFA u gudbiyeen cabasho ay kaga soo horjeedaan qorshaha Koonfur Suudaan ee ah in deegaanka lagu daro doorashooyinkeeda soo socda, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.

items.title: Guatemala oo xoojisay howlgallada amniga kaddib xaalad degdeg ah oo 30 maalmood ah
items.summary: Wasiirrada arrimaha gudaha iyo difaaca Guatemala ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, kormeeray howlgallada amniga ee laba gobol oo xuduud la leh Honduras, maalmo kaddib markii Madaxweyne Bernardo Arévalo uu ku dhawaaqay xaalad degdeg ah oo 30 maalmood ah si loola dagaallamo rabshadaha la xiriira daroogada, sida ay werisay…
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Guatemala Bernardo Arévalo

items.title: Shirarka SEC oo dib uga gurtay khilaafka RJ Luis, LSU oo hadda xor u ah inay ku darto ciyaaryahanka
items.summary: Shirarka SEC ee kubbadda koleyga Mareykanka ayaa oggolaaday inay u hoggaansamaan amar maxkamadeed oo ku meel gaar ah, taasoo u furaysa jaamacadda LSU inay kooxdeeda kubbadda koleyga ku darto RJ Luis, oo xilli ciyaareedkii 2024-25 ahaa ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican Big East.

items.title: Nations League: Slovenia oo 3-0 ku jabisay Waqooyiga Macedonia, Giriigga oo 1-0 kaga adkaaday Serbia
items.summary: Slovenia ayaa 3-0 kaga adkaatay Waqooyiga Macedonia, waxayna hubisay kaalinta labaad ee Kooxda B1 iyo booska ciyaarta isreebreebka ee heerka A/B, halka Giriigga uu 1-0 kaga adkaaday Serbia, sida ay xaqiijisay UEFA iyo wargeyska L'Équipe.
items.imageAlt: Giorgos Masouras, oo dhaliyay goolka Giriigga, sawir hore oo 2022

items.title: Packers: Micah Parsons oo la qorsheeyay inuu xilli ciyaareedka ugu horreeyo kulanka Rams
items.summary: Tababaraha Green Bay Packers, Matt LaFleur, ayaa sheegay in qorshihiisu yahay in Micah Parsons uu kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee xilli ciyaareedkan ka ciyaaro Arbacada soo socota, marka Packers ay Los Angeles ku wajahaan Rams.
items.imageAlt: Micah Parsons oo garoonka ku jira, December 2021

items.title: California oo dacwad ka gudbisay OpenAI kaddib weerar internet oo uu qaaday moodeel AI ah oo tijaabo ahaa
items.summary: Xeer-ilaaliyaha guud ee gobolka California, Rob Bonta, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, ku dhawaaqay dacwad uu gobolku ka gudbiyay shirkadda OpenAI, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay horumarisay moodeel sirdoon macmal ah iyadoo aan haysan ilaalin ku filan, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

items.title: Declan Rice oo afka ku oggolaaday heshiis cusub oo muddo dheer ah oo uu kula sii joogayo Arsenal
items.summary: Kubbad-sameeyaha Arsenal iyo England Declan Rice ayaa afka ku oggolaaday shuruudaha heshiis cusub oo muddo dheer ah, sida ay werisay Sky Sports News, halka L'Équipe ay sheegtay in Rice iyo daafaca Jurriën Timber ay labaduba ku dhow yihiin inay kordhiyaan heshiisyadooda.
items.imageAlt: Declan Rice oo ciyaaraya, sawir hore

items.title: Tababaraha Portugal Jorge Jesus oo ka jawaabay dhaliisha hooyada Cristiano Ronaldo
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka Portugal Jorge Jesus ayaa ka jawaabay hadallo ay sheegtay Dolores Aveiro, hooyada Cristiano Ronaldo, oo ahaa in wiilkeeda uu "khiyaameeyay" tababaruhu, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Tababaraha Jorge Jesus, sawir hore

items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha Kaniisadda Kaatooligga Pope Leo XIV ayaa Isniinta soo afjaray safar 12 maalmood ah oo uu ku maray Uruguay, Argentina iyo Peru, isagoo dib u xaqiijiyay mowqifkiisa caddaaladda bulshada iyo ilaalinta deegaanka.

items.summary: Wasiirkii hore ee Gaadiidka Mareykanka Pete Buttigieg ayaa Isniinta diiday sheegashada Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee ah in isaga lagu eedeeyo joojintii guud ee duulimaadyada ka dhacday dalka Jimcihii.
items.imageAlt: Pete Buttigieg, Wasiirkii hore ee Gaadiidka Mareykanka

items.title: Philip Rivers oo si rasmi ah loogu soo bandhigay tababaraha cusub ee NC State

items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Jarmalka Alexander Zverev ayaa Isniinta magaalada Turin lagu guddoonsiiyay koobka ciyaaryahanka ku dhammeystay sannadka 2026 isagoo ah lambarka 1 ee adduunka.

items.imageAlt: Xarun ka tirsan bangiga JPMorgan Chase ee Mareykanka

items.title: Lazio oo war cusub ka bixisay dhaawacyada Frattesi, Zaccagni iyo Tavares kahor ciyaarta Lecce

items.title: UEFA oo si wadajir ah u taageertay Philippe Diallo si uu ugu tartamo Infantino doorashada madaxweynaha FIFA
items.summary: Ururka kubadda cagta Yurub ee UEFA ayaa Isniinta bayaan ku sheegay inuu si wadajir ah u taageeray madaxweynaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Faransiiska Philippe Diallo, si uu ula tartamo Gianni Infantino doorashada madaxweynaha FIFA ee bisha March.

items.title: Mucaaradka Israa'iil oo baaritaan ka dalbaday sheegashooyin ah in xafiiska Netanyahu uu faragaliyay doorashada

items.title: Shan dal oo Yurub ah oo si rasmi ah u shaaciyey qorshe ay magangalyo-doonka ugu dirayaan Rwanda

items.title: Iceland oo u dallacday heerka B ee Nations League, Faroe Islands oo gaartay ciyaaraha isreebreebka

items.imageAlt: Xulka kubadda cagta Iceland oo ciyaar ku jira garoonkiisa Reykjavík

items.title: Thomas Tuchel: Ku guuleysiga Nations League waa diyaar-garowga ugu wanaagsan ee England u leedahay Euro 2028
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka England, Thomas Tuchel, ayaa sheegay in ku guuleysiga Nations League bisha June ee soo socota ay noqon lahayd diyaar-garowga ugu fiican ee koobka Yurub 2028, kaddib markii England ay Madrid 3-2 kaga adkaatay Spain, sida ay werisay The Athletic iyo The Guardian.
items.imageAlt: Thomas Tuchel, tababaraha xulka England, oo ku sugan ciyaar Koobka Adduunka, sawir hore

items.title: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga: Sarkaal sare oo Al-Shabaab ah ayaa lagu dilay howlgal ka dhacay duleedka Xudur

items.imageAlt: Magaalada Xudur, xarunta gobolka Bakool

items.title: Rugby: Will Joseph oo shan try dhaliyay, la filayo inuu England u bilaabo ciyaarta All Blacks
items.summary: Garab-ciyaaryahanka England ee Will Joseph, oo ciyaartii Japan dhaliyay shan try, ayaa la filayaa inuu mar kale ka mid noqdo kooxda bilaabaysa ciyaarta Sabtida ee New Zealand (All Blacks) ee Nations Championship, sida ay werisay BBC Sport iyo The Guardian.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Twickenham ee magaalada London, hoyga rugby-ga England, sawir hore

items.title: Taliyaha qaybta 27-aad ee Xoogga Dalka oo ka digay kala furfurka ciidamada qaranka
items.summary: Taliyaha qaybta 27-aad ee ciidamada Xoogga Dalka, Col Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cali Cagey), ayaa 16 November sheegay in aan loo dulqaadan doonin in ciidanka qaranka la kala furfuro ama la burburiyo, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Askar ka tirsan ciidamada Xoogga Dalka oo ku sugan Beledweyne, sawir hore oo 2013

items.title: Darawal Uber oo Soomaali-Maraykan ah oo dhaawac culus ku noqday weerar ka dhacay Minnesota

items.imageAlt: Saldhigga tareenka Downtown Hopkins ee magaalada Hopkins, Minnesota (sawir hore)

items.title: Somaliland oo sheegtay inay muddo kooban xirtay shan Mareykan ah oo ay ku eedeysay khatar amni

items.title: Horyaalka ACC oo ciqaabay Louisville iyo North Carolina kadib dagaal ka dhacay dhammaadka ciyaar

items.title: Kameruun iyo Senegal oo u dhow inay u gudbaan Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027

items.title: Thomas Frank oo si rasmi ah loogu magacaabay tababaraha cusub ee Crystal Palace
items.summary: Crystal Palace ayaa Isniinta xaqiijisay in tababaraha reer Denmark Thomas Frank uu la saxiixday heshiis 2 sano iyo badh ah, isagoo bedelaya Pierre Sage oo toddobaadkii hore xilka laga qaaday.

items.title: Aidan Hutchinson oo seegi doona inta ka hartay xilli ciyaareedka kadib dhaawac uu ku gaaray dabaaldeg
items.summary: Xiddigga difaaca ee Detroit Lions, Aidan Hutchinson, ayaa seegi doona inta ka hartay xilli ciyaareedka NFL kadib markii uu seedda jilibka midig ka go'ay, dhaawacaas oo uu ku gaaray markii uu u dabaaldegayay sack kulankii Munich.

items.title: Wasaaradda Warfaafinta oo kala noqotay ruqsadda Radio Geed Fadhi
items.summary: Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa go'aan ku kala noqotay ruqsadda warbaahineed iyo shahaadada diiwaangelinta Radio Geed Fadhi, laga bilaabo 14 November 2026.
items.imageAlt: Astaanta Radio Geed Fadhi

items.title: Robert Pattinson oo loo magacaabay jilaaga cusub ee James Bond
items.summary: Shirkadda Amazon MGM ayaa Isniinta ku dhawaaqday in jilaaga Ingiriiska ah Robert Pattinson uu noqon doono jilaaga 7-aad ee ciyaara doorka basaasaha caanka ah James Bond, isagoo bedelaya Daniel Craig.
items.imageAlt: Jilaaga Robert Pattinson oo ku sugan bandhigga filimada Berlinale 2025

items.title: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Kaatooligga oo ka digay in Koonfur Suudaan lagu qasbo doorasho aan shuruudaheedu dhammeystirnayn
items.summary: Shirka Hoggaamiyeyaasha Kaniisadda Kaatooligga ee Suudaan iyo Koonfur Suudaan ayaa ka digay in dalka lagu qasbo doorasho aan shuruudaheedu dhammeystirnayn ama lagu sii hayo xilli kala guur ah oo aan dhammaad lahayn, waxayna ugu baaqeen dhinacyada wadahadal dhab ah.

items.title: Kompany oo dib ugu laabtay tababarka Bayern, Alphonso Davies oo dhaawac muruq ah la dhacay
items.summary: Tababaraha Bayern Munich Vincent Kompany ayaa Isniinta markii ugu horreysay muddo ka badan 3 toddobaad hoggaamiyay tababarka kooxda, kadib xanuun qoorgooye (meningitis) oo isbitaal la seexiyay, halka kooxdu ay xaqiijisay in Alphonso Davies uu dhaawac muruq ah la dhacay.
items.imageAlt: Tababaraha Bayern Munich Vincent Kompany

items.title: Caawiyayaasha Pochettino oo goor hore xerada Mareykanka uga ambabaxay Manchester United
items.summary: Saddex ka mid ah caawiyayaasha Mauricio Pochettino ayaa ka tagay xerada xulka Mareykanka, waxayna u ambabaxeen Manchester si ay shaqada uga bilaabaan Manchester United ka hor kulanka Liverpool, sida ay werisay The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: Mauricio Pochettino oo ah tababaraha xulka Mareykanka, kulan ay Mareykanka la ciyaareen Australia

items.title: Juventus: Celik dhaawaciisu ma culus, Zhegrova oo xulka ka soo laabtay, Kalulu oo maqnaan doona ilaa dhammaadka bisha
items.summary: Kooxda Juventus ayaa neef weyn qaadatay kadib markii baaritaanno muujiyeen in dhaawaca difaaca Zeki Celik uusan culus ahayn, balse tababare Luciano Spalletti wuxuu weli wajahayaa dhaawacyo dhowr ah kahor kulanka Venezia ee 22 November.
items.imageAlt: Zeki Celik oo u ciyaaraya Lille (sawir hore, 2019)

items.title: Emerson Palmieri oo jilibka laga qalay, Marseille oo waayi doonta dhowr toddobaad
items.summary: Difaaca bidix ee Olympique de Marseille, Emerson Palmieri, ayaa laga sameeyay qalliin jilibka bidix ah, waxaana la filayaa inuu dhowr toddobaad ka maqnaado garoonka, sida ay wariyeen RMC Sport iyo L'Équipe.
items.imageAlt: Emerson Palmieri (sawir hore, 2022)

items.title: Sacuudiga oo xilka ka qaaday taliyaha isbahaysiga Yemen, iyadoo Xuuthiyiintu u soo dhowaanayaan Cadan
items.summary: Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, xilka ka qaaday taliyaha isbahaysiga ay hoggaamiso ee la dagaallamaya Xuuthiyiinta Yemen, xilli kooxdu ay u soo dhowaanayso magaalada Cadan, sida ay werisay France 24 iyadoo xigatay warbaahinta dowladda Sacuudiga.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Cadan ee Yemen

items.title: Carlos Alcaraz oo 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaaday Frances Tiafoe kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee ATP Finals
items.summary: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, Frances Tiafoe kaga adkaaday 6-2, 6-2 saacad iyo sagaal daqiiqo gudahood, kulankiisii furitaanka ee ATP Finals, inkastoo uu jilibka midig ku xirnaa faashad, sida ay wariyeen AS iyo kicker.
items.imageAlt: Carlos Alcaraz oo ciyaaraya tartanka US Open 2026

items.title: Iran oo sheegtay inaysan u oggolaan doonin kormeerayaasha IAEA xarumaha nukliyeerka ilaa dagaalku dhammaado
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, sheegtay inay hor istaagi doonto in kormeerayaasha Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga ee Caalamka (IAEA) ay booqdaan xarumaheeda nukliyeerka ee waxyeelloobay, ilaa shuruudaha ay dhigtay ee dhammaadka dagaalka Mareykanku ka fuliyo.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta nukliyeerka ee Natanz ee dalka Iran

items.title: Mike Maignan oo baaritaanno kalsooni leh maray kadib dhaawacii xulka Faransiiska
items.summary: Goolhayaha AC Milan iyo xulka Faransiiska, Mike Maignan, ayaa Isniintii maray baaritaanno caafimaad oo natiijadoodu ay ahayd mid kalsooni leh, kadib markii laga beddelay qeybtii hore ee kulankii Faransiiska iyo Turkiga.
items.imageAlt: Mike Maignan oo u ciyaaraya AC Milan (sawir hore, 2023)

items.title: SoDMA oo shirka COP31 ka sheegtay in isbeddelka cimiladu uu sii huriyo barakaca Soomaaliya
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Soomaaliyeed (SoDMA), Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa doodda IGAD ee shirka cimilada COP31 ku baaqay maalgelin joogto ah iyo iskaashi gobol iyo caalami si bulshooyinka Soomaaliyeed loogu xoojiyo u adkeysiga abaaraha iyo fatahaadaha.
items.imageAlt: Haweeney ku nool xero barakacayaal abaaraha ka cararay oo safka ugu jirta gargaar cunto, Doolow, Soomaaliya

items.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo Muqdisho ka furay shirweynaha 3-aad ee qaran ee dabagalka iyo qiimeynta
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, Muqdisho ka furay Shirweynaha Saddexaad ee Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimeynta (SNMEC 2026), isagoo ku baaqay in waxqabadka dowladda lagu cabbiro natiijooyin la taaban karo oo xog lagu caddeyn karo.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo khudbad ka jeedinaya kulan hore oo Muqdisho ka dhacay

items.title: SoDMA oo agab aan cunto ahayn u qaybisay qoysaska barakacayaasha ah ee Baydhabo
items.summary: Hay'adda Maareynta Masiibooyinka Soomaaliyeed (SoDMA) ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, magaalada Baydhabo ee gobolka Baay ugu qaybisay qoysaska barakacayaasha ah agab aan cunto ahayn, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda ee Radio Muqdisho.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Baydhabo ee gobolka Baay

items.title: Safiirka Shiinaha: Shiinaha iyo Jabuuti waxay diidan yihiin aqoonsiga Somaliland
items.summary: Safiirka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Wang Yu, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, sheegay in Shiinaha iyo Jabuuti ay taageerayaan midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, ayna ka soo horjeedaan dadaallada Somaliland ee aqoonsiga diblomaasiyadeed, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Shiinaha, Wang Yi, oo kulan ku leh Beijing

items.title: Aragti: Xil qaran iyo dhalasho labaad – yaa difaacaya sharafta Soomaaliya?
items.summary: Qormadan aragtida ah waxay su’aal ka keenaysaa jawaabta Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, oo loo fasiran karo inuu ka gaabsaday inuu dhaliilo madaxweynaha Mareykanka, iyo masuuliyadda uu xilka qaran ku leeyahay difaaca karaamada shacabka.
items.imageAlt: Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya oo xiran koodh buluug ah iyo taay casaan ah

items.title: Vinícius Júnior oo qiray in xiisihii Arsenal ee xagaagii uu saameeyay qaabka ciyaartiisa
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Real Madrid, Vinícius Júnior, ayaa sheegay in warar kala iibsiga ee xagaagii, oo ay ugu weyneyd xiisaha Arsenal, ay maskaxdiisa ku jahwareeriyeen, taasoo qeyb ka ah bilowga liita ee xilli ciyaareedkan, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo Capital FM.
items.imageAlt: Vinícius Júnior oo u ciyaaraya Brazil kulankii Morocco ee Koobka Adduunka 2026

items.title: Madaxweynaha xiriirka Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, oo loo tixgelinayo inuu la tartamo Infantino
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, ayaa soo baxay inuu noqon karo musharax ka soo horjeeda Gianni Infantino doorashada madaxtinimada FIFA ee March, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Philippe Diallo, madaxweynaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Faransiiska

items.title: Cristian Chivu oo ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Panchina d'Oro ee tababaraha ugu fiican Serie A
items.summary: Tababaraha Inter, Cristian Chivu, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Panchina d'Oro ee xilli ciyaareedkii 2025/26, oo ay tababarayaasha Talyaanigu siiyaan saaxiibkood ugu fiican, kaddib markii uu Inter u hooyay horyaalka Serie A iyo Coppa Italia.
items.imageAlt: Cristian Chivu oo u ciyaaraya Inter kulan Champions League ah sannadkii 2011

items.title: Dowladda Turkiga oo dadaallo xooggan ka wadda xallinta khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya
items.summary: Ankara oo adkaynaysa doorkeeda dhexdhexaadinta, iyadoo xoogga saaraysa wada-hadal loo dhan yahay iyo mustaqbal siyaasadeed oo xasilloon.
items.imageAlt: Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, iyo siyaasiyiin Soomaaliyeed oo kulan ku jira

items.title: Adriano Galliani oo ka tanaasulay racfaan ka dhan ah musharaxnimada Malagò ee doorashada xiriirka kubbadda Talyaaniga
items.summary: Adriano Galliani, oo u tartamaya guddoomiyaha xiriirka kubbadda cagta Talyaaniga (FIGC), ayaa go'aansaday inuusan racfaan ka qaadan oggolaanshaha musharaxnimada Giovanni Malagò, ka hor doorashada 14 December, sida ay werisay La Gazzetta dello Sport.
items.imageAlt: Adriano Galliani, sawir hore

items.title: Romelu Lukaku oo ka fariistay xulka Belgium kadib 94 gool iyo 135 kulan
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Romelu Lukaku, oo ah gooldhaliyaha ugu badan abid ee xulka ragga Belgium, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay ciyaaraha caalamiga ah kadib 16 sano.
items.imageAlt: Romelu Lukaku oo u ciyaaraya Belgium kulankii Mareykanka ee Koobka Adduunka 2026

items.title: Shan dal oo Yurub ah oo la filayo inay ku dhawaaqaan xarun lagu celiyo muhaajiriinta oo laga dhiso Kigali
items.summary: Jarmalka, Denmark, Austria, Giriigga iyo Netherlands ayaa la filayaa inay ku dhawaaqaan in caasimadda Rwanda, Kigali, laga dhiso xarun loogu talagalay magangalyo-doonayaasha laga diiday sii joogitaanka Midowga Yurub, sida ay BBC u sheegeen ilo diblomaasiyadeed.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Kigali, caasimadda Rwanda

items.title: Puntland: Wasiirka Maaliyadda oo baarlamaanka ku qiray in shaqaalaha rayidka 6 bilood aan la mushaarin
items.summary: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Puntland, Maxamed Faarax Maxamuud, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, baarlamaanka hortiisa ku qiray in shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee dowladda aysan mushaar qaadan muddo 6 bilood ah, isagoo sidoo kale golaha u gudbiyay miisaaniyadda 2027.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Garoowe, caasimadda Puntland

items.title: Drake Maye oo dhaawac culus oo canqowga ah la kulmay, Patriots oo laga yaabo inay waayaan xilli ciyaareedka
items.summary: Quarterback-ka New England Patriots, Drake Maye, ayaa dhaawac culus oo canqowga ah ku gaaray kulankii Patriots ay Detroit Lions uga dhacday Munich, waxaana la filayaa inuu muddo dheer maqnaado, laga yaabee inta ka hartay xilli ciyaareedka.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Gillette Stadium ee kooxda New England Patriots (sawir hore, 2021)

items.title: Dino Sani, oo Brazil kula guuleystay Koobka Adduunka 1958, kuna ciyaaray AC Milan, oo ku geeriyooday 94 jir
items.summary: Dino Sani, xiddigii hore ee khadka dhexe ee xulka Brazil iyo AC Milan, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku geeriyooday magaalada São Paulo isagoo 94 jir ah, sida ay xaqiijisay xiriirka kubbadda cagta Brazil.
items.imageAlt: Dino Sani sannadkii 2008

items.title: Markab dagaal oo saddexaad oo Mareykan ah oo gaaray Bariga Dhexe, Iran oo sheegtay inay u heellan tahay diblomaasiyadda
items.summary: Markabka diyaaradaha sida ee USS Theodore Roosevelt ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, gaaray Bariga Dhexe, halka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, uu Islamabad ka sheegay in dalkiisu weli u heellan yahay diblomaasiyadda.
items.imageAlt: Markabka diyaaradaha sida ee USS Theodore Roosevelt oo badda ku jira (sawir hore)

items.title: Maxkamad Hargeysa oo xabsi ku xukuntay siyaasi sheegay inuu u tartamayo madaxweynaha Soomaaliya iyo wariyihii waraystay
items.summary: Maxkamadda Gobolka Maroodi-jeex ee Hargeysa ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, xabsi ku xukuntay siyaasiga Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Sharaay iyo wariye Cabdiraxmaan Cige, kadib waraysi uu Sharaay kaga hadlay damaciisa ah inuu u tartamo xilka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya.
items.imageAlt: Suuq ku yaalla magaalada Hargeysa

items.title: Nike oo beddeleysa Adidas, noqonaysana shirkadda kubbadaha Champions League laga bilaabo 2027
items.summary: Shirkadda Mareykanka ee Nike ayaa laga bilaabo xilli ciyaareedka 2027/28 noqon doonta bixiyaha rasmiga ah ee kubbadaha tartamada kooxaha ragga ee UEFA, iyadoo beddeleysa Adidas oo kubbadda Champions League keenaysay tan iyo 2001.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta UEFA ee magaalada Nyon, Swiiserland (sawir hore)

items.title: Shiinaha: Xi, Trump iyo Putin oo Shenzhen kaga wada hadli doona nabadda adduunka
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Shiinaha ayaa Isniinta xaqiijisay in Madaxweyne Xi Jinping, Donald Trump iyo Vladimir Putin ay Khamiista, 19 November, magaalada Shenzhen ku yeelan doonaan shirkii ugu horreeyay ee saddex-geesood ah, iyagoo ka wada hadli doona nabadda adduunka iyo xasilloonida istiraatiijiga ah.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin iyo Xi Jinping oo ku kulmay Beijing (2025)

items.title: Ciidanka Asluubta oo fashiliyay maandooriye la doonayay in la geliyo Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho
items.summary: Taliska Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed ayaa Isniinta sheegay inuu gacanta ku dhigay maandooriye la doonayay in si qarsoodi ah loo geliyo Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho, lix haween ahna lagu xiray, kaddib hawlgal laba bilood socday.
items.imageAlt: Ilaalada xabsiga oo taagan Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho (2013)

items.title: Mareykanka oo dib u cusboonaysiinaya taageerada xafiiska UNSOS iyo howlgalka AUSSOM

items.imageAlt: Xaflad Muqdisho lagu sagootiyay madaxii hore ee xafiiska UNSOS, Lisa Filipetto (2023)

items.title: Bankiga Adduunka oo ka fiirsanaya hakinta taageerada miisaaniyadda Soomaaliya
items.summary: Bankiga Adduunka ayaa ka fiirsanaya inuu hakiyo taageerada uu siiyo miisaaniyadda dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka ka dhashay muddo kororsiga madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online Isniintii, 16 November.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Kooxda Bankiga Adduunka ee Washington, D.C.

items.title: Ruushka oo sheegay inuu habeennimo riday 1,336 drone oo Ukraine ah; buundada Crimea la weeraray

items.imageAlt: Buundada Crimea ee ku taal Kerch (2021)

items.title: Warbixin gaar ah: Waxqabadka iyo hoggaaminta xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre
items.summary: Warbixin gaar ah oo ku saabsan waxqabadka xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre: dowlad-dhis, horumar, amni, diblomaasiyad iyo dowlad-wanaag.
items.imageAlt: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo ag taagan calanka Soomaaliya

items.title: Suudaan iyo Itoobiya oo isku eedeynaya taageerada kooxaha hubeysan
items.summary: Xiisadda u dhexaysa Suudaan iyo Itoobiya ayaa sii korortay, iyadoo dal waliba uu kan kale ku eedeynayo inuu taageero kooxo hubeysan oo dagaal ka wada gudaha xuduudihiisa, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.
items.imageAlt: Taliyaha ciidamada Itoobiya, Field Marshal Birhanu Jula (2019)

items.title: Kenya oo baaritaan ku billowday boob lagu qaaday xafiisyada qaxootiga ee Hagadera, Dadaab
items.summary: Dowladda Kenya ayaa ku baaqday degganaansho deegaanka Hagadera ee Dadaab, kadib markii xafiisyada Waaxda Adeegyada Qaxootiga la burburiyay oo la boobay, iyadoo ay ku eedaysan yihiin koox dhallinyaro qaxooti ah, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya.
items.imageAlt: Hoyga qaxootiga ee xerada Dadaab, waqooyiga Kenya (2011)

items.title: Ciidamada Uganda ee AUSSOM oo Xoogga Dalka ku wareejiyay shan saldhig oo ku yaalla Baraawe
items.summary: Ciidamada Uganda ee ka tirsan hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ku wareejiyay shan saldhig oo ku yaalla aagga Baraawe ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Ciidamada Uganda ee hawlgalka Midowga Afrika oo ku sugan Baraawe, gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose (2017)

items.title: Martine Moïse, carmalladii madaxweyne Jovenel Moïse, oo isu diiwaangelisay musharax madaxweyne Haiti
items.summary: Martine Moïse, oo ah carmalladii madaxweynihii hore ee Haiti Jovenel Moïse oo la dilay sannadkii 2021, ayaa isu diiwaangelisay musharax madaxweyne doorashada sannadka soo socda, sida ay werisay BBC News.
items.imageAlt: Martine Moïse oo ka qayb gelaysa kulan ka dhacay Haiti, December 2018

items.title: San Antonio Spurs iyo Wembanyama oo gaaray 12 guul oo isku xigta, kadib 110-102 ay kaga adkaadeen Utah Jazz
items.summary: San Antonio Spurs ayaa Axaddii 110-102 kaga adkaatay Utah Jazz, taasoo ah guushoodii 12-aad ee isku xigta ee NBA, iyadoo Victor Wembanyama uu dhaliyay 26 dhibcood.
items.imageAlt: Victor Wembanyama oo u ciyaaraya San Antonio Spurs (sawir hore, 2025)

items.title: 49ers oo 46-40 kaga adkaaday Cowboys, natiijo aan weligeed horay uga dhicin taariikhda NFL
items.summary: San Francisco 49ers ayaa Axaddii 15 November magaalada Dallas ku garaacay Dallas Cowboys 46-40, ciyaar 86 dhibcood leh oo natiijadeedu ay markii ugu horreysay abid ka dhacday horyaalka kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee NFL.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: garoonka AT&T Stadium ee Arlington, Texas, oo ay ku ciyaaraan Dallas Cowboys

items.title: Toronto Tempo oo ku guuleystay bakhtiyaanasiibka WNBA, waxayna heleen doorashada 1-aad ee 2027
items.summary: Kooxda cusub ee Toronto Tempo ayaa Axaddii 15 November ku guuleysatay bakhtiyaanasiibka doorashada ciyaartoyda WNBA, waxayna heshay doorashada 1-aad ee 2027, taasoo fursad u siin karta inay qaataan xiddigta USC JuJu Watkins.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: JuJu Watkins, xiddigta kubadda koleyga ee USC, oo daawanaysa ciyaar NFL ah 2025

items.title: Sarkaal ciidanka Mareykanka ah oo cabasho ka gudbiyay Pentagon-ka weerarkii Iran ee ku dilay 6 askari Kuwait
items.summary: Sarkaal ka tirsan ciidanka dhulka Mareykanka oo ka badbaaday weerar diyaarad drone ah oo Iran ku qaadday xarun Mareykan oo ku taal Kuwait, kaas oo dilay 6 askari, ayaa Congress-ka u gudbiyay cabasho uu ku sheegay in hoggaanka ciidamadu iska indha tireen walaacii laga qabay difaaca xarunta.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: dhismaha Pentagon-ka, xarunta Wasaaradda Difaaca Mareykanka, oo cirka laga qaaday

items.title: Mirra Andreeva oo finalka kaga adkaatay Svitolina, ku guuleysatayna WTA Finals
items.summary: Ciyaartoyda Ruushka ah ee Mirra Andreeva, oo 19 jir ah, ayaa Axaddii 15 November finalka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells kaga adkaatay Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine 7-5, 6-3, waxayna noqotay ciyaartoyda ugu da'da yar ee ku guuleysata tartankan muddo 22 sano ah.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: Mirra Andreeva oo ciyaareysa US Open 2023

items.title: Amiir Harry oo booqasho lama filaan ah ku tegay Lviv, dagaalyahannada dhaawacmayna ku tilmaamay tusaale
items.summary: Amiirka Ingiriiska Harry ayaa Axaddii 15 November soo gabagabeeyay booqasho aan horay loo shaacin oo uu ku tegay magaalada Lviv ee galbeedka Ukraine, halkaas oo uu ku ammaanay askarta dagaalka ku dhaawacantay, isagoo ku tilmaamay tusaalayaasha bulshada, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: Amiir Harry oo ka hadlaya furitaankii Ciyaaraha Invictus 2017

items.title: Bessent oo ku baaqay in Nvidia maamule ka keento dibadda, Musk oo taageeray soo celinta Huang
items.summary: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent ayaa Axaddii 15 November ku baaqay in guddiga Nvidia uu maamulaha cusub ka raadiyo meel ka baxsan shirkadda, xilli Elon Musk uu ku biiray in ka badan 158,000 oo qof oo saxiixay warqad dalbaneysa in Jensen Huang dib loogu celiyo xilka.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent, sawirkiisa rasmiga ah ee 2025

items.title: Klopp oo ku baaqay in hoggaanka FIFA la beddelo, kuna dhaleeceeyay Infantino
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka Jarmalka Jürgen Klopp ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku baaqay in isbeddel lagu sameeyo madaxtinimada Ururka Kubadda Cagta Adduunka (FIFA), isagoo dhaliilay guddoomiyaha Gianni Infantino, sida ay wariyeen RMC Sport, kicker iyo AS.
items.imageAlt: Jürgen Klopp, tababaraha xulka Jarmalka, sawir laga qaaday 2019

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo fuulay markab shidaal oo looga shakiyay inuu ka tirsan yahay 'raxanta qarsoon' ee Ruushka
items.summary: Ciidamada badda ee Midowga Yurub ayaa badda Mediterranean-ka ku fuulay markab shidaal oo lagu magacaabo MV MIDAG, kaas oo looga shakiyay inuu ka tirsan yahay raxanta qarsoon ee Ruushka, waxayna caddeeyeen inuu sitay calan been ah, sida ay Axaddii, 15 November, sheegtay Kaja Kallas, madaxa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda…
items.imageAlt: Kaja Kallas, madaxa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Midowga Yurub

items.title: Africa CDC: Cudurka Ebola ee Kongo weli lama xakameyn, lix bilood kadib markii lagu dhawaaqay
items.summary: Madaxa Xarunta Afrika ee Xakameynta iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada (Africa CDC), Jean Kaseya, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in faafidda Ebola ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo aan weli la xakameyn, isagoo ka digay inay noqon karto faafiddii ugu xumayd ee adduunka haddii aan hadda la joojin.
items.imageAlt: Jean Kaseya, agaasimaha guud ee Africa CDC, oo saxiixaya heshiis is-afgarad ah 2025

items.title: Xasan Sheekh: Israa'iil iyo Taiwan waxay khatar ku yihiin jiritaanka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ka sheegay Muqdisho in Israa'iil iyo Taiwan ay khatar ku yihiin jiritaanka iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay qaadayaan tallaabooyin ka dhan ah midnimada dalka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud

items.title: Yemen: Xuuthiyiinta oo u soo dhowaaday 60 km magaalada Cadan, sida ay sheegeen ilo militari
items.summary: Xoogagga Xuuthiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, u soo dhowaaday qiyaastii 60 kilomitir magaalada Cadan, oo ah caasimadda ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay, sida ay ilo militari iyo kuwo dowladeed u sheegeen wakaaladda AFP.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda iyo dhismayaal ku yaal magaalada Cadan ee koonfurta Yemen

items.title: Ronaldinho oo 46 jir ah oo 45 daqiiqo u ciyaaray Ravenna, kulankiisii ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2015
items.summary: Xiddigii hore ee Brazil Ronaldinho ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku soo laabtay garoonka isagoo 46 jir ah, wuxuuna qaybtii hore oo dhan u ciyaaray kooxda Ravenna ee horyaalka Serie C ee Talyaaniga, kulan ay 2-0 kaga adkaadeen deriskooda Forlì, sida ay wariyeen The Guardian iyo The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: Xiddigii hore ee Brazil Ronaldinho, sawir laga qaaday 2016

items.title: Estonia oo xiraysa dhammaan marinnada xuduudda Ruushka laga bilaabo 1 December
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Estonia, Margus Tsahkna, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in dalkiisu xiri doono dhammaan marinnada xuduudda Ruushka laga bilaabo 1 December, kadib isku day weerar dab-qabadsiin ah oo lala beegsaday shirkad difaac, kaas oo Tallinn ay ku eedeysay Moscow.
items.imageAlt: Xuduudda Estonia iyo Ruushka ee webiga Narva, iyadoo gadaal ka muuqato qalcadda Ivangorod

items.title: Kumanyaal qof oo Prague isugu soo baxay ka soo horjeedka qorshaha maalgelinta warbaahinta dadweynaha
items.summary: Kumanyaal kun oo qof ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, isugu soo baxay beerta Letná ee Prague, caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda Czech, si ay uga soo horjeestaan qorshe dowladeed oo beddelaya habka loo maalgeliyo warbaahinta dadweynaha, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Boodhka mudaaharaad ka dhan ah Andrej Babiš oo lagu taagay banaanbax 2019 ka dhacay beerta Letná ee Prague

items.title: Hirshabeelle oo Korneel Cabdullaahi Barre Cilmi u magacaabay guddoomiyaha gobolka Hiiraan
items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Guudlaawe), ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, Korneel Cabdullaahi Barre Cilmi u magacaabay guddoomiyaha cusub ee gobolka Hiiraan, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo ilaalo ku jooga waddo ku taal bartamaha Beledweyne, xarunta gobolka Hiiraan (sawir 2012)

items.title: Ruto oo ugu baaqay Ntutu iyo Tongoyo inay xakameeyaan taageerayaashooda kadib qalalaasihii dabaaldegga Maa
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ugu baaqay Guddoomiyaha gobolka Narok Patrick Ole Ntutu iyo xildhibaanka Narok West Gabriel Tongoyo inay xakameeyaan taageerayaashooda, kadib qalalaase ka dhacay dabaaldegga Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Maa ee Sabtidii.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal ka mid ah magaalada Narok ee Kenya

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo Sanca ku sii daayay 600 maxbuus oo la xiriira colaadda, sida ay sheegtay ICRC
items.summary: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa magaalada Sanca ku sii daysay 600 qof oo loo xiray colaadda dalka, iyadoo la raacayo cafis ay keligeed ku dhawaaqday, sida ay sheegeen Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas (ICRC) iyo saraakiil Xuuti ah.
items.imageAlt: Dhismayaal ku yaal magaalada qadiimiga ah ee Sanca, Yemen

items.title: Mareykanka oo waayay heerka dal jadeecadu ka cirib-tirantay kadib sannad faafitaan ah
items.summary: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Pan American (PAHO) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in Mareykanku waayay heerkiisa dal jadeecadu ka cirib-tirantay, kadib markii guddi khubaro ah ay go'aamiyeen in fayraska cudurkani uu dalka ku faafayay si aan kala go' lahayn in ka badan 12 bilood.
items.imageAlt: Tallaalka MMR ee jadeecada, qaamaqa iyo rubella

items.title: Iran oo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerartay saldhig Mareykan oo ku yaal Bahrain
items.summary: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay inay 6 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn ku beegsadeen xarun raadaar oo Mareykan ah oo ku taal saldhigga hawada ee Riffa ee Bahrain, halka Bahrain ay sheegtay in difaaceeda hawadu burburiyay weerarka.
items.imageAlt: Munaaradda saacadda ee magaalada Riffa ee Bahrain

items.title: Weerarro drone ah oo Ukraine qaaday oo ku dhacay Nizhnekamsk iyo Taganrog ee Ruushka
items.summary: Saraakiisha Ruushka ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in weerarro drone ah oo Ukraine habeennimo qaaday ay waxyeelleeyeen xarumo warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Nizhnekamsk, halka weerar kale oo lagu qaaday Taganrog uu ku dhintay injineer ka shaqeynayay xarun koronto.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Nizhnekamsk ee Tatarstan oo baraf ku daboolan

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo dhagax-dhigay Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka, mucaaradkana ugu baaqay inay ku soo laabtaan wada-hadallada
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, dhagax-dhigay dhismaha Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka iyo dib-u-dhiska Isbitaalka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoo xilligaas ugu baaqay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka inay ku soo laabtaan miiska wada-hadallada.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo booqasho rasmi ah ku jira

items.title: Ruto oo ka jawaabay eedaha mucaaradka ee musuqmaasuqa tareenka SGR
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku eedeeyay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka inay si xulasho ah u soo xiganayaan warbixin Bangiga Adduunka oo walaac ka muujisay musuqmaasuq iyo daciifnimo ku jirtay iibsiga dhismaha tareenka SGR, isagoo sheegay in mashruuca la fuliyay xilligii dowlad hore, sida…
items.imageAlt: Tareen rakaab ah oo maraya khadka SGR ee Mombasa iyo Nairobi

items.title: Hamas oo xaqiijisay dilka taliyaheeda Rafah, Samir Abu Younis, oo lagu dilay duqeyn Israa'iil
items.summary: Garabka militari ee Hamas, Kataa'ib al-Qassam, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku dhawaaqay in taliyihii guutadeeda Rafah, Samir Abu Younis, lagu dilay duqeyn Israa'iil ay ka fulisay aagga al-Mawasi ee Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza, sida ay werisay wakaaladda Anadolu oo Daily Sabah daabacday.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Khan Younis ee koonfurta Gaza, 2019

items.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamse: Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay awood ay iskaga difaacdo weerarrada internetka
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in Soomaaliya ay khasab ku tahay inay dhisato awood ay kaga hortagto weerarrada internetka iyo khataraha amniga dhijitaalka ah, xilli uu kormeer ku tagay xarunta Wasaaradda Isgaarsiinta iyo Tiknoolajiyadda ee Muqdisho.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamse Cabdi Barre oo ka qayb galaya shir lagu qabtay Muqdisho, Janaayo 2023

items.title: Australia oo New Zealand 32-12 kaga adkaatay finalka Koobka Adduunka ee Rugby League
items.summary: Australia ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku guuleysatay Koobka Adduunka ee Rugby League ee ragga markii afraad oo isku xigta, kadib markii ay finalkii ka dhacay garoonka Suncorp ee Brisbane 32-12 kaga adkaatay New Zealand, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Suncorp ee magaalada Brisbane, Australia

items.title: Senator Ted Cruz oo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ugu baaqay inay aqoonsato Somaliland
items.summary: Senator Ted Cruz oo ka tirsan Aqalka Senate-ka Mareykanka ayaa mar kale ku baaqay in Mareykanku si rasmi ah u aqoonsado Somaliland, isagoo qoraal uu soo dhigay barta X ku sheegay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibaddu ay qaaddo tallaabooyin waafaqsan aragtida Madaxweyne Donald Trump, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Senator Ted Cruz, 2019

items.title: Cape Verde oo codeynaysa doorashada madaxweynaha, Neves oo la tartamaya musharraxa ugu horreysa ee haweenka
items.summary: Codbixiyeyaasha Cape Verde ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, u codeynaya doorashada madaxweynaha, halkaas oo Madaxweyne José Maria Neves uu xilka mar labaad u raadinayo, kuna tartamayo Joana Rosa, oo ah haweenayda ugu horreysa ee dalkaas u tartanta xilka madaxweynaha, sida ay werisay Euronews.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Cape Verde José Maria Neves, 2023

items.title: Nigeria oo muwaadiniinteeda uga digtay inay maraan garoonka Bole ee Addis Ababa sababo caafimaad dartood
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Nigeria ayaa muwaadiniinteeda, gaar ahaan kuwa qaba xanuunno, uga digtay inay safar ku maraan garoonka Bole ee Addis Ababa joogga sare ee magaalada dartiis, kadib markii 16 Nigerian ay sanadkan dhinteen iyagoo sii maraya, sida ay werisay KBC.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Bole ee magaalada Addis Ababa, Itoobiya

items.title: Yemen: ciidamada koonfureed oo ka baxay Bab el-Mandeb iyo garoonka Dhubab, Xuuthiyiintu waa la wareegeen
items.summary: Ciidamada Hubaysan ee Koonfurta Yemen ayaa ka baxay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Dhubab iyo deegaanka Bab el-Mandeb ee galbeedka gobolka Taiz, taasoo goobtaas u daysay xoogagga Xuuthiyiinta, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Marin-biyoodka Bab el-Mandeb oo laga arkayo badda dhexdeeda, iyadoo xeebta Yemen ay ka muuqato meel fog

items.title: Urdun: saddex nin oo dil lagu xukumay weerarkii kaniisadda Karak ee 9 qof lagu dilay
items.summary: Maxkamadda Amniga Dowladda ee Urdun ayaa saddex nin ku xukuntay dil daldalaad ah, kadib markii lagu helay inay fuliyeen weerarkii hubaysnaa ee 23 October lagu qaaday kaniisad ku taal koonfurta dalka, sida ay sheegeen ciidamada Urdun.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Al-Karak ee koonfurta Urdun

items.title: Axmed Madoobe oo u ambabaxaya Garoowe si uu Deni ula falanqeeyo muranka doorashooyinka
