items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo ku sugan Madaxtooyada Garoowe, January 2021

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka mid noqotay 133 dal oo taageeray qaraarka QM ee hakinta xukunka dilka
items.summary: Soomaaliya ayaa codkeeda siisay qaraar uu Guddiga Saddexaad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ansixiyay 13 November 2026, kaas oo dalalka ugu baaqaya inay hakiyaan fulinta xukunka dilka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee xarunta QM ee New York, 2024

items.title: Mooyaale: in ka badan 10,000 oo qof oo ku barakacay gudaha Kenya, cudurro ayaa laga cabsi qabaa
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Marsabit ee Kenya ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 10,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha Kenya kadib colaadaha ka socda deegaanka Mooyaale ee xuduudda Itoobiya, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Waddada weyn ee isku xirta Kenya iyo Itoobiya, oo ka bilaabata xuduudda Kenya ee Mooyaale

items.title: UFC 334: Ciryl Gane oo Josh Hokit ku garaacay go'aan dhammaystiran, kuna haystay koobka miisaanka culus
items.summary: Faransiiska Ciryl Gane ayaa difaacay horyaalnimada miisaanka culus ee UFC, kadib markii uu Josh Hokit kaga adkaaday go'aan garsoorayaal oo dhammaystiran (48-47, 48-47, 48-47) ciyaartii ugu weyneyd ee UFC 334 ee Madison Square Garden, New York.
items.imageAlt: Ciryl Gane oo miisaanka la saarayo xafladda miisaanka ee UFC Freedom 250, Washington, June 2026

items.title: Australia iyo Filibiin oo Manila ku saxiixday heshiis difaac oo cusub
items.summary: Australia iyo Filibiin ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, magaalada Manila ku saxiixay heshiis cusub oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga ciidamada, iyadoo Filibiin ay khilaaf ba'an kala dhexeeyo Shiinaha Badda Koonfurta Shiinaha.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Difaaca Filibiin Gilberto Teodoro oo ku sugan xarunta Taliska Galbeed ee Palawan, November 2024

items.title: Iran: saddex markab oo saliid ah oo miino ku dhacay Hormuz, Bahrain oo dhawaaq digniin ah shiday
items.summary: Ciidamada badda ee IRGC ayaa sheegay in laba markab oo saliid sida ay qarxeen oo dab qabsadeen kadib markii ay miino ku dhaceen koonfurta Marinka Hormuz, halka Axaddii, 15 November, dhawaaqyada digniinta ay ka dhawaaqeen Bahrain.
items.imageAlt: Doomaha gantaallada iyo kumaandoosta ciidamada badda ee IRGC oo ku sugan agagaarka Marinka Hormuz, layli 2015

items.title: UFC 334: Kayla Harrison oo Amanda Nunes ku ceejisay wareegga afraad, kuna haysatay koobka
items.summary: Kayla Harrison ayaa difaacatay horyaalnimada miisaanka bantamweight ee UFC kadib markii ay wareegga afraad ceejis kaga adkaatay Amanda Nunes, Sabtidii habeennimo garoonka Madison Square Garden ee New York.
items.imageAlt: Kayla Harrison oo dabaaldegaysa kadib guusheedii billadda dahabka ee judo Olombikada Rio 2016

items.title: Sacuudiga oo sheegay inuu riday laba gantaal oo Xuuthiyiintu ku ganeen Riyadh
items.summary: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirku uu Axaddii, 15 November, riday laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuuthiyiinta Yemen ay ku ganeen caasimadda Riyadh, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaalka dhismayaasha dhaadheer ee magaalada Riyadh, Sacuudi Carabiya

items.title: Bilibili Gaming oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Gen.G, kuna guuleysatay koobka adduunka ee League of Legends
items.summary: Kooxda Shiinaha ee Bilibili Gaming (BLG) ayaa 3-1 kaga adkaatay kooxda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ee Gen.G finalka koobka adduunka ee ciyaarta elektaroonigga ah ee League of Legends, oo ka dhacay Barclays Center ee New York, waxayna jebisay 4 sano oo ay Kuuriyada Koonfureed ku guuleysanaysay.
items.imageAlt: Barclays Center oo ku yaal Brooklyn, New York, halkaas oo lagu ciyaaray finalka

items.title: SpaceX oo markii ugu horreysay gacmaha munaaradda ku qabatay Starship ka soo laabtay hawada sare
items.summary: Shirkadda SpaceX ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, markii ugu horreysay taariikhda ku qabatay markabka hawada sare ee Starship gacmaha waaweyn ee munaaradda ganitaanka ee Starbase, Texas, kadib markii uu ka soo laabtay safar uu ku wareegay dhulka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Gantaalka Starship oo ku taagan barxadda ganitaanka ee Starbase, Texas, April 2023

items.title: Netanyahu oo ugu baaqay dowlad midnimo, Eisenkot oo ku tilmaamay khiyaamo
items.summary: Ra'iisul wasaaraha xilka u sii hayaa ee Israa'iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, mar kale ugu baaqay in isaga iyo Gadi Eisenkot ay dhisaan dowlad midnimo qaran, halka Eisenkot uu baaqaas ku tilmaamay khiyaamo.
items.imageAlt: Benjamin Netanyahu, sawir rasmi ah oo la qaaday February 2023

items.title: Mirra Andreeva oo Pegula ka badisay, gaartayna finalka WTA Finals
items.summary: Ciyaartoyda Ruushka ah ee Mirra Andreeva ayaa 6-3, 6-4 kaga adkaatay Jessica Pegula semi-finalka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells, waxayna noqotay ciyaartoydii ugu da'da yarayd ee gaarta finalka tartankan muddo 22 sano ah.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: Mirra Andreeva oo ciyaareysa US Open 2023

items.title: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Ciraaq oo xilka ka qaaday sagaal sarkaal oo lagu tuhmay tahriibinta shidaalka
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq Cali al-Zaidi ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, xilalka ka qaaday sagaal sarkaal, wuxuuna amar ku bixiyay in cid kasta oo lagu eedeeyay tahriibinta shidaalka ee Jurf al-Sakher loo gudbiyo garsoorka, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq Cali al-Zaidi oo ku sugan Pentagon-ka, Washington, 14 July 2026

items.title: Faransiiska: 106,000 qof oo isugu soo baxay dibadbaxyada qaaliga nolosha, sabtidii shanaad oo xiriir ah
items.summary: Ku dhawaad 106,000 qof ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah qaaliga nolosha ka dhigay magaalooyinka Faransiiska, oo ay ku jiraan 24,000 oo Paris ah, sida uu sheegay Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, halka ururrada ardaydu sheegeen 200,000.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: dibadbax dhaqdhaqaaqa Jaakadaha Jaalaha ee Paris, 9 February 2019

items.title: Kalonzo Musyoka oo sheegay inuu taageeri doono musharaxa mideysan ee mucaaradka Kenya ee doorashada 2027
items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper, Kalonzo Musyoka, ayaa Sabtidii ku dhawaaqay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu ka tanaasulo hammigiisa madaxweynenimo si uu u taageero musharax keliya oo mucaaradku u soo bandhigo doorashada guud ee Kenya ee 2027, sida ay wariyeen Capital FM iyo KBC.
items.imageAlt: Kalonzo Musyoka, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper ee Kenya (sawir hore)

items.title: Rugby: Wales oo 35-28 kaga adkaatay New Zealand, guushii ugu horreysay tan iyo 1953
items.summary: Xulka rugby-ga Wales ayaa Sabtidii magaalada Cardiff 35-28 kaga adkaaday New Zealand tartanka Nations Championship, taas oo ahayd guushoodii ugu horreysay ee ay ka gaaraan All Blacks muddo 73 sano ah.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Principality Stadium ee magaalada Cardiff, Wales

items.title: Talyaaniga oo Meta ku ganaaxay 805 milyan oo yuuro, kadib markii ay sawirrada isticmaaleyaasha gashay oggolaansho la'aan
items.summary: Hay'adda ilaalinta xogta ee Talyaaniga ayaa Sabtidii shirkadda Meta, oo leh Facebook, ku ganaaxday 805 milyan oo yuuro, iyadoo ku eedeysay inay app-ka Facebook ee Android ku gashay sawirrada iyo muuqaallada isticmaaleyaasha iyadoo aan helin oggolaanshahooda gaarka ah.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal hawada ah oo xarunta Facebook (Meta) ee Menlo Park, California

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo Antalya ku kala saxiixday heshiis lagu xoojinayo ilaalinta qoysaska iyo adeegyada bulshada
items.summary: Wasiirka Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Soomaaliya, Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, iyo dhiggeeda Turkiga, Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş, ayaa magaalada Antalya ku kala saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad oo ku saabsan adeegyada bulshada iyo ilaalinta qoysaska, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Qoyska iyo Adeegyada Bulshada Turkiga, Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş, oo ka hadlaysa shir ka dhacay Budapest sannadkii 2023

items.title: Mohamed Salah oo noqday gooldhaliyaha ugu badan taariikhda xulka Masar
items.summary: Xiddigii hore ee Liverpool, Mohamed Salah, ayaa noqday ciyaaryahanka goolasha ugu badan u dhaliyay xulka Masar, kadib markii uu laba gool u dhaliyay guushii 5-0 ee Malawi ee isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika, sida uu sheegay Liverpool FC.
items.imageAlt: Mohamed Salah oo u ciyaaraya xulka Masar ciyaartii Argentina iyo Masar ee Koobka Adduunka 2026

items.title: Bulgaria oo joojisay hubka ay Ukraine uga bixin jirtay kaydka ciidankeeda
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Bulgaria, Rumen Radev, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu aanu Ukraine siin doonin hub iyo rasaas laga soo qaado kaydka ciidanka, aanuna ka qayb qaadan doonin maalgelin cusub oo Midowga Yurub, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Rumen Radev oo ka hadlaya shir ka dhacay Budapest sannadkii 2023

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo keligiis ku sugnaa hoolka shirkii Gogosha Wadahadalka Qaranka – Kuraastii loo diyaariyey ka qaybgalayaasha oo bannaan
items.summary: Sawir laga soo qaaday goobta loo diyaariyey shirka Gogosha Wadahadalka Qaranka ayaa muujinaya Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo keligiis fadhiya miiska dhexe ee shirka, iyadoo kuraastii kale ee hoolka ay bannaan yihiin.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo keligiis fadhiya miiska dhexe ee hoolka Gogosha Wadahadalka Qaranka, kuraasta kalena ay bannaan yihiin

items.title: Kenya: qiimaha shidaalka oo aan isbeddelin bisha soo socota, EPRA ayaa sheegtay
items.summary: Hay'adda Nidaamisa Tamarta iyo Batroolka ee Kenya (EPRA) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in qiimaha batroolka, diiseelka iyo gaaska aysan isbeddelin muddada 14 November ilaa 15 December, iyadoo dowladdu ay kabid ku bixisay, sida ay werisay The Standard.
items.imageAlt: Xarun shidaal oo ku taal waddada A104 ee magaalada Nairobi, Kenya

items.title: Baraawe oo warshad ogsijiinta caafimaadka soo saarta laga hirgeliyay Isbitaalka Guud
items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, xarigga ka jaray warshad cusub oo soo saarta ogsijiinta caafimaadka oo laga dhisay Isbitaalka Guud ee degmada Baraawe, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Kalluumaysato ku sugan xeebta magaalada Baraawe ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, 2022

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya oo Muqdisho ku bilaabay wada-tashigii ugu horreeyay ee wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda
items.summary: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Hindiya ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, magaalada Muqdisho ka bilaabay wada-tashigii ugu horreeyay ee rasmi ah ee u dhexeeya wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda ee labada dal, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Sripriya Ranganathan, oo ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Hindiya, oo 2024 fuuleysa markabka Dali ee Baltimore xilli ay ahayd diblomaasi ka tirsan safaaradda Hindiya ee Mareykanka

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan iyo Suudaan oo Khartoum ku saxiixday heshiis ku saabsan mugga saliidda ceeriin
items.summary: Koonfur Suudaan iyo Suudaan ayaa magaalada Khartoum ku saxiixay heshiis is-afgarad (MoU) oo lagu waafajinayo mugga saliidda ceeriin ee labada dal, laguna xoojinayo iskaashiga qaybta batroolka, sida ay werisay Eye Radio Sabtida 14 November.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta dhoofinta saliidda ee dekedda Port Sudan oo laga arkayo markab, 2019 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Zelensky: Mareykanka ayaa soo jeediyay in Ukraine ka baxdo Donbas si ay u hesho xubinnimada NATO
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa sheegay in wada-xaajoodayaasha Mareykanka ay soo jeediyeen fikrad ah in Ukraine ciidamadeeda kala baxdo qaybta Donbas ee ay weli gacanta ku hayso, beddelkeedana ay ku biirto NATO, sida ay werisay BBC iyo warbaahin kale Sabtida 14 November.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky oo booqasho ku joogay Golaha Yurub ee Strasbourg, June 2025 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Erdoğan oo Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay wada-hadal siyaasadeed iyo midnimo qaran
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud kula hadlay muhiimadda midnimada qaranka iyo wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo lagu xalliyo khilaafka Soomaaliya, sida uu sheegay war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Turkiga oo ay soo xigatay Hiiraan Online Sabtida 14 November.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo garoonka Aadan Cadde ee Muqdisho ku dhegeysanaya heesaha calanka, 2015 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Axmed Madoobe oo Mukhtaar Sheekh Axmed Cabdulle u magacaabay Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Jubaland
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Jubaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), ayaa Sabtida 14 November wareegto ka soo saaray magaalada Kismaayo, kuna magacaabay Mukhtaar Sheekh Axmed Cabdulle inuu noqdo Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Jubaland, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Jubaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) oo ka hadlaya shir ka dhacay Muqdisho, 2021 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Golaha Ammaanka QM oo howlgalka nabad-ilaalinta Abyei u kordhiyay ilaa November 2027
items.summary: Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Jimcihii 13 November sannad kale u kordhiyay howlgalka ciidamada nabad-ilaalinta ee Abyei (UNISFA), ilaa 15 November 2027, iyadoo Shiinaha iyo Ruushka ay ka aamuseen codbixinta, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal sare oo laga qaaday deegaanka Abyei, 2009 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo doorashada guud dib ugu dhigay 11 February 2027
items.summary: Guddiga Qaranka ee Doorashooyinka Koonfur Suudaan (NEC) ayaa doorashooyinka guud ee dalka dib ugu dhigay 11 February 2027, halkii ay ka ahaayeen 22 December 2026, sida uu muujinayo jadwal cusub oo ay heshay Radio Tamazuj, oo ay sidoo kale werisay Eye Radio.
items.imageAlt: Dad codbixinaya degmada Lainya ee Koonfur Suudaan, 2011 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya: Gogosha Wadatashiga Qaran ayaa dhawaan la furayaa
items.summary: Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Sabtida 14 November sheegtay in ay socdaan xiriirro lala leeyahay dhinacyada lagu casuumay Gogosha Wadatashiga Qaran, taas oo ay sheegtay in dhawaan la furi doono, sida ay werisay warbaahinta dowladda ee Radio Muqdisho.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ku sugan Villa Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho, 2014 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ka jawaabtay cambaareynta khubarada QM ee xil-ka-qaadista Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare
items.summary: Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Sabtida 14 November jawaab rasmi ah ka bixisay bayaan ay khubaro Qaramada Midoobay 12 November ku cambaareeyeen xil-ka-qaadista Guddoomiyihii Maxkamadda Sare, iyadoo sheegtay inay ka go'an tahay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida garsoorka,…
items.imageAlt: Madax garsoor iyo diblomaasiyiin ku sugan furitaanka Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir ee Muqdisho, 2015 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Rugby: Faransiiska oo 21-19 kaga adkaaday Koonfur Afrika garoonka Stade de France
items.summary: Xulka rugby-ga Faransiiska ayaa Jimcihii 13 November garoonka Stade de France ee Paris 21-19 kaga adkaaday Koonfur Afrika, oo labadii koob ee adduunka ee ugu dambeeyay ku guulaysatay, kulan ka tirsan wareegga 5aad ee Nations Championship.
items.imageAlt: Taageerayaal ku sugan garoonka Stade de France ee Paris xilli kulan rugby ah socday (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Kenya: Lixda gobol ee xeebta oo loogu baaqay inay xoojiyaan u diyaargarowga tsunami
items.summary: Xarunta Hawlgallada Masiibooyinka Qaranka ee Kenya (NDOC) ayaa ugu baaqday lixda gobol ee xeebta dalka inay tababarro joogto ah oo tsunami ah ka sameeyaan dugsiyada, goobaha dalxiiska iyo bulshada kalluumeysatada, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya.
items.imageAlt: Xeebta Diani ee gobolka xeebta Kenya (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Shirka dalalka ku hadla Faransiiska oo Cambodia ka furmay iyadoo khilaafka Rwanda iyo Congo uu hareeyay
items.summary: Shirka labadii sannadoodba mar ee Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Francophonie ayaa Sabtida ka bilaabmay magaalada Phnom Penh ee Cambodia, iyadoo doorashada xoghayaha guud ee ururka ay khilaaf ka dhex abuurtay Rwanda iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.
items.imageAlt: Louise Mushikiwabo, oo ah xoghayaha guud ee Francophonie ee hadda, xilligii ay ahayd Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Rwanda, 2013 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Baarlamaanka Jarmalka oo hay'adaha sirdoonka siiyay awoodo cusub oo ballaaran
items.summary: Baarlamaanka Jarmalka (Bundestag) ayaa Jimcihii ansixiyay sharci siinaya hay'adaha sirdoonka dalka awood ay ku jebiyaan ama ku carqaladeeyaan khataraha cadawga, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera, iyadoo codbixintu ahayd 308 haa, 190 maya iyo 71 ka aamusay.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta dhexe ee hay'adda sirdoonka dibadda ee Jarmalka (BND) ee Berlin (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar oo soo gabagabowday, Shiinaha oo dahab ugu badan qaatay
items.summary: Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026 ayaa Jimcihii ku soo gabagabowday caasimadda Senegal kadib laba toddobaad, iyadoo Shiinaha uu qaatay biladaha dahabka ugu badan, dalalka Afrikana ay heleen tiradii biladaha ugu badnayd abid, sida ay werisay DW.
items.imageAlt: Calaamadda (mascot) Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026 oo xiran dhar dhaqameed Senegal

items.title: Wada-hadalkii Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka ee Sabtida oo dib u dhacay
items.summary: Wada-hadal la filayay inay maanta, Sabti 14 November, Muqdisho ku yeeshaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo kooxaha mucaaradka ayaa dib u dhacay, kadib markii Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo Nabad & Nolol ay sheegeen inaysan ka qayb geli doonin wada-hadal aan lahayn dammaanad-qaad iyo dhexdhexaadin caalami ah, sida ay…
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Duulimaadyada Mareykanka oo dib u bilaabmay kadib markii la qaaday hakadkii dalka oo dhan
items.summary: Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) ayaa habeenimadii Jimcaha qaadday hakadkii saacadaha socday ee garoomada dalka oo dhan, iyadoo masuuliyiintu sheegeen in cilladda aysan sababin weerar internet, sida ay werisay France 24.
items.imageAlt: Munaaradda xakamaynta hawada ee garoonka Dallas Fort Worth iyo diyaarad (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: SpaceX oo Starship u dirtay meeraha dhulka, balse gantaalka hoose ayaa ku qarxay Gacanka Mexico
items.summary: Shirkadda SpaceX ayaa si guul leh u dirtay duulimaadkii ugu dambeeyay ee dayax-gacmeedka Starship, balse kama ay soo celin gantaalka hoose ee Super Heavy sidii loo qorsheeyay, kaas oo ku qarxay Gacanka Mexico, sida ay werisay DW.
items.imageAlt: Gantaalka Starship iyo gantaalka hoose ee Super Heavy oo isku dul saaran goobta Starbase ee Texas (sawir kayd ah, 2022)

items.title: Mareykanka oo waayay magacii dal ka xorobay jadeecada kadib 26 sano
items.summary: Guddi khubaro madax-bannaan oo warbixin u gudbiya agaasimaha Ururka Caafimaadka Pan-Ameerika (PAHO) ayaa toddobaadkan go'aamiyay in jadeecada aan mar dambe loo arkin cudur Mareykanka ka xorobay, sida ay werisay CNN.
items.imageAlt: Sawir mikroskoob oo midab lagu daray oo muujinaya walxaha fayraska jadeecada (cas)

items.title: Svitolina oo kaga adkaatay Sabalenka, kuna gudubtay semi-finalka WTA Finals
items.summary: Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine ayaa 6-3, 3-6, 6-1 kaga adkaatay Aryna Sabalenka tartanka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells, taasoo soo afjartay xilli-ciyaareedka Sabalenka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Elina Svitolina oo ku ciyaaraysa tartanka Indian Wells (sawir kayd ah, 2017)

items.title: Aqalka Cad: Trump, Xi iyo Putin ayaa Khamiista Shenzhen ku yeelan doona kulan saddex-geesood ah oo nukliyeer ah
items.summary: Aqalka Cad ee Mareykanka ayaa Jimcihii shaaciyay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu toddobaadka soo socda magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha kula kulmi doono hoggaamiyaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping iyo Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin, kulankii ugu horreeyay ee saddex-geesood ah ee hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal, sida ay werisay…
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo laga qaaday degmada Futian ee magaalada Shenzhen, Shiinaha (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Goolhayaha Andorra Jesús Owono oo 12 kulan laga ganaaxay isku dhacii ku dambeeyay geerida Jesús de Miguel
items.summary: Guddiga anshaxa ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Isbaanya (RFEF) ayaa Jimcihii 12 kulan ka ganaaxay goolhayaha FC Andorra Jesús Owono, kadib isku dhac uu la galay weeraryahankii Tenerife Jesús de Miguel, kaas oo maalin kadib geeriyooday, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Ciudad del Fútbol ee Las Rozas, xarunta Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Isbaanya (RFEF) (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Midowga Yurub iyo shan dal oo diblomaasiyiin u diraya wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada Ukraine
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Yurub António Costa ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Yurub ay wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda Ukraine u diri doonto koox diblomaasiyiin ah oo ka socda Midowga Yurub iyo shan dal: Ingiriiska, Faransiiska, Jarmalka, Talyaaniga iyo Booland, sida ay werisay France 24.
items.imageAlt: António Costa, oo hadda ah Guddoomiyaha Golaha Yurub, sawir laga qaaday sannadkii 2017 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Mareykanka oo dalka oo dhan ka joojiyay duulimaadyada, kadib cillad isgaarsiineed oo saameysay xakamaynta hawada
items.summary: Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) ayaa Jimcihii, 13 November, amar ku bixisay in diyaarad kasta oo ka duulaysa garoomada dalka oo dhan la hakiyo, kadib cillad isgaarsiineed oo saameysay xarumaha gobollada ee xakameeya duulimaadyada, sida ay werisay CNN.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Wilbur Wright ee magaalada Washington, oo ah xarunta Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo shirka Golaha Fulinta Midowga Afrika ee Accra ku taageertay in ururku dhaqaale ahaan isku filnaado
items.summary: Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad), ayaa 13 November magaalada Accra ee Ghana ka sheegay in Soomaaliya ay taageersan tahay in Midowga Afrika uu yeesho hannaan dhaqaale oo isku filan, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad) oo kulan kula jira Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Giriigga, Brussels (sawir kayd ah, 2024)

items.title: Microsoft oo raalli-gelin ka bixisay cilladdii adeegyadeeda oo ku dhowaad 24 saacadood carqaladeysay dunida
items.summary: Shirkadda Microsoft ayaa sheegtay inay aad uga xun tahay cilladda ku timid adeegyadeeda, oo ay ku jiraan Outlook iyo Teams, kadib markii ay ku dhowaad 24 saacadood carqaladeysay isticmaaleyaasha in ka badan 70 dal, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta shirkadda Microsoft ee Redmond, Mareykanka, oo sare laga sawiray (sawir kayd ah, 2021)

items.title: Qaraxyo laga maqlay dekedda Jask ee Iran kadib sheegashada IRGC ee weerarka radar Mareykan oo Bahrain ku yaal
items.summary: Qaraxyo ayaa Jimcihii 13 November laga maqlay magaalada dekedda ah ee Jask ee koonfurta Iran, sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka dowladda Iran ee IRNA, saacado kadib markii Ilaalada Kacaanka (IRGC) ay sheegatay inay burburiyeen nidaam radar oo Mareykan ah oo ku yaal Bahrain.
items.imageAlt: Xeebta Jask ee koonfurta Iran, oo ku taal Gacanka Cumaan (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Xeer-ilaalinta Paraguay oo eedeyn cusub u jeedisay madaxweynihii hore Santiago Peña oo la xiriirta burburka bangiga Ueno
items.summary: Xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta Paraguay ayaa Jimcihii 13 November madaxweynihii hore Santiago Peña ku eedeeyay ka qaybgal koox dambiyeed, oo la xiriirta doorkiisa la sheegay ee burburka bangiga dijitaalka ah ee Ueno, toddobaad kadib markii baarlamaanku xilka ka qaaday, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Santiago Peña oo ah madaxweynihii hore ee Paraguay (sawir kayd ah, 2025)

items.title: Kagame oo booqasho taariikhi ah ku tagay Cambodia, 3 heshiis oo iskaashi ahna la saxiixay
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Rwanda Paul Kagame ayaa 13 November magaalada Phnom Penh kula kulmay Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Cambodia Hun Manet, waxaana labada dal kala saxiixdeen 3 heshiis oo ku saabsan maalgashiga, dalxiiska iyo duulimaadyada, sida ay werisay KT Press.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Rwanda Paul Kagame oo ka hadlaya shirka amniga ee Munich (sawir kayd ah, 2017)

items.title: Ronaldinho oo 46 jir ah oo la filayo inuu Axadda u saftay Ravenna, kulankiisii ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2015
items.summary: Xiddiga reer Brazil Ronaldinho ayaa la filayaa inuu Axadda ka bilaabo kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee rasmi ah muddo ka badan 10 sano, marka kooxdiisa Ravenna ay la ciyaarto deriskeeda Forlì horyaalka Serie C ee Talyaaniga, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Ronaldinho, xiddigii hore ee Brazil (sawir kayd ah, 2019)

items.title: Ruushka oo wafdi ganacsi oo 70 qof ah u diray Kabul si uu ula xaajooto dowladda Taliban
items.summary: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka Ruushka Alexei Overchuk ayaa hoggaaminayay wafdi ka kooban 70 ganacsade oo gaaray Kabul, halkaas oo ay dowladda Taliban kala hadleen gaadiidka, beeraha iyo daawooyinka, sida ay werisay Euronews.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka Ruushka Alexei Overchuk (sawir rasmi ah oo kayd ah)

items.title: Ruto oo ballan qaaday in waddada Nairobi-Mombasa laga dhigo laba jid muddo sannad gudihiis ah
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Jimcihii magaalada Mombasa ka sheegay in dowladdiisu muddo sannad gudihiis ah laba jid ka dhigi doonto waddada weyn ee isku xirta Nairobi iyo Mombasa, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya.
items.imageAlt: Waddada weyn ee Nairobi iyo Mombasa isku xirta (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Maxkamadda ICC oo baaritaankeeda Afgaanistaan ku koobtay dambiyada lagu eedeeyay Taliban
items.summary: Garsoorayaasha Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ayaa xiray qaybta baaritaanka Afgaanistaan ee lagu eegi karay ciidamada Mareykanka, waxayna baaritaanka ku koobeen dambiyada lagu eedeeyay Taliban, sida ay muujinayaan dukumentiyo maxkamadda oo Jimcihii la shaaciyay.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ee magaalada The Hague (sawir kayd ah, 2019)

items.title: Goolhayaha caanka ah ee Mareykanka Alyssa Naeher oo ka fariisatay kubadda cagta xirfadda
items.summary: Alyssa Naeher, oo ka mid ah goolhayeyaasha ugu guulaha badan taariikhda xulka haweenka Mareykanka, ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ka fariisanayso kubadda cagta xirfadda kadib 11 xilli ciyaareed oo ay u ciyaartay kooxda Chicago Stars, sida ay werisay CBS Sports.
items.imageAlt: Alyssa Naeher oo u diyaar garoobaysa kulan saaxiibtinimo oo xulka Mareykanka la ciyaaray Shiinaha (sawir kayd ah, 2018)

items.title: Israa'iil oo la sheegay inay Somaliland u xaqiijisay in aqoonsigu sii jiri doono xitaa haddii xukuumaddeedu isbeddesho
items.summary: Mas'uuliyiin Israa'iili ah ayaa hoggaanka Somaliland u xaqiijiyay in Israa'iil aysan ka noqon doonin aqoonsiga ay siisay Somaliland, xataa haddii xukuumadda Tel Aviv ay isbeddesho, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online oo soo xigatay telefishanka dowladda Israa'iil ee KAN.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Hargeysa ah (sawir kayd ah, 2024)

items.title: OCHA oo ka digtay daacuun iyo shuban-biyood ku faafaya Mudug kadib fatahaadaha
items.summary: Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee isku-dubaridka arrimaha bini'aadantinimada (OCHA) ayaa ka digay korodhka cudurrada faafa ee ka dhashay fatahaadihii dhowaan ka dhacay gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan deegaannada bariga Gaalkacyo, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Hoyga ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dad fatahaad ka barakacay oo ku yaal duleedka Beledweyne, gobolka Hiiraan (sawir kayd ah, 2014)

items.title: Turkiga iyo Qatar oo saxiixay heshiis difaac wadaag ah oo Istanbul lagu gaaray
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan iyo Amiirka Qatar Sheekh Tamiim bin Xamad Aal Thaani ayaa Jimcihii Istanbul ku saxiixay heshiis difaac wadaag ah, xilli ay qabteen shirka 12aad ee Guddiga Istiraatiijiyadeed ee Sare ee labada dal, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Amiirka Qatar Sheekh Tamiim bin Xamad Aal Thaani iyo Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan oo ka qayb galay kulan ka dhacay xarunta Qaramada Midoobay (sawir kayd ah, September 2025)

items.title: McIlroy iyo Hatton oo wadaaga hoggaanka DP World Tour Championship ee Dubai
items.summary: Rory McIlroy iyo Tyrrell Hatton ayaa wadaaga hoggaanka tartanka golf-ka ee DP World Tour Championship ee Dubai kadib labadii maalmood ee hore, iyagoo labaduba ku jira shan dhibcood ka hooseeya par-ka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Rory McIlroy oo kubadda ku tuuraya godka koowaad xilli tababar ka hor tartanka Masters ee 2024 ee Augusta (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Lix qof oo ku dhimatay dhismo siddeed dabaq ah oo ku burburay Syokimau, duleedka Nairobi
items.summary: Ugu yaraan lix qof ayaa ku dhimatay kadib markii dhismo siddeed dabaq ah oo aan la dhammaystirin uu subaxnimadii Jimcaha ku burburay Syokimau oo ku taal duleedka Nairobi, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Saldhigga tareenka ee Syokimau, oo ku yaal duleedka Nairobi, meel u dhow goobta uu dhismuhu ku burburay (sawir kayd ah, 2014)

items.title: Madaxweyne Ramaphosa oo warqadaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya, Aadam Isxaaq
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika, Cyril Ramaphosa, ayaa maanta Madaxtooyada Pretoria si rasmi ah uga guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya u fadhiya Koonfur Afrika, Amb. Aadam Isxaaq.
items.imageAlt: Safiirka Soomaaliya, Aadam Isxaaq (bidix), iyo Madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa (midig) oo ku sugan Madaxtooyada Pretoria

items.title: Puntland oo ciidamo geysay deegaanka Roox ee Mudug kadib xiisad dhimasho sababtay
items.summary: Dowladda Puntland ayaa ciidamo nabadgelyo geysay deegaanka Roox ee gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo maalmo ka hor ay ka dhacday xiisad sababtay dhimashada hal qof, sida ay werisay Puntland Post.
items.imageAlt: Mas'uuliyiin Puntland iyo Galmudug, saraakiil booliis iyo hawlwadeenno UNSOM ah oo ku sugan magaalada Gaalkacyo, xilli tababar booliis la furayay (sawir kayd ah, 2017)

items.title: IAEA oo Iran ugu baaqday inay kormeerayaasha u ogolaato goobaha nukliyeerka ee muhiimka ah
items.summary: Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga ee Caalamka (IAEA) ayaa warbixin cusub ku sheegtay in si degdeg ah loo baahan yahay in dib loo bilaabo kormeerka Iran, maadaama aysan haysan macluumaad ku saabsan uraaniyamka aadka loo kobciyay, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today oo soo xigatay AFP iyo Reuters.
items.imageAlt: Calammada dalalka xubnaha ka ah oo taagan xarunta IAEA ee magaalada Vienna (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ee Ukraine oo Volgograd ku dilay 4 qof
items.summary: Afar qof ayaa la dilay, labana waa la dhaawacay, kadib weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo Ukraine ku qaaday aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Volgograd ee koonfurta Ruushka, sida uu sheegay guddoomiyaha gobolka Andrei Bocharov.
items.imageAlt: Warshadda shidaalka sifeysa ee Volgograd oo laga arkayo degmada Krasnoarmeisky (sawir kayd ah, 2023)

items.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway oo go'aamisay in oggolaanshaha saddex goob oo saliid ah uu sharci-darro ahaa
items.summary: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway ayaa 13-kii November go'aamisay in oggolaanshihii dowladdu siisay saddex goob oo saliid iyo gaas ah oo ku yaal Badda Waqooyi uu ahaa mid aan ansax ahayn, maadaama aan la qiimeyn saameynta cimilada, sida ay werisay Sweden Herald.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway ee magaalada Oslo (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Ciidamada IRGC oo sheegay in markab gaas dareere ah uu ku qarxay miino bariga Marinka Hormuz
items.summary: Ciidamada badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa Jimcaha sheegay in markab sida gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha (LNG) uu si xoog leh u qarxay kaddib markii uu ku dhacay miino badeed bariga Marinka Hormuz, sheegashadaas oo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin.
items.imageAlt: Sawir dayax-gacmeed oo muujinaya Marinka Hormuz

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine iyo Ruushka waxay ku heshiiyeen isweydaarsigii maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weynaa
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, ayaa 12-kii November magaalada Dublin ka sheegay in Ukraine iyo Ruushka ay isku raaceen isweydaarsiga maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weyn ilaa hadda, kaddib kulan uu la yeeshay ergayada Mareykanka Steve Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky oo booqasho ku jooga Golaha Yurub (sawir kayd ah, 2025)

items.title: Kosovo oo Soomaaliya ka codsatay inay ka caawiso helitaanka sagaal xubnood oo wafdi Soomaaliyeed ka maqan
items.summary: Dowladda Kosovo ayaa warqad diblomaasiyadeed ku weydiisatay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inay ka caawiso ogaanshaha halka ay ku sugan yihiin sagaal xubnood oo ka tirsanaa wafdi Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo 27-kii October ka baxay hoygoodii magaalada Prishtina iyaga oo aan cidna ogeysiin, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha cusub ee garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Prishtina, Kosovo

items.title: Sacuudiga oo Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 11,500 kursi oo Xajka 2027 ah
items.summary: Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Soomaaliya u qoondeysay 11,500 boos oo Xaj ah oo loogu talagalay xujeyda Soomaaliyeed ee Xajka 2027, kadib heshiis ay labada dowladood ku kala saxiixdeen magaalada Jeddah, sida ay maanta subax werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Kacbada iyo xujeyda ku sugan Masjidka Xaramka ee Maka xilliga Xajka (sawir kayd ah, 2018)

items.title: Jubaland oo diiday magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka ee Golaha Wasiirrada
items.summary: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha ee Jubaland ayaa sheegtay inaysan aqoonsanayn magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka, iyadoo ku doodday in hannaanka dhismaha hay'adda aan lala tashan dowlad-goboleedyada, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirro iyo mas'uuliyiin Jubaland ah oo ka qayb galay xaflad magaalada Kismaayo (sawir kayd ah, 2015)

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 6 milyan oo Yuuro oo looga hortagayo saameynta El Niño
items.summary: Midowga Yurub ayaa Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 6 milyan oo Yuuro oo lagu xoojinayo u diyaargarowga musiibooyinka iyo taageerada bulshada nugul, xilli laga cabsi qabo in El Niño uu saameyn xooggan ku yeesho qaybo ka mid ah Afrika 2026 iyo 2027, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Hadja Lahbib, wakiilka Midowga Yurub ee diyaargarowga iyo maareynta xasaradaha (sawir kayd ah, 2024)

items.title: Kalonzo Musyoka oo u ambabaxaya Mareykanka si uu ula kulmo xildhibaannada Congress-ka ka hor doorashada 2027
items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper ee Kenya, Kalonzo Musyoka, ayaa 18 ilaa 24 November u safraya Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu kula kulmi doono xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka isla markaana la kulmi doono Kenyanka qurbaha, sida ay werisay Capital FM.
items.imageAlt: Kalonzo Musyoka, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper ee Kenya

items.title: Muqdisho oo markii ugu horreysay martigelisay shirka Guddiga Xoghayeyaasha Joogtada ah ee IGAD iyo CEWARN
items.summary: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay magaalada Muqdisho ku qabatay shir laba maalmood ah oo ay yeesheen Guddiga Xoghayeyaasha Joogtada ah ee IGAD iyo xarunta digniinaha hore ee colaadaha CEWARN, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaalka magaalada Muqdisho, caasimadda Soomaaliya

items.title: Senator Chris Van Hollen oo ku dhawaaqay inuu Chuck Schumer kula tartamayo hoggaanka Dimuqraadiga ee Aqalka Sare
items.summary: Senator-ka Dimuqraadiga ah ee gobolka Maryland, Chris Van Hollen, ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inuu u tartamayo jagada Hoggaamiyaha Aqlabiyadda ee Aqalka Sare ee Mareykanka, isagoo noqday senator-kii ugu horreeyay ee si toos ah u loolama Chuck Schumer, sida ay werisay Euronews.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Senator Chris Van Hollen

items.title: Cade Cunningham oo taariikh NBA sameeyay: 52 dhibcood, 11 caawin iyo 0 kubbad lumis
items.summary: Xiddiga Detroit Pistons Cade Cunningham ayaa Khamiistii dhaliyay 52 dhibcood, kana caawiyay 11, isagoo aan lumin hal kubbad, xilli Pistons ay 144-140 kaga adkaadeen Washington Wizards kadib 2 waqti oo dheeri ah, sida ay werisay The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: Cade Cunningham oo u ciyaaraya Detroit Pistons

items.title: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran oo sheegtay inay weerar ku qaadeen goob radar oo Mareykan ah oo ku taal Bahrain
items.summary: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay inay beegsadeen goob radar digniin hore oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay Bahrain, iyagoo ku tilmaamay aargoosi weerar cirka laga soo qaaday oo ku dhacay munaarad isgaarsiineed oo ku taal koonfurta Iran, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Qalcadda Bahrain iyo muuqaalka magaalada Manama, caasimadda Bahrain

items.title: Maxkamad Isbaanya ah oo hakisay hawlaha kooxda midigta fog ee Núcleo Nacional
items.summary: Garsoore ku sugan magaalada Gijón ee waqooyiga Isbaanya ayaa Khamiistii hakiyay hawlaha kooxda midigta fog ee Núcleo Nacional, iyadoo la baarayo dambiyo nacayb iyo urur sharci darro ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Fagaaraha Plaza Mayor ee magaalada Gijón, waqooyiga Isbaanya

items.title: FBI: Haakarro Kuuriyada Waqooyi ah oo wicitaanno muuqaal been ah ku xaday in ka badan $400 milyan oo crypto ah
items.summary: Hay'adda FBI ee Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in haakarro ay dowladda Kuuriyada Waqooyi taageerto ay in ka badan $400 milyan oo lacag crypto ah ku xadeen iyagoo adeegsanaya wicitaanno muuqaal ah oo been abuur ah si ay u xadaan aqoonsiga dadka, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta FBI ee J. Edgar Hoover Building ee Washington

items.title: Trump oo sheegay inuu ka fiirsan doono xoog militari oo ka dhan ah Cuba ka hor inta uusan xilka ka degin
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu hubaal ka fiirsan doono adeegsiga xoog militari oo ka dhan ah Cuba, isagoo intaas ku daray inuu doonayo in arrinta Cuba la dhammeeyo ka hor inta uusan xilka ka degin 2029, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Malecón ee magaalada Havana, caasimadda Cuba

items.title: Zelensky oo soo dhoweeyay in Yurub lagu daro wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda Ukraine iyo Ruushka
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa soo dhoweeyay ballanqaad ay bixiyeen ergooyinka Mareykanka Jared Kushner iyo Steve Witkoff oo ah in wakiillo ka socda Midowga Yurub lagu daro wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda ee Ruushka, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky oo kulan ku jira, June 2026

items.title: Booliska Haiti oo dib ula wareegay garoonka kubadda cagta ee qaranka oo 2 sano ay haysteen kooxaha burcadda
items.summary: Ciidamada amniga Haiti ayaa Khamiistii dib gacanta ugu soo celiyay garoonka ugu weyn ee kubadda cagta ee dalka, kaas oo 2 sano ay gacanta ku hayeen kooxaha burcadda, sida ay werisay France 24.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Sylvio Cator ee Port-au-Prince, garoonka qaranka ee Haiti (sawir 2010)

items.title: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania oo sheegay in shirka NATO ee 2027 aan lagu qaban doonin Tirana
items.summary: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania Edi Rama ayaa sheegay in NATO aysan sannadka soo socda shirkeeda ku qaban doonin Albania sidii loo qorsheeyay, xilli dowladdiisu ay wajahayso dhaleeceyn ku saabsan kharashka difaaca iyo mudaaharaadyo gudaha ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania Edi Rama oo ka hadlaya shir jaraa'id, Berlin 2025

items.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong iyo Yordan Alvarez oo codad buuxa loogu doortay ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha badan MLB 2026
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka Chicago Cubs Pete Crow-Armstrong iyo ciyaaryahanka Houston Astros Yordan Alvarez ayaa Khamiistii lagu dhawaaqay inay yihiin ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha badan (MVP) ee National League iyo American League, iyagoo labaduba helay codadka oo dhan, sida ay werisay The Guardian.
items.imageAlt: Pete Crow-Armstrong oo u ciyaaraya Chicago Cubs, 2024

items.title: Maxkamad ku taal Kaliningrad oo 12 sano xabsi ku xukuntay qareen u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha
items.summary: Maxkamad ku taal gobolka Kaliningrad ee Ruushka ayaa Khamiistii 12 sano oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Maria Bontsler, qareen 66 jir ah oo difaaci jirtay dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyo siyaasadeed, kadib markii lagu helay khiyaano qaran, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Kaniisadda weyn ee hore ee magaalada Kaliningrad, Ruushka

items.title: Mauricio Pochettino oo heshiis 2 sano iyo badh ah ku gaaray inuu tababare u noqdo Manchester United
items.summary: Manchester United iyo Mauricio Pochettino, tababaraha xulka Mareykanka, ayaa heshiis ku gaaray inuu noqdo tababaraha cusub ee kooxda, isagoo bedelaya Michael Carrick oo Khamiistii xilka laga qaaday, sida ay werisay Sky Sports.
items.imageAlt: Mauricio Pochettino oo garoonka ku jira xilli ciyaar xulka Mareykanka iyo Belgium, March 2026

items.title: Burburka dhismaha Brooklyn: tirada dadka dhintay oo gaartay 8, oo ay ku jiraan 2 carruur ah
items.summary: Mas'uuliyiinta magaalada New York ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in 8 qof, oo ay ku jiraan 2 carruur ah, ay ku dhinteen burburkii dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo Arbacadii ku dumay goob dhismo oo ku taal degmada Brooklyn, sida ay werisay France 24.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Flatbush Avenue ee degmada Brooklyn, New York, oo baraf ku daboolan, January 2026

items.title: Trump oo sheegay inuusan ka waaban doonin inuu xoog ka adeegsado Iran haddii xulafada iyo maraakiibta la khatar geliyo
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inuusan ka waaban doonin inuu ciidan ka adeegsado Iran haddii uu arko in xaaladdu ka soo horjeedo Washington, isagoo intaas ku daray in laga yaabo inuu hadda sidaas sameeyo, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo waraysi bixinaya, 30 October 2026

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Guddiga doorashada oo xisbiyada siin waayay jadwal cad oo doorashada 22 December
items.summary: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ee Koonfur Suudaan (NEC) ayaa Khamiistii magaalada Juba shir kula yeeshay xisbiyada siyaasadda si looga wada hadlo diyaargarowga doorashada guud ee 22 December, balse xisbiyada ayaa sheegay in aan la siin jadwal cad oo lagu dhammaystirayo hawlaha harsan, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Juba, caasimadda Koonfur Suudaan

items.title: Cillad ku timid adeegyada Microsoft oo saameysay Outlook, Teams iyo Copilot
items.summary: Kumanaan isticmaalayaal ah oo adeegyada Microsoft ah ayaa Khamiistii la kulmay dhibaatooyin ku saabsan emailka Outlook, Teams, Copilot iyo adeegyo kale oo Microsoft 365 ah, kadib markii server-yo si lama filaan ah u shaqeyn waayeen, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha 92 ee xarunta Microsoft ee Redmond, Washington

items.title: Rwanda oo COP31 ka codsatay maalgelin $3 bilyan oo koronto ah iyo ilaalinta daadadka Kigali
items.summary: Dowladda Rwanda ayaa shirka cimilada ee COP31 ka codsatay maalgelin caalami ah oo lagu taageerayo korontada, adkaysiga magaalooyinka iyo beeraha, iyadoo sheegtay inay u baahan tahay ku dhowaad 3.05 bilyan oo doollar qorshaheeda korontada, sida ay werisay KT Press.
items.imageAlt: Dad ka qayb qaadanaya shaqo bulsho oo lagu dayactirayo dhul-qoyanka Nyandungu ee Kigali, 2017

items.title: Khubaro oo cambaareeyay xil ka qaadista Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Bashe Yuusuf Axmed
items.summary: Koox khubaro ah ayaa maanta cambaareeyay xil ka qaadista sharci-darrada ah ee Dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku sameysay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Bashe Yuusuf Axmed, iyo dhaarinta qof loogu magacdaray beddelkiisa, iyaga oo ku tilmaamay faragelin cad oo lagu hayo madax-bannaanida garsoorka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud (bidix) iyo garsoore xiran dharka rasmiga ah ee Maxkamadda Sare (midig)

items.title: Harry Kane oo jebiyay rikoorka kulamada ugu badan ee xulka Ingiriiska, isagoo gaaray 126
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Bayern Munich Harry Kane ayaa Khamiistii noqday ciyaaryahanka ugu kulamada badan taariikhda xulka ragga Ingiriiska, kadib markii lagu bilaabay ciyaartii Nations League ee Croatia ee garoonka Wembley, taas oo ahayd kulankiisii 126-aad, sida ay werisay bogga rasmiga ah ee Bundesliga.
items.imageAlt: Harry Kane oo xulka Ingiriiska u ciyaaraya, June 2026

items.title: Helikobtar milateri oo nooca S-70 ah oo ku burburay Malatya ee bariga Turkiga, 4 askari ayaa ku dhintay
items.summary: Helikobtar ay leeyihiin ciidamada Turkiga oo nooca S-70 ah ayaa Khamiista fiidkii ku burburay degmada Yeşilyurt ee gobolka Malatya, waxaana shilka ku dhintay 4 askari, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Helikobtar Sikorsky S-70 Black Hawk ah oo ay leeyihiin ciidamada dhulka ee Turkiga, bandhigga Teknofest 2021, Istanbul (sawir hore)

items.title: Ingiriiska oo cunaqabateyn saaray dhammaan 10-ka shirkadood ee ugu waaweyn saliidda Ruushka
items.summary: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa Khamiista ku dhawaaqday cunaqabateyn cusub oo beegsanaysa dhammaan 10-ka shirkadood ee ugu waaweyn ee soo saara saliidda Ruushka, iyadoo ujeedku yahay in la jaro dakhliga lagu maalgeliyo dagaalka Ukraine, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Andy Burnham, 13 August 2024 (sawir hore)

items.title: Aisha Jumwa oo dib ugu laabatay xisbiga UDA, 3 bilood kadib markii ay ku biirtay Wiper
items.summary: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa Khamiista, 12 November 2026, Aqalka Madaxtooyada ee Mombasa ku soo dhaweeyay wasiirkii hore Aisha Jumwa oo dib ugu soo laabatay xisbiga talada haya ee UDA, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya iyo The Standard.
items.imageAlt: William Ruto (sawir hore)

items.title: Lix safaaradood oo ka digay khatar sare oo Ebola uga dillaacdo Koonfur Suudaan
items.summary: Safaaradaha Jarmalka, Japan, Netherlands, Norway, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska iyo Mareykanka ee Juba ayaa Khamiista bayaan wadajir ah ku sheegay in Koonfur Suudaan ay wajaheyso khatar sare oo Ebola ah, waxayna hoggaamiyeyaasha dalka ugu baaqeen inay maalgeliyaan qaybta caafimaadka.
items.imageAlt: Haweeney ku fadhida xarun caafimaad oo ku taalla Koonfur Suudaan, 2023

items.title: Jensen Huang oo iska casilay hoggaanka Nvidia, Colette Kress oo noqotay maamulaha ku-meel-gaarka
items.summary: Shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Khamiista xaqiijisay in aasaasaheeda iyo maamulaheeda guud Jensen Huang uu xilka ka degayo, kadib warar sheegayay inuu xiriir la lahaa haweeney ay saraakiisha Mareykanku u haystaan basaasad Shiine ah.
items.imageAlt: Jensen Huang oo ka hadlaya Jaamacadda Stanford, 30 April 2026

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Antalya kula kulmay Erdogan iyo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Liibiya
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Khamiista magaalada Antalya ee Turkiga kula kulmay Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Liibiya Cabdulxamiid Dbeibah, iyadoo kulammadu ay ka dhaceen hareeraha shirka cimilada ee COP31.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Erdogan iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo furaya terminaalka cusub ee garoonka Aadan Cadde, Muqdisho, January 2015

items.title: MSF: Boqollaal milyan oo doollar oo Ebola loogu talagalay oo aan gaarin shaqaalaha safka hore ee Kongo
items.summary: Hay'adda Dhakhaatiirta Aan Xuduudaha Lahayn (MSF) ayaa Khamiista ka digtay in maalgelinta caalamiga ah ee lagula dagaallamayo cudurka Ebola ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo aysan gaarin shaqaalaha caafimaadka iyo bulshooyinka sida weyn ugu baahan.
items.imageAlt: Xoghayaha Guud ee QM António Guterres iyo madaxa WHO Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus oo booqanaya xarunta daaweynta Ebola ee Mangina, Kongo, September 2019

items.title: Crystal Palace oo xilka ka qaaday tababare Pierre Sage kadib 16 kulan
items.summary: Kooxda Crystal Palace ayaa Khamiista xilka ka qaaday tababaraha Faransiiska Pierre Sage, iyadoo kooxdu ay ku jirto kaalinta ugu hooseysa Premier League-ka kadib shan bilood oo uu hoggaaminayay.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Selhurst Park ee kooxda Crystal Palace, qaybta Holmesdale Stand

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyay 3 siyaasadood qaran, heshiis Turkiga iyo xafiis OHCHR

items.imageAlt: Waddada isku xirta Marsabit iyo Moyale ee waqooyiga Kenya

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Antalya ka daahfurtay qorshe maalgashi cimilo oo lagu qiyaasay 12.8 bilyan oo doollar

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo Faysal Maxamed Xaashi u magacaabay Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka

items.imageAlt: Mudane Faysal Maxamed Xaashi, Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka, oo ay gadaashiisa ka muuqdaan astaanta Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo dekedda Muqdisho

items.title: Manchester United oo xilka ka qaaday Michael Carrick, Pochettino ayaa la filayaa inuu bedelo
items.summary: Manchester United ayaa Khamiista shaacisay inay xilka ka qaadday tababaraheedii Michael Carrick, iyadoo kooxdu ay ku jirto kaalinta 18-aad ee Premier League kadib bilowgii ugu xumaa ee xilli ciyaareed muddo 40 sano ah.
items.imageAlt: Michael Carrick oo la sawiray kadib ciyaar dhex martay Millwall iyo Middlesbrough, April 2025

items.title: Zelensky: Xaddidaad cusub oo lagu sameeyay Starshield ayaa wiiqaysa difaaca Ukraine
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa Khamiista sheegay in ciidamada Ukraine ay maalmihii la soo dhaafay la kulmeen carqalado waaweyn oo ku yimid adeegga isgaarsiinta dayax-gacmeedka Starshield, kuwaasoo saameeyay safka hore oo dhan iyo dhulka Ruushku qabsaday.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky, 2022

items.title: Turkiga oo beeniyay warar sheegaya inuu 15,000 askari u dirayo Soomaaliya

items.imageAlt: Furitaanka saldhigga ciidamada Turkiga ee Muqdisho, September 2017

items.title: James Anderson oo 44 jir ah oo u wareegay Surrey kaddib markii Lancashire aysan siin heshiis cusub
items.summary: Ciyaartoyga kubbadda cricket-ka ee England James Anderson, oo 44 jir ah, ayaa heshiis la saxiixday kooxda Surrey, taas oo u oggolaanaysa inuu ciyaarta sii wado xitaa kaddib dhalashadiisa 45-aad, sida ay Khamiista werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaartoyga cricket-ka ee England James Anderson sannadkii 2023

items.title: Burundi oo la sheegay inay dadajinayso ka bixitaanka ciidamadeeda Soomaaliya ka hor dhammaadka AUSSOM
items.summary: Dowladda Burundi ayaa la sheegay inay dadaal degdeg ah ugu jirto sidii ay ciidamadeeda uga saari lahayd Soomaaliya ka hor inta uusan dhammaan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, sida ay Khamiista werisay Hiiraan Online iyo Goobjoog News oo soo xigtay warbaahinta Africa Intelligence.
items.imageAlt: Askar ka tirsan ciidamada Burundi ee Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya oo safaf ku jira

items.title: Sarkaal ciidamada Ruushka ah oo lagu dilay qarax gaari oo ka dhacay St Petersburg
items.summary: Sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada Ruushka ayaa Khamiista lagu dilay qarax ku dhacay gaarigiisa degmada Pushkinsky ee magaalada St Petersburg, sida ay sheegtay Guddiga Baarista ee Ruushka oo dacwad dil ah furay.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal ka mid ah degmada Pushkinsky ee St Petersburg, Ruushka

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo COP31 ka codsaday 6.3 bilyan oo dollar oo Soomaaliya ugu diyaargarowdo isbeddelka cimilada
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shirweynaha COP31 ee Antalya ka dalbaday in Soomaaliya la siiyo 6.3 bilyan oo dollar si ay ula qabsato saameynta isbeddelka cimilada inta u dhexeysa hadda iyo 2035, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo kulan rasmi ah ku jira sannadkii 2025

items.title: Duqeyn Israa'iil ah oo ku dhacday Isbitaalka Nasser ee Khan Younis: 6 qof ayaa la sheegay inay dhinteen
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 6 qof ayaa la dilay, in ka badan 20 kalena waa ku dhaawacmeen duqeyn cirka ah oo Israa'iil ay Khamiista subaxnimo ku qaadday dhismo ka tirsan Isbitaalka Nasser ee magaalada Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza, sida ay sheegtay hay'adda difaaca madaniga ee Gaza.
items.imageAlt: Dhismayaal burburay oo ku yaal magaalada Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza

items.title: Philip Rivers oo noqonaya tababaraha cusub ee kooxda kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee NC State
items.summary: Philip Rivers, oo ahaa ciyaaryahan caan ah oo ka ciyaaray NFL, ayaa oggolaaday inuu noqdo tababaraha cusub ee kooxda kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee jaamacadda NC State, halkaas oo uu horey quarterback uga ahaa, sida ay werisay CBS Sports iyo The Athletic.
items.imageAlt: Philip Rivers xilligii uu NFL ka ciyaarayay, 2017

items.title: Stephen Curry oo dhaawac caloosha ah ku baxay, Rockets-na 115-108 kaga adkaadeen Warriors
items.summary: Xiddigga Golden State Warriors Stephen Curry ayaa Arbacadii ka baxay ciyaartii Houston Rockets rubucii 1-aad kaddib xanuun dhinaca midig ee caloosha ah, Rockets-na waxay ciyaarta ku guuleysteen 115-108.
items.imageAlt: Stephen Curry oo tababar tuur ah sameynaya ciyaar ka hor

items.title: Amnesty: QM iyo dowladda Koonfur Suudaan ayaa ka gaabiyay ka hortagga xasuuqii Abiemnom
items.summary: Hay'adda Amnesty International ayaa warbixin ay Khamiista soo saartay ku sheegtay in hawlgalka nabad-ilaalinta QM ee Koonfur Suudaan (UNMISS) iyo mas'uuliyiinta dalka ay haysteen digniino ku filan, balse ay ku guuldareysteen inay ka hortagaan weerar 1 March 2026 lagu dilay in ka badan 200 qof oo ku sugnaa Abiemnom.
items.imageAlt: Gawaarida hawlgalka QM ee Koonfur Suudaan (UNMISS) oo biyo ka qaadaya webiga Niil

items.title: Dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo ku burburay Brooklyn, New York: ugu yaraan 2 qof ayaa dhimatay
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 2 qof ayaa dhimatay, in ka badan 17 kalena waa la dhaawacay kaddib markii dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo ku yaal xaafadda Flatbush ee degmada Brooklyn, magaalada New York, uu Arbacadii galabnimo ku dumay goob dhismo oo ag taal, sida ay sheegeen mas'uuliyiinta magaalada.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Flatbush Avenue ee degmada Brooklyn, magaalada New York

items.title: Bangiga EBRD oo ballan-qaaday 6 bilyan oo doollar mashaariicda tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo ee Turkiga
items.summary: Bangiga Yurub ee Dib-u-dhiska iyo Horumarinta (EBRD) ayaa sheegay inuu shanta sano ee soo socota 6 bilyan oo doollar gelin doono mashaariicda tamarta nadiifka ah ee Turkiga, kadib markii uu ku biiray barnaamij cusub oo lagu daah-furay shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya.
items.imageAlt: Marawaxadaha dabaysha ee beerta korontada dabaysha ee Silivri, gobolka Istanbul, Turkiga

items.title: Jacob Misiorowski oo si wadajir ah ugu guuleystay abaalmarinta Cy Young ee National League
items.summary: Ciyaartoyga tuuraha ah ee kooxda Milwaukee Brewers Jacob Misiorowski ayaa Arbacadii lagu dhawaaqay inuu ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Cy Young ee National League ee xilli-ciyaareedka 2026, isagoo helay dhammaan 30-ka cod ee kaalinta koowaad.
items.imageAlt: Jacob Misiorowski oo kubad tuuraya isagoo u ciyaaraya Milwaukee Brewers

items.title: Saamiyada Nvidia oo hoos u dhacay iyadoo guddiga shirkadda uu ka doodayo mustaqbalka Jensen Huang
items.summary: Saamiyada shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Arbacadii ku dhacay in ka badan 8 boqolkiiba ganacsiga saacadaha dambe, kadib warar sheegaya in guddiga agaasimayaasha shirkadda uu ka doodi doono jagada madaxa shirkadda Jensen Huang, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta dhexe ee shirkadda Nvidia ee magaalada Santa Clara, California

items.title: Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Guatemala oo khatar ugu jira inay waayaan magaca dal ka xorobay jadeecada

items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Ururka Caafimaadka Pan-Ameerika (PAHO) ee magaalada Washington

items.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo gaaray Peru, dalkii uu muddo dheer ka shaqeeyay
items.summary: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa Arbacadii gaaray Peru, oo ah marxaladdii ugu dambeysay ee socdaalkiisa Koonfurta Ameerika, waxaana soo dhaweeyay kumanaan qof oo u yaqaan "Padre Robert", sida ay werisay France 24.
items.imageAlt: Taallada Baabe Leo XIV ee Pimentel, Chiclayo, Peru

items.title: Dimuqraadi Scott Colom oo ku guuleystay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee Mississippi
items.summary: Musharraxa xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Scott Colom ayaa ku guuleystay doorashada Golaha Guurtida Mareykanka ee gobolka Mississippi, isagoo tiro yar oo codad ah kaga adkaaday Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith oo ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Scott Colom, musharraxa Dimuqraadiga ee Golaha Guurtida Mississippi

items.title: Svitolina oo dib uga soo kacday kaga adkaatay Muchova, rajada WTA Finals-na ilaashatay
items.summary: Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine ayaa 3-6, 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaatay Karolina Muchova tartanka WTA Finals, taasoo u sii daysay fursadda inay u gudubto semi-finalka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Elina Svitolina oo ciyaar teennis ah ku jirta

items.title: Garsoore Mareykan ah oo oggolaaday in dacwadda $10 bilyan ee Trump ka gudbiyay BBC ay socoto

items.imageAlt: Xarunta BBC ee Broadcasting House, London

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo Jimcaha fasax dadweyne ka dhigtay aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu
items.summary: Koonfur Suudaan ayaa Jimcaha, 13 November 2026, ku dhawaaqday fasax dadweyne si muwaadiniintu uga qayb galaan aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu Yanga, hoggaamiyihii dhaqdhaqaaqa Anyanya, sida uu sheegay guddiga sare ee qabanqaabada aaska.

items.title: Iran oo ciidamada badda iyo cirka ee Argentina u aqoonsatay ururro argagixiso
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay ciidamada badda iyo ciidamada cirka ee Argentina u aqoonsatay ururro argagixiso, taasoo jawaab u ah go'aan Buenos Aires horay uga gaartay Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

Mabda'a Soomaaliya waa in madaxbannaanideeda iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed si buuxda loo ixtiraamo.

items.summary: Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka waxay leeyihiin xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo soo taxnaa tan iyo xilligii ay Soomaaliya xorriyadda qaadatay 1-dii Luulyo 1960, kana dhisan saaxiibtinimo, is-ixtiraam, iskaashi iyo danaha labada shacab. Qoraa: Eng Mahad AA.

items.summary: Rex Ryan, falanqeeyaha ESPN iyo tababarihii hore ee kooxaha New York Jets iyo Buffalo Bills, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 isu dhiibay booliska Nashville, kaddib markii lagu eedeeyay inuu baabuurkiisa ku dhuftay laba qof oo lugeynayay oo uu goobta ka tagay, sida ay werisay The Guardian.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Broadway ee bartamaha magaalada Nashville, Tennessee

items.summary: Danjiraha Türkiye u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan isbarasho ah la yeeshay Ra'iisul Wasaarihii 19-aad ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre. Waxay ka wada hadleen geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ee dalka, dadaallada afarta dhinac ee Türkiye, Maraykanka, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska iyo Midowga Yurub, iyo xiriirka…

items.title: Safiirka Ruushka u fadhiyay Mareykanka, Alexander Darchiev, oo geeriyooday isagoo 66 jir ah
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 ku dhawaaqday in safiirka dalkaas u fadhiyay Mareykanka, Alexander Darchiev, uu si lama filaan ah u geeriyooday isagoo 66 jir ah, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha safaaradda Ruushka ee magaalada Washington, D.C.

items.title: Iran oo ku hanjabtay inay weerari doonto saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Yurub haddii looga duulo
items.summary: Mohsen Rezaei, xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 sheegay in Tehran ay weerari doonto saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Yurub iyo jasiiradaha fogfog haddii laga adeegsado weerar lagu qaado Iran, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Mohsen Rezaei, xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran (sawir 2013)

items.title: Baarlamaanka Kenya oo meel mariyay sharci ka mamnuucaya isbitaallada inay bukaanka iyo meydadka hayaan

items.imageAlt: Qolka shirarka ee Golaha Qaranka Kenya, magaalada Nairobi

items.title: Wakiilka IGAD ee Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho ku qaabilay Danjiraha Sweden
items.summary: Wakiilka IGAD ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Mohamud Karshe, ayaa xarunta Urur Goboleedka IGAD ee magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay Danjiraha Dowladda Sweden u fadhiya Soomaaliya, H.E. Amb. Hans Henric Lundquist, iyagoo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida.

items.title: England oo baajisay Test-ka haweenka ee West Indies si ay ugu diyaar garowdo Ashes-ka

items.summary: Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Soomaaliya, Xasan Macallin Maxamuud, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 ka digay khataraha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee dalka, wuxuuna ku baaqay in dib loo eego nidaamka federaalka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Siyaasiyiin iyo odayaal Soomaaliyeed oo ku sugan Villa Somalia xilli la saxiixayay heshiiskii dowlad goboleedka Baydhabo (sawir 2014)

items.summary: Jared Kushner, oo qaba gabadha Madaxweyne Donald Trump, ayaa Arbacada sheegay in isaga iyo ergayga Bariga Dhexe Steve Witkoff ay berri u safri doonaan Moskow si ay ula kulmaan Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin, kaddib markii wada-hadallada saddex-geesoodka ah ee Abu Dhabi ay ku dhammaadeen horumar cad la'aan, sida ay werisay…

items.title: Isbaanya oo markii ugu horreysay muddo 14 sano ah gashay shaqo-joojin guud oo ka dhan ah xiisadda guryaha
items.summary: Malaayiin shaqaale ah oo Isbaanya ah ayaa Arbacada, 11 November 2026, galay shaqo-joojin guud oo 24 saacadood ah, iyagoo dowladda ka dalbanaya inay wax ka qabato xiisadda guryaha, wax ka yar saddex toddobaad kahor doorashada qaranka ee 29 November, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

items.title: Kenya oo sii daysay bukaankii Ebola ee ugu dambeeyay, tirinta 42 maalmood ee ka xorowga cudurka oo bilaabatay
